refs.text_big5: 一俄梅珥就是一伊法的十分之一。
refs.text_en: Now an omer is a tenth of an ephah.

refs.text_gb: 他的力量若不够献两只斑鸠或两只雏鸽，就要为所犯的罪带供物来，就是细面一伊法的十分之一作赎罪祭；不可加上油，也不可加上乳香，因为这是赎罪祭。
refs.text_big5: 他的力量若不彀獻兩隻斑鳩或兩隻雛鴿，就要為所犯的罪帶供物來，就是細麵一伊法的十分之一作贖罪祭；不可加上油，也不可加上乳香，因為這是贖罪祭。
refs.text_en: But if he cannot afford two turtledoves or two young pigeons, then he shall bring as his offering for that which he has sinned, the tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it nor put any frankincense upon it, for it is a sin offering.

verses.text_gb: 要在煎盘上用油调制；调匀了，你就拿来；要把烤好、分成块子的素祭，献给耶和华为怡爽的[Cra]香气。
verses.text_big5: 要在煎盤上用油調製；調勻了，你就拿來；要把烤好、分成塊子的素祭，獻給耶和華為怡爽的[Cra]香氣。
verses.text_en: On a flat plate it shall be prepared with oil; when it is mixed, you shall bring it; as a meal offering of baked pieces you shall present it as a satisfying fragrance to Jehovah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 要在煎盘上用油调制；调匀了，你就拿来；要把烤好、分成块子的素祭，献给耶和华为怡爽的香气。
verses.text_big5_plain: 要在煎盤上用油調製；調勻了，你就拿來；要把烤好、分成塊子的素祭，獻給耶和華為怡爽的香氣。

refs.text_gb: 要从他们手中接过来，烧在坛上的燔祭上，作为耶和华面前怡爽的香气；这是献给耶和华的火祭。
refs.text_big5: 要從他們手中接過來，燒在壇上的燔祭上，作為耶和華面前怡爽的香氣；這是獻給耶和華的火祭。
refs.text_en: And you shall take them from their hands and burn them on the altar upon the burnt offering for a satisfying fragrance before Jehovah; it is an offering by fire to Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 但燔祭牲的内脏与腿，那人要用水洗。祭司要把这一切全烧在坛上，当作燔祭，献与耶和华为怡爽香气的火祭。
refs.text_big5: 但燔祭牲的內臟與腿，那人要用水洗。祭司要把這一切全燒在壇上，當作燔祭，獻與耶和華為怡爽香氣的火祭。
refs.text_en: But its inward parts and its legs he shall wash with water. Then the priest shall burn the whole on the altar, as a burnt offering, an offering by fire, a satisfying fragrance to Jehovah.

verses.text_gb: 亚伦的子孙中，受膏接续他作祭司的，要调制这素祭。这是永远的定例；这祭要全烧给耶和华。
verses.text_big5: 亞倫的子孫中，受膏接續他作祭司的，要調製這素祭。這是永遠的定例；這祭要全燒給耶和華。
verses.text_en: And the priest anointed to be in his place from among his sons shall prepare it. It shall be a perpetual statute; it shall be wholly burned to Jehovah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 亚伦的子孙中，受膏接续他作祭司的，要调制这素祭。这是永远的定例；这祭要全烧给耶和华。
verses.text_big5_plain: 亞倫的子孫中，受膏接續他作祭司的，要調製這素祭。這是永遠的定例；這祭要全燒給耶和華。

verses.text_gb: 凡祭司的素祭要全烧了，不可以吃。
verses.text_big5: 凡祭司的素祭要全燒了，不可以喫。
verses.text_en: And every meal offering of the priest shall be wholly burned; it must not be eaten.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡祭司的素祭要全烧了，不可以吃。
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡祭司的素祭要全燒了，不可以喫。

verses.text_gb: 耶和华对摩西说，
verses.text_big5: 耶和華對摩西說，
verses.text_en: Then Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华对摩西说，
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華對摩西說，

verses.text_gb: 你要对亚伦和他儿子们说，[Cra]赎罪祭的条例乃是这样：要在[Fn1]宰燔祭牲的[Crb]地方，在耶和华面前宰赎罪祭牲；这是[Fn2]至圣的。
verses.text_big5: 你要對亞倫和他兒子們說，[Cra]贖罪祭的條例乃是這樣：要在[Fn1]宰燔祭牲的[Crb]地方，在耶和華面前宰贖罪祭牲；這是[Fn2]至聖的。
verses.text_en: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered the sin offering shall be slaughtered before Jehovah; it is most holy.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你要对亚伦和他儿子们说，赎罪祭的条例乃是这样：要在宰燔祭牲的地方，在耶和华面前宰赎罪祭牲；这是至圣的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你要對亞倫和他兒子們說，贖罪祭的條例乃是這樣：要在宰燔祭牲的地方，在耶和華面前宰贖罪祭牲；這是至聖的。

footnotes.zh: 在宰燔祭牲的地方，在耶和华面前宰赎罪祭牲，表征：(一)作我们赎罪祭的基督，乃是在神面前被杀；(二)基督作我们的赎罪祭，乃是基于祂作燔祭。基督必须是燔祭，使神满足，才够资格作我们的赎罪祭；我们必须先享受基督作我们的燔祭，就是绝对为着神的一位，我们才能知道自己是何等有罪，意即我们是多么为着自己，而不为着神。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在宰燔祭牲的地方，在耶和華面前宰贖罪祭牲，表徵：(一)作我們贖罪祭的基督，乃是在神面前被殺；(二)基督作我們的贖罪祭，乃是基於祂作燔祭。基督必須是燔祭，使神滿足，纔彀資格作我們的贖罪祭；我們必須先享受基督作我們的燔祭，就是絕對為著神的一位，我們纔能知道自己是何等有罪，意即我們是多麼為著自己，而不為著神。
footnotes.en: 6:25 1 burnt The slaughtering of the sin offering before Jehovah in the place where the burnt offering was slaughtered signifies: 1) that Christ as our sin offering was slain before God 2) that Christ is the sin offering for us based on His being the burnt offering. Christ must be the burnt offering for God's satisfaction that He might be qualified to be our sin offering, and we must enjoy Christ as our burnt offering, as the One who is absolutely for God, before we can realize how sinful we are, i.e., how much we are for ourselves and not for God.

footnotes.zh: 赎罪祭是至圣的，表征作我们赎罪祭的基督是至圣的，因祂内在且全然的对付了我们性情中的罪。
footnotes.zh_big5: 贖罪祭是至聖的，表徵作我們贖罪祭的基督是至聖的，因祂內在且全然的對付了我們性情中的罪。
footnotes.en: 6:25 2 most The sin offering being most holy signifies that Christ as our sin offering was most holy in that He dealt with sin in our nature intrinsically and entirely.

verses.text_gb_plain: 为罪献这祭的祭司要吃这祭物，要在圣处，就是在会幕的院子里吃。
verses.text_big5_plain: 為罪獻這祭的祭司要喫這祭物，要在聖處，就是在會幕的院子裏喫。

footnotes.zh: 献赎罪祭的祭司在圣处，就是在会幕的院子里吃这祭物，表征那以基督为赎罪祭服事罪人的，是在分别、圣别的范围里，就是在召会的范围里，享受基督为赎罪祭(参16注2)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 獻贖罪祭的祭司在聖處，就是在會幕的院子裏喫這祭物，表徵那以基督為贖罪祭服事罪人的，是在分別、聖別的範圍裏，就是在召會的範圍裏，享受基督為贖罪祭。（參16註2。）
footnotes.en: 6:26 1 priest That the priest who offered the sin offering ate it in a holy place, in the court of the Tent of Meeting, signifies that the one who serves sinners with Christ as their sin offering enjoys Christ as the sin offering in a separated, sanctified realm, in the sphere of the church (cf. note Lev. 6:16 2 ).

refs.text_gb: 所剩下的，亚伦和他子孙要吃，必在圣处不带酵而吃，要在会幕的院子里吃。
refs.text_big5: 所剩下的，亞倫和他子孫要喫，必在聖處不帶酵而喫，要在會幕的院子裏喫。
refs.text_en: And what is left of it Aaron and his sons may eat; it shall be eaten without leaven in a holy place; in the court of the Tent of Meeting they shall eat it.

refs.text_gb: 你们岂不知为圣事劳碌的，就吃殿中之物么？伺候祭坛的，就同祭坛分领坛上的祭物么？
refs.text_big5: 你們豈不知為聖事勞碌的，就喫殿中之物麼？伺候祭壇的，就同祭壇分領壇上的祭物麼？
refs.text_en: Do you not know that those who labor on the sacred things eat the things of the sacred temple, that those who attend to the altar have their portion with the altar?

verses.text_gb: 凡触着这祭肉的要成为[Fn1]圣；这祭牲的血若溅在什么衣服上，所溅的那一件要在圣处[Fn2][Cra]洗净。
verses.text_big5: 凡觸著這祭肉的要成為[Fn1]聖；這祭牲的血若濺在甚麼衣服上，所濺的那一件要在聖處[Fn2][Cra]洗淨。
verses.text_en: Whatever touches its flesh shall be holy. And when any of its blood splashes on a garment, you shall wash whatever was splashed in a holy place.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡触着这祭肉的要成为圣；这祭牲的血若溅在什么衣服上，所溅的那一件要在圣处洗净。
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡觸著這祭肉的要成為聖；這祭牲的血若濺在甚麼衣服上，所濺的那一件要在聖處洗淨。

footnotes.zh: 这表征凡触着基督这赎罪祭的，就被分别且圣别了，也会弃绝罪，并使肉体受对付，因为基督作赎罪祭，在十字架上已经对付了罪和我们有罪的肉体(罗八3)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這表徵凡觸著基督這贖罪祭的，就被分別且聖別了，也會棄絕罪，並使肉體受對付，因為基督作贖罪祭，在十字架上已經對付了罪和我們有罪的肉體。（羅八3。）
footnotes.en: 6:27 1 holy This signifies that whoever touches Christ as the sin offering is separated and sanctified (holy) and will forsake sin and have his flesh dealt with, for Christ as the sin offering has dealt with sin and our sinful flesh on the cross (Rom. 8:3).

footnotes.zh: 这表征那借著作赎罪祭之基督的血蒙救赎的人，他日常的行事为人(由衣服所表征—赛六四6上)该在分别、圣别的范围里受对付(参弗四22～24)。我们应当看重基督的血，绝不可将它当作俗物(参来十29)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這表徵那藉著作贖罪祭之基督的血蒙救贖的人，他日常的行事為人（由衣服所表徵—賽六四6上）該在分別、聖別的範圍裏受對付。（參弗四22～24。）我們應當看重基督的血，絕不可將它當作俗物。（參來十29。）
footnotes.en: 6:27 2 wash This signifies that the daily walk (signified by the garment — Isa. 64:6a) of the one who has received redemption through the blood of Christ as the sin offering should be dealt with in a separated, sanctified realm (cf. Eph. 4:22-24). We should have regard for the blood of Christ and should never consider it common (cf. Heb. 10:29).

refs.text_gb: 你要用铜作洗濯盆和盆座，以便洗濯。要将盆放在会幕和祭坛之间，在盆里盛水。
refs.text_big5: 你要用銅作洗濯盆和盆座，以便洗濯。要將盆放在會幕和祭壇之間，在盆裏盛水。
refs.text_en: You shall also make a laver of bronze, with its base of bronze, for washing. And you shall put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and you shall put water in it.

refs.text_gb: 亚伦和他的儿子们，要用这盆里的水洗手洗脚。
refs.text_big5: 亞倫和他的兒子們，要用這盆裏的水洗手洗腳。
refs.text_en: And Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet with water from it;

refs.text_gb: 他们进会幕的时候，要用水洗濯，免得死亡；或是他们就近坛前供职，给耶和华献火祭的时候，
refs.text_big5: 他們進會幕的時候，要用水洗濯，免得死亡；或是他們就近壇前供職，給耶和華獻火祭的時候，
refs.text_en: When they go into the Tent of Meeting, they shall wash with water, that they may not die; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn an offering by fire to Jehovah,

refs.text_gb: 必要洗手洗脚，免得死亡。这要作亚伦和他后裔，世世代代永远的定例。
refs.text_big5: 必要洗手洗腳，免得死亡。這要作亞倫和他後裔，世世代代永遠的定例。
refs.text_en: They shall wash their hands and their feet, that they may not die. And it shall be a perpetual statute to them, for him and for his seed throughout their generations.

refs.text_gb: 他要穿上细麻布圣内袍，把细麻布裤子穿在身上，腰束细麻布带子，头戴细麻布顶冠；这些都是圣衣。他要用水洗身，然后穿戴。
refs.text_big5: 他要穿上細麻布聖內袍，把細麻布褲子穿在身上，腰束細麻布帶子，頭戴細麻布頂冠；這些都是聖衣。他要用水洗身，然後穿戴。
refs.text_en: He shall put on the holy linen tunic, and linen trousers shall be upon his body, and he shall gird himself with the linen girdle and be attired with the linen turban; these are the holy garments. And he shall bathe his flesh in water and put them on.

refs.text_gb: 浸洗的教训，按手，死人的复活，以及永远的审判。
refs.text_big5: 浸洗的教訓，按手，死人的復活，以及永遠的審判。
refs.text_en: Of the teaching of baptisms and of the laying on of hands, of the resurrection of the dead and of eternal judgment.

verses.text_gb: 唯有煮祭物的[Cra]瓦器要[Fn1]打碎；若是煮在铜器里，这铜器要[Fn2]擦磨，在水中涮净。
verses.text_big5: 惟有煮祭物的[Cra]瓦器要[Fn1]打碎；若是煮在銅器裏，這銅器要[Fn2]擦磨，在水中涮淨。
verses.text_en: But the earthen vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken; and if it is boiled in a bronze vessel, it shall be scoured and rinsed in water.
verses.text_gb_plain: 唯有煮祭物的瓦器要打碎；若是煮在铜器里，这铜器要擦磨，在水中涮净。
verses.text_big5_plain: 惟有煮祭物的瓦器要打碎；若是煮在銅器裏，這銅器要擦磨，在水中涮淨。

footnotes.zh: 这表征那与作赎罪祭的基督有关联的人，乃是瓦器(参林后四7)，他天然的生命应当被破碎。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這表徵那與作贖罪祭的基督有關聯的人，乃是瓦器，（參林後四7，）他天然的生命應當被破碎。
footnotes.en: 6:28 1 broken This signifies that the natural life of the one who, as an earthen vessel (cf. 2 Cor. 4:7), has a relationship with Christ as the sin offering should be broken.

footnotes.zh: 这表征那受那灵光照并审判(由铜镜比喻—参出三十18注1)而得重生的人，不需要破碎，但需要借着擦磨和涮净而受对付(林前六11，多三5)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這表徵那受那靈光照並審判（由銅鏡比喻—參出三十18註1）而得重生的人，不需要破碎，但需要藉著擦磨和涮淨而受對付。（林前六11，多三5。）
footnotes.en: 6:28 2 scoured This signifies that the one who has been enlightened and judged by the Spirit (likened to a bronze mirror — cf. note Exo. 30:18 2 in ) to be regenerated needs not to be broken but to be dealt with by being scoured and rinsed (1 Cor. 6:11; Titus 3:5).

refs.text_gb: 若有掉在什么瓦器里的，其中不拘有什么，就不洁净，你们要把这瓦器打破。
refs.text_big5: 若有掉在甚麼瓦器裏的，其中不拘有甚麼，就不潔淨，你們要把這瓦器打破。
refs.text_en: And any earthen vessel into which any of them falls, whatever is in it shall be unclean, and the vessel you shall break.

refs.text_gb: 患漏症的人所摸的瓦器要打破，所摸的一切木器也要用水涮洗。
refs.text_big5: 患漏症的人所摸的瓦器要打破，所摸的一切木器也要用水涮洗。
refs.text_en: And the earthen vessel that the one who has the discharge touches shall be broken, and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

verses.text_gb: 凡祭司中的[Fn1]男丁都可以吃这祭物；这是至圣的。
verses.text_big5: 凡祭司中的[Fn1]男丁都可以喫這祭物；這是至聖的。
verses.text_en: Every male among the priests may eat of it; it is most holy.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡祭司中的男丁都可以吃这祭物；这是至圣的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡祭司中的男丁都可以喫這祭物；這是至聖的。

footnotes.zh: 这表征所有较刚强的人(男丁)，将作赎罪祭的基督供应给罪人时，就能享受基督为至圣的赎罪祭。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這表徵所有較剛強的人（男丁，）將作贖罪祭的基督供應給罪人時，就能享受基督為至聖的贖罪祭。
footnotes.en: 6:29 1 male This signifies that all the stronger ones (males) can enjoy Christ as the most holy sin offering in ministering Christ as the sin offering to sinners.

verses.text_gb: 凡赎罪祭，若有一些血带进会幕，在圣所[Fn1]遮罪，这祭物就不可吃，必用火焚烧。
verses.text_big5: 凡贖罪祭，若有一些血帶進會幕，在聖所[Fn1]遮罪，這祭物就不可喫，必用火焚燒。
verses.text_en: And any sin offering of which some of the blood is brought into the Tent of Meeting to make expiation in the Holy Place shall not be eaten; it shall be burned with fire.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡赎罪祭，若有一些血带进会幕，在圣所遮罪，这祭物就不可吃，必用火焚烧。
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡贖罪祭，若有一些血帶進會幕，在聖所遮罪，這祭物就不可喫，必用火焚燒。

footnotes.zh: 这里所提的遮罪，是在至圣所里(十六27)，就是神所在之处完成的。本节表征基督作赎罪祭，在十字架上对付了我们的罪和有罪的性情，为我们完成了神的救赎，这完全是为着神的享受，我们没有分。然而，当我们将基督作为赎罪祭供应给罪人时，我们能有分于祂(26)。关于基督作赎罪祭，神和事奉的祭司都有一分，而上好的一分是给神享受的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏所題的遮罪，是在至聖所裏，（十六27，）就是神所在之處完成的。本節表徵基督作贖罪祭，在十字架上對付了我們的罪和有罪的性情，為我們完成了神的救贖，這完全是為著神的享受，我們沒有分。然而，當我們將基督作為贖罪祭供應給罪人時，我們能有分於祂。（26。）關於基督作贖罪祭，神和事奉的祭司都有一分，而上好的一分是給神享受的。
footnotes.en: 6:30 1 expiation The expiation mentioned here was made in the Holy of Holies (Lev. 16:27), where God was. This verse signifies that Christ as the sin offering that dealt with our sin and with our sinful nature on the cross to accomplish God's redemption for us is wholly for God's enjoyment, and we have no share in it. However, in our ministering Christ as the sin offering to sinners, we can share in Him (v. 26). Concerning Christ as the sin offering, both God and the serving priests have a portion, the best portion being for God's enjoyment.

verses.text_gb: [Cra]赎愆祭的条例乃是这样：这祭是[Fn1]至圣的。
verses.text_big5: [Cra]贖愆祭的條例乃是這樣：這祭是[Fn1]至聖的。
verses.text_en: And this is the law of the trespass offering; it is most holy;
verses.text_gb_plain: 赎愆祭的条例乃是这样：这祭是至圣的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 贖愆祭的條例乃是這樣：這祭是至聖的。

footnotes.zh: 赎愆祭(像素祭和赎罪祭一样—六17，25)是至圣的，表征基督作我们的赎愆祭，在对付我们行为的诸罪上是至圣的。因着赎愆祭把我们指向赎罪祭，提醒我们，罪是在我们的肉体里(约壹一7～8)，也把我们指向燔祭，提醒我们，我们犯罪是因为我们没有绝对为着神(见五7注1)，我们不该轻率地取用赎愆祭；反之，我们该以圣别的方式应用基督作我们的赎愆祭。
footnotes.zh_big5: 贖愆祭（像素祭和贖罪祭一樣—六17，25）是至聖的，表徵基督作我們的贖愆祭，在對付我們行為的諸罪上是至聖的。因著贖愆祭把我們指向贖罪祭，題醒我們，罪是在我們的肉體裏，（約壹一7～8，）也把我們指向燔祭，題醒我們，我們犯罪是因為我們沒有絕對為著神，（見五7註1，）我們不該輕率的取用贖愆祭；反之，我們該以聖別的方式應用基督作我們的贖愆祭。
footnotes.en: 7:1 1 holy That the trespass offering (like the meal offering and the sin offering — Lev. 6:17, 25) was most holy signifies that Christ as our trespass offering is most holy in dealing with the sins in our conduct. Since the trespass offering refers us to the sin offering, reminding us that sin is in our flesh (1 John 1:7-8), and to the burnt offering, reminding us that we commit sins because we are not absolute for God (see note Lev. 5:7 1 ), we must not take it in a light way; rather, we must apply Christ as our trespass offering in a holy way.

refs.text_gb: 若有人听见叫人发誓作证的声音，他本是见证人，却不把所看见或知道的说出来，他就犯了罪，要担当他的罪孽。
refs.text_big5: 若有人聽見叫人發誓作證的聲音，他本是見證人，卻不把所看見或知道的說出來，他就犯了罪，要擔當他的罪孽。
refs.text_en: And if anyone sins in that he hears the voice of adjuration and he is a witness, either seeing or knowing about a matter, if he does not speak up, then he shall bear his iniquity.

refs.text_gb: 祭司要取一只公羊羔献为赎愆祭，和那一罗革油一同作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇。
refs.text_big5: 祭司要取一隻公羊羔獻為贖愆祭，和那一羅革油一同作搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖。
refs.text_en: And the priest shall take one of the male lambs and present it as a trespass offering and the log of oil, and wave them as a wave offering before Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 他要在宰赎罪祭牲和燔祭牲之地，就是在圣处，宰那只公羊羔；赎愆祭要归祭司，与赎罪祭一样；这是至圣的。
refs.text_big5: 他要在宰贖罪祭牲和燔祭牲之地，就是在聖處，宰那隻公羊羔；贖愆祭要歸祭司，與贖罪祭一樣；這是至聖的。
refs.text_en: Then he shall slaughter the male lamb in the place where they slaughter the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the place of the sanctuary; for the trespass offering, like the sin offering, is the priest's; it is most holy.

verses.text_gb: 人[Fn1]在哪里宰[Cra]燔祭牲，也要在哪里宰赎愆祭牲；祭牲的[Fn2]血，祭司要洒在坛的四边。
verses.text_big5: 人[Fn1]在那裏宰[Cra]燔祭牲，也要在那裏宰贖愆祭牲；祭牲的[Fn2]血，祭司要灑在壇的四邊。
verses.text_en: In the place where they slaughter the burnt offering they shall slaughter the trespass offering, and its blood he shall sprinkle on and around the altar.
verses.text_gb_plain: 人在哪里宰燔祭牲，也要在哪里宰赎愆祭牲；祭牲的血，祭司要洒在坛的四边。
verses.text_big5_plain: 人在那裏宰燔祭牲，也要在那裏宰贖愆祭牲；祭牲的血，祭司要灑在壇的四邊。

footnotes.zh: 在宰燔祭牲的地方宰赎愆祭牲，指明赎愆祭是基于燔祭，并且表征基督作我们的赎愆祭，乃是基于祂作燔祭。基督绝对为着神，乃是祂作我们赎罪祭(六25)和赎愆祭的基础。这提醒并加强我们，当我们取用基督作赎愆祭时，也要取用祂作燔祭，使我们在祂里面、同着祂并借着祂，能绝对的为着神。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在宰燔祭牲的地方宰贖愆祭牲，指明贖愆祭是基於燔祭，並且表徵基督作我們的贖愆祭，乃是基於祂作燔祭。基督絕對為著神，乃是祂作我們贖罪祭（六25）和贖愆祭的基礎。這題醒並加強我們，當我們取用基督作贖愆祭時，也要取用祂作燔祭，使我們在祂裏面、同著祂並藉著祂，能絕對的為著神。
footnotes.en: 7:2 1 place The trespass offering being slaughtered where the burnt offering was slaughtered indicates that the trespass offering is based on the burnt offering, and it signifies that Christ is the trespass offering for us based on His being the burnt offering. Christ's being absolute for God is the base for His being both our sin offering (Lev. 6:25) and our trespass offering. This reminds us and strengthens us, when we take Christ as our trespass offering, to take Him also as our burnt offering so that in Him, with Him, and through Him we may be absolute for God.

footnotes.zh: 参五9注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 參五9註1。
footnotes.en: 7:2 2 blood Cf. note Lev. 5:9 1

refs.text_gb: 你要对亚伦和他儿子们说，赎罪祭的条例乃是这样：要在宰燔祭牲的地方，在耶和华面前宰赎罪祭牲；这是至圣的。
refs.text_big5: 你要對亞倫和他兒子們說，贖罪祭的條例乃是這樣：要在宰燔祭牲的地方，在耶和華面前宰贖罪祭牲；這是至聖的。
refs.text_en: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered the sin offering shall be slaughtered before Jehovah; it is most holy.

verses.text_big5: 又要獻上祭牲所有的[Fn1][Cra]脂油，就是肥尾巴，和蓋臟的脂油，

verses.text_gb_plain: 又要献上祭牲所有的脂油，就是肥尾巴，和盖脏的脂油，
verses.text_big5_plain: 又要獻上祭牲所有的脂油，就是肥尾巴，和蓋臟的脂油，

refs.text_gb: 那人要从这祭牲中，将供物当作火祭献给耶和华。盖脏的脂油和脏上所有的脂油，
refs.text_big5: 那人要從這祭牲中，將供物當作火祭獻給耶和華。蓋臟的脂油和臟上所有的脂油，
refs.text_en: And from it he shall present his offering, as an offering by fire to Jehovah, the fat that covers the inward parts and all the fat that is on the inward parts,

refs.text_gb: 并两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰两旁的脂油，与肝上连着腰子的网子，都要取下。
refs.text_big5: 並兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰兩旁的脂油，與肝上連著腰子的網子，都要取下。
refs.text_en: And the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, which is on the loins; and the appendage on the liver, which he shall remove with the kidneys.

refs.text_gb: 祭司要把这些烧在坛上；这是献给耶和华为食物之怡爽香气的火祭；所有的脂油都是耶和华的。
refs.text_big5: 祭司要把這些燒在壇上；這是獻給耶和華為食物之怡爽香氣的火祭；所有的脂油都是耶和華的。
refs.text_en: And the priest shall burn them on the altar; it is the food of the offering by fire for a satisfying fragrance; all the fat is Jehovah's.

refs.text_gb: 在你们一切的住处，脂油和血都不可吃；这要作你们世世代代永远的定例。
refs.text_big5: 在你們一切的住處，脂油和血都不可喫；這要作你們世世代代永遠的定例。
refs.text_en: It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwelling places that you shall not eat any fat or any blood.

verses.text_gb: 他若为感谢而献，就要把调油的[Cra]无酵饼和抹油的无酵薄饼，并用油调匀细面作的饼，与[Fn1]感谢祭一同献上。
verses.text_big5: 他若為感謝而獻，就要把調油的[Cra]無酵餅和抹油的無酵薄餅，並用油調勻細麵作的餅，與[Fn1]感謝祭一同獻上。
verses.text_en: If he presents it for a thanksgiving, then he shall present with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil and unleavened wafers anointed with oil and saturated cakes of fine flour mingled with oil.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他若为感谢而献，就要把调油的无酵饼和抹油的无酵薄饼，并用油调匀细面作的饼，与感谢祭一同献上。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他若為感謝而獻，就要把調油的無酵餅和抹油的無酵薄餅，並用油調勻細麵作的餅，與感謝祭一同獻上。

footnotes.zh: 为感谢所献的平安祭，与各种素祭一同献上，表征我们在祂行为上享受祂作素祭的这位基督，乃是我们的平安祭；祂钉在十字架上，流出血来(西一20)，使我们将感谢归给神。关于素祭各项的意义，见二章注。
footnotes.zh_big5: 為感謝所獻的平安祭，與各種素祭一同獻上，表徵我們在祂行為上享受祂作素祭的這位基督，乃是我們的平安祭；祂釘在十字架上，流出血來，（西一20，）使我們將感謝歸給神。關於素祭各項的意義，見二章註。
footnotes.en: 7:12 1 sacrifice The presenting of the different kinds of meal offerings with the peace offering for thanksgiving signifies that the Christ who is the meal offering in our enjoyment of Him in His conduct is our peace offering, crucified with the shedding of His blood on the cross (Col. 1:20), in our thanksgiving to God. For the significance of the items of the meal offering, see notes on Lev. 2.

refs.text_gb: 你若献炉中烤的物为素祭作供物，就要用细面，作成调油的无酵饼，或抹油的无酵薄饼。
refs.text_big5: 你若獻爐中烤的物為素祭作供物，就要用細麵，作成調油的無酵餅，或抹油的無酵薄餅。
refs.text_en: And when you present an offering of a meal offering baked in the oven, it shall be of fine flour, unleavened cakes mingled with oil or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

refs.text_gb: 并一筐子无酵饼，就是细面调油的饼，与抹油的无酵薄饼，并同献的素祭和奠祭。
refs.text_big5: 並一筐子無酵餅，就是細麵調油的餅，與抹油的無酵薄餅，並同獻的素祭和奠祭。
refs.text_en: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and their meal offering and their drink offerings.

verses.text_gb: 他要把这供物，与[Fn1][Cra]有酵的饼，和为感谢所献的平安祭，一同献上。
verses.text_big5: 他要把這供物，與[Fn1][Cra]有酵的餅，和為感謝所獻的平安祭，一同獻上。
verses.text_en: With cakes of leavened bread he shall present his offering with the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他要把这供物，与有酵的饼，和为感谢所献的平安祭，一同献上。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他要把這供物，與有酵的餅，和為感謝所獻的平安祭，一同獻上。

footnotes.zh: 为感谢所献的平安祭，与有酵的饼一同献上，表征献祭的人虽然享受基督作无罪的一位，自己却仍然有罪，所以在软弱的光景中。因此，为感谢所献的平安祭，是最软弱的一种平安祭。
footnotes.zh_big5: 為感謝所獻的平安祭，與有酵的餅一同獻上，表徵獻祭的人雖然享受基督作無罪的一位，自己卻仍然有罪，所以在軟弱的光景中。因此，為感謝所獻的平安祭，是最軟弱的一種平安祭。
footnotes.en: 7:13 1 leavened The offering of the peace offering for thanksgiving with leavened bread signifies that the offerer, although he enjoys Christ as the One who is without sin, still has sin and is therefore in a weak condition. For this reason, the peace offering for thanksgiving is the weakest kind of peace offering.

refs.text_gb: 要从你们的住处带来两个摇祭的饼，是用细面一伊法的十分之二加酵烤成的，当作初熟之物献给耶和华。
refs.text_big5: 要從你們的住處帶來兩個搖祭的餅，是用細麵一伊法的十分之二加酵烤成的，當作初熟之物獻給耶和華。
refs.text_en: You shall bring out of your dwelling places two loaves as a wave offering; they shall be of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour, baked with leaven, as firstfruits to Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 以色列人哪，你们献有酵的感谢祭，宣报甘心祭给众人听见；因为这些是你们所喜爱的，这是主耶和华说的。
refs.text_big5: 以色列人哪，你們獻有酵的感謝祭，宣報甘心祭給眾人聽見；因為這些是你們所喜愛的，這是主耶和華說的。
refs.text_en: And offer in smoke a thank offering out of what is leavened; / And proclaim freewill offerings; make them known; / For you love them, O children of Israel, / Declares the Lord Jehovah.

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]从其中，他要从各样的供物中取一个饼，献给耶和华为[Cra]举祭；这要归给洒平安祭牲之血的祭司。
verses.text_big5: [Fn1]從其中，他要從各樣的供物中取一個餅，獻給耶和華為[Cra]舉祭；這要歸給灑平安祭牲之血的祭司。
verses.text_en: And from it he shall present one out of each offering as a heave offering to Jehovah; it shall belong to the priest who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings.
verses.text_gb_plain: 从其中，他要从各样的供物中取一个饼，献给耶和华为举祭；这要归给洒平安祭牲之血的祭司。
verses.text_big5_plain: 從其中，他要從各樣的供物中取一個餅，獻給耶和華為舉祭；這要歸給灑平安祭牲之血的祭司。

footnotes.zh: 即从素祭中。这表征：(一)在各面作素祭的基督，乃是作为在升天里的一位(举祭)献给神；(二)这样一位基督，乃是供应基督作平安祭的人所有分并享受的食物。
footnotes.zh_big5: 即從素祭中。這表徵：(一)在各面作素祭的基督，乃是作為在升天裏的一位（舉祭）獻給神；(二)這樣一位基督，乃是供應基督作平安祭的人所有分並享受的食物。
footnotes.en: 7:14 1 it I.e., from the meal offering. This signifies: 1) that Christ as the meal offering in all His aspects is offered to God as the One in ascension (a heave offering); 2) that such a Christ is partaken of and enjoyed as food by the one who ministers Christ as the peace offering.

refs.text_gb: 那摇祭的胸和举祭的腿，就是从承接圣职所献之公绵羊所摇的、所举的，是归亚伦和他儿子们的；这些你都要分别为圣。
refs.text_big5: 那搖祭的胸和舉祭的腿，就是從承接聖職所獻之公綿羊所搖的、所舉的，是歸亞倫和他兒子們的；這些你都要分別為聖。
refs.text_en: And you shall sanctify the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the heave offering which was waved and which was heaved up from the ram of consecration, from that which is for Aaron and from that which is for his sons.

refs.text_gb: 这要作亚伦和他儿子们从以色列人中永远所得的分，因为这是举祭。这要从以色列人平安祭的祭牲中，作为献给耶和华的举祭。
refs.text_big5: 這要作亞倫和他兒子們從以色列人中永遠所得的分，因為這是舉祭。這要從以色列人平安祭的祭牲中，作為獻給耶和華的舉祭。
refs.text_en: And it shall become a perpetual statute for Aaron and his sons to be observed by the children of Israel, for it is a heave offering; and it shall be a heave offering from the children of Israel from the sacrifices of their peace offerings, their heave offering to Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 耶和华对亚伦说，我已将我的举祭，就是以色列人一切分别为圣的物，交给你经管；因你受过膏，我把这些都赐给了你和你的子孙；这要作永远的定例。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華對亞倫說，我已將我的舉祭，就是以色列人一切分別為聖的物，交給你經管；因你受過膏，我把這些都賜給了你和你的子孫；這要作永遠的定例。
refs.text_en: Then Jehovah spoke to Aaron, And I Myself have given you charge of My heave offerings, even all the holy things of the children of Israel; I have given them to you because of the anointing, and to your sons, as a perpetual statute.

refs.text_gb: 以色列人礼物中的举祭，并一切的摇祭，也都是你的，我已赐给你和你的儿子并女儿；这要作永远的定例；凡在你家中洁净的人都可以吃。
refs.text_big5: 以色列人禮物中的舉祭，並一切的搖祭，也都是你的，我已賜給你和你的兒子並女兒；這要作永遠的定例；凡在你家中潔淨的人都可以喫。
refs.text_en: This also is yours, the heave offering of their gift, even all the wave offerings of the children of Israel. I have given them to you and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as a perpetual statute; everyone who is clean in your house may eat it.

refs.text_gb: 凡以色列人所献给耶和华圣物中的举祭，我都赐给你和你的儿子并女儿；这要作永远的定例。这是给你和你的后裔，在耶和华面前作为永远的盐约。
refs.text_big5: 凡以色列人所獻給耶和華聖物中的舉祭，我都賜給你和你的兒子並女兒；這要作永遠的定例。這是給你和你的後裔，在耶和華面前作為永遠的鹽約。
refs.text_en: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer to Jehovah, I have given to you and to your sons and your daughters with you, as a perpetual statute. It is a covenant of salt forever before Jehovah for you and for your descendants with you.

verses.text_gb: 他为感谢[Cra]所献平安祭牲的肉，要在献的日子吃，一点[Fn1]不可留到早晨。
verses.text_big5: 他為感謝[Cra]所獻平安祭牲的肉，要在獻的日子喫，一點[Fn1]不可留到早晨。
verses.text_en: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他为感谢所献平安祭牲的肉，要在献的日子吃，一点不可留到早晨。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他為感謝所獻平安祭牲的肉，要在獻的日子喫，一點不可留到早晨。

footnotes.zh: 这表征为感谢所献的平安祭维持的能力相当小，必须在献的日子完全享受，而我们对基督这一面的经历和享受，应该天天都是新鲜的。为还愿或是甘心所献的平安祭(16)，表征对基督较强的享受，能维持较久。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這表徵為感謝所獻的平安祭維持的能力相當小，必須在獻的日子完全享受，而我們對基督這一面的經歷和享受，應該天天都是新鮮的。為還願或是甘心所獻的平安祭，（16，）表徵對基督較強的享受，能維持較久。
footnotes.en: 7:15 1 not This signifies that the maintaining power of the peace offering for thanksgiving is rather small, that it has to be fully enjoyed on the day it is offered, and that our experience and enjoyment of Christ in this aspect should be fresh daily. The peace offering for a vow or a freewill offering (v. 16) signifies a stronger enjoyment of Christ that can last longer.

refs.text_gb: 你们献感谢祭给耶和华，要献得可蒙悦纳。
refs.text_big5: 你們獻感謝祭給耶和華，要獻得可蒙悅納。
refs.text_en: And when you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to Jehovah, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.

refs.text_gb: 要当天吃，一点不可留到早晨；我是耶和华。
refs.text_big5: 要當天喫，一點不可留到早晨；我是耶和華。
refs.text_en: On the same day it shall be eaten; you shall leave none of it until the morning; I am Jehovah.

verses.text_gb: [Cra]若所献的供物是为还愿，或是甘心献的，要在献祭的日子吃，所剩下的第二天也可以吃。
verses.text_big5: [Cra]若所獻的供物是為還願，或是甘心獻的，要在獻祭的日子喫，所剩下的第二天也可以喫。
verses.text_en: But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow or a freewill offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he presents his sacrifice, and on the next day what remains of it shall be eaten;
verses.text_gb_plain: 若所献的供物是为还愿，或是甘心献的，要在献祭的日子吃，所剩下的第二天也可以吃。
verses.text_big5_plain: 若所獻的供物是為還願，或是甘心獻的，要在獻祭的日子喫，所剩下的第二天也可以喫。

refs.text_gb: 这祭物要在献的当天或第二天吃，若有剩到第三天的，就要用火焚烧。
refs.text_big5: 這祭物要在獻的當天或第二天喫，若有剩到第三天的，就要用火焚燒。
refs.text_en: It shall be eaten on the day you sacrifice it, or on the next day, but what remains until the third day shall be burned with fire.

refs.text_gb: 第三天若再吃，这祭物就是可憎的，必不蒙悦纳。
refs.text_big5: 第三天若再喫，這祭物就是可憎的，必不蒙悅納。
refs.text_en: But if it is eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination; it will not be accepted.

refs.text_gb: 凡吃的人必担当自己的罪孽，因为他亵渎了耶和华的圣物；那人必从民中剪除。
refs.text_big5: 凡喫的人必擔當自己的罪孽，因為他褻瀆了耶和華的聖物；那人必從民中剪除。
refs.text_en: And whoever eats it will bear his own iniquity, because he has profaned what is holy to Jehovah; and that person shall be cut off from his people.

verses.text_gb: 但所剩下的祭肉，到第三天要用火焚烧；
verses.text_big5: 但所剩下的祭肉，到第三天要用火焚燒；
verses.text_en: But what remains of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但所剩下的祭肉，到第三天要用火焚烧；
verses.text_big5_plain: 但所剩下的祭肉，到第三天要用火焚燒；

verses.text_gb: 第三天若吃了平安祭牲的肉，这祭必不蒙悦纳，人所献的也不算为祭，反成了[Fn1]可憎之物；吃这祭肉的人，必担当他的罪孽。
verses.text_big5: 第三天若喫了平安祭牲的肉，這祭必不蒙悅納，人所獻的也不算為祭，反成了[Fn1]可憎之物；喫這祭肉的人，必擔當他的罪孽。
verses.text_en: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten at all on the third day, it will not be accepted, neither will it be reckoned to the one who presents it; it will be an abomination, and the person who eats of it shall bear his own iniquity.
verses.text_gb_plain: 第三天若吃了平安祭牲的肉，这祭必不蒙悦纳，人所献的也不算为祭，反成了可憎之物；吃这祭肉的人，必担当他的罪孽。
verses.text_big5_plain: 第三天若喫了平安祭牲的肉，這祭必不蒙悅納，人所獻的也不算為祭，反成了可憎之物；喫這祭肉的人，必擔當他的罪孽。

footnotes.zh: 这表征我们对基督的享受若是老旧的，就是神所憎恶的，也是与神不对的。
footnotes.en: 7:18 1 abomination This signifies that our enjoyment of Christ in its oldness is abhorrent to God and is not right with Him.

verses.text_gb: 祭肉若触着什么[Fn1]不洁之物，就不可吃，要用火焚烧。至于洁净的祭肉，凡洁净的人都可以吃；
verses.text_big5: 祭肉若觸著甚麼[Fn1]不潔之物，就不可喫，要用火焚燒。至於潔淨的祭肉，凡潔淨的人都可以喫；
verses.text_en: And flesh that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burned with fire. And as for other flesh, anyone who is clean may eat such flesh.
verses.text_gb_plain: 祭肉若触着什么不洁之物，就不可吃，要用火焚烧。至于洁净的祭肉，凡洁净的人都可以吃；
verses.text_big5_plain: 祭肉若觸著甚麼不潔之物，就不可喫，要用火焚燒。至於潔淨的祭肉，凡潔淨的人都可以喫；

footnotes.zh: 这表征享受基督作我们的平安，应当远离一切的不洁，并且基督这平安祭，该由洁净的人吃(林前十一28)。
footnotes.en: 7:19 1 unclean This signifies that the enjoyment of Christ as our peace should be kept from all uncleanness and also that Christ as the peace offering should be eaten by a clean person (1 Cor. 11:28).

verses.text_gb: 只是那归与耶和华平安祭牲的肉，人若不洁净而吃了，这人必从民中[Fn1]剪除。
verses.text_big5: 只是那歸與耶和華平安祭牲的肉，人若不潔淨而喫了，這人必從民中[Fn1]剪除。
verses.text_en: But the person who eats of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which belong to Jehovah, with his uncleanness upon him, that person shall be cut off from his people.
verses.text_gb_plain: 只是那归与耶和华平安祭牲的肉，人若不洁净而吃了，这人必从民中剪除。
verses.text_big5_plain: 只是那歸與耶和華平安祭牲的肉，人若不潔淨而喫了，這人必從民中剪除。

footnotes.zh: 20～21节的话，表征不洁净的人若有分于基督作他的平安，就如赴主的筵席(林前十16～17)，这人必从对基督之享受的交通中被撇开。这样一个有罪的人该从主筵席的交通中挪开(参林前五13下)。

refs.text_en: The priests shall not eat of anything that dies of itself or is torn by beasts, either a bird or an animal.

footnotes.zh_big5: 29～34節的話，表徵我們這些以基督為平安祭的，該把基督超越的部分（脂油）獻給神作祂的滿足，而基督在祂復活裏愛的部分（作搖祭的胸，）以及基督在升天裏剛強的部分（作舉祭的右腿，）是給事奉之人享受的。我們享受基督作平安祭時，神把基督愛的度量和加強的能力，分給我們這些新約的祭司，（彼前二5，9，啟一5～6，五10，）作我們事奉神時所享受的永分。見出二九26註1至28註1。
footnotes.en: 7:29 1 Speak The word in vv. 29-34 signifies that we who take Christ as our peace offering should offer the excellent part of Christ (the fat) to God for His satisfaction, the loving part of Christ in His resurrection (the breast as a wave offering) and the strong part of Christ in His ascension (the right thigh as a heave offering) being for the serving ones' enjoyment. In our enjoyment of Christ as the peace offering, God has allotted the loving capacity and the strengthening power of Christ to us, the New Testament priests (1 Pet. 2:5, 9; Rev. 1:5-6; 5:10), as our eternal portion for our enjoyment in serving God. See note Exo. 29:26 1 , note Exo. 29:26 2 , note Exo. 29:27 1 , note Exo. 29:28 1 .

footnotes.en: 7:37 1 consecration Lit., filling (of hands). So also throughout the book, unless otherwise noted. The consecration here is not a sixth offering; rather, the five offerings are for the consecration of Aaron and his sons to serve God as priests (cf. Exo. 29 and notes). At the time of consecration God assigned these offerings, in different aspects, for the priests' enjoyment. The word in vv. 37-38 signifies that our consecration for the priesthood must be with the all-inclusive Christ as all the five offerings and according to their regulations.

footnotes.zh: 一1～六7五种祭的次序，乃是照着我们实际的经历(见三1注1与5注1，四3注4三段)，而六8～七38的次序，乃是照着神经纶的全幅图画。在神的心和祂的愿望里，神是要基督作我们的四种祭—燔祭、素祭、赎罪祭和赎愆祭—使我们可以在各方面享受基督作我们与神的平安。基督作这四种祭，终结于神和祂子民之间的平安，这平安就是基督自己(弗二14)。享受基督作各种祭的结果带进平安祭，这至终要终极完成于新耶路撒冷，作最终的平安祭(耶路撒冷的意思是平安的根基)，在其中我们要享受三一神作平安(腓四7，9)，直到永远。因此，关于各种祭的条例乃是神经纶之总和的记载。
footnotes.zh_big5: 一1～六7五種祭的次序，乃是照著我們實際的經歷，（見三1註1與5註1，四3註4三段，）而六8～七38的次序，乃是照著神經綸的全幅圖畫。在神的心和祂的願望裏，神是要基督作我們的四種祭—燔祭、素祭、贖罪祭和贖愆祭—使我們可以在各方面享受基督作我們與神的平安。基督作這四種祭，終結於神和祂子民之間的平安，這平安就是基督自己。（弗二14。）享受基督作各種祭的結果帶進平安祭，這至終要終極完成於新耶路撒冷，作最終的平安祭，（耶路撒冷的意思是平安的根基，）在其中我們要享受三一神作平安，（腓四7，9，）直到永遠。因此，關於各種祭的條例乃是神經綸之總和的記載。
footnotes.en: 7:37 2 peace The sequence of the five offerings in 1:1—6:7 is according to our practical experience (see note Lev. 3:1 1 and note Lev. 3:5 1 and note Lev. 4:3 4 , par. 3), whereas the sequence in Lev. 6:8-30; 7:1-38 is according to the total picture of God's economy. In God's heart and in His desire God would have Christ to be four kinds of offerings to us — the burnt offering, the meal offering, the sin offering, and the trespass offering — that we may enjoy Christ as peace with God in every way. Christ's being these four offerings consummates in peace between God and God's people, and this peace is simply Christ Himself (Eph. 2:14). Eventually, the enjoyment of Christ as all the offerings, issuing in the peace offering, will consummate in the New Jerusalem as the ultimate peace offering (Jerusalem means the foundation of peace), in which we will enjoy the Triune God as peace (Phil. 4:7, 9) for eternity. Thus, the ordinances concerning the offerings are a record of the totality of God's economy.

footnotes.zh: 摩西用膏油抹帐幕、祭坛、洗濯盆、及一切器具，使它们分别为圣(10～11)，表征基督与召会(帐幕)、十字架(祭坛)、并那灵的洗涤(洗濯盆)，都与新约的祭司职分有关，使祭司得以圣别。见出二五9注1，二七1注2与三十18注2。 膏抹将那复合有基督的人性、人性生活、死、复活和升天的三一神，带给祭司以及召会生活。这很强的指明，祭司体系受膏抹乃是使神与我们成为一，因为膏抹表征凡神所是、所正在作以及将要作的，都是我们的(见出三十25注2，26注1)。在祭司承接圣职的事上，赎罪祭和燔祭紧接着膏抹(14～21)。这两种祭向我们提醒我们是谁，我们是什么，以及我们该是什么却还不是什么。见14注1与18注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 摩西用膏油抹帳幕、祭壇、洗濯盆、及一切器具，使它們分別為聖，（10～11，）表徵基督與召會（帳幕、）十字架（祭壇、）並那靈的洗滌（洗濯盆，）都與新約的祭司職分有關，使祭司得以聖別。見出二五9註1，二七1註2與三十18註2。ˍ膏抹將那複合有基督的人性、人性生活、死、復活和升天的三一神，帶給祭司以及召會生活。這很強的指明，祭司體系受膏抹乃是使神與我們成為一，因為膏抹表徵凡神所是、所正在作、以及將要作的，都是我們的。（見出三十25註2，26註1。）在祭司承接聖職的事上，贖罪祭和燔祭緊接著膏抹。（14～21。）這兩種祭向我們題醒我們是誰，我們是甚麼，以及我們該是甚麼卻還不是甚麼。見14註1與18註1。
footnotes.en: 8:10 1 anointed Moses' anointing of the tabernacle, the altar, and the laver, with all their utensils, to sanctify them (vv. 10-11) signifies that Christ and the church (the tabernacle), the cross (the altar), and the washing of the Spirit (the laver) are related to the New Testament priesthood for the priests' sanctification. See note Exo. 25:9 2 , note Exo. 27:1 1 , and note Exo. 30:18 1 . The anointing brings the Triune God compounded with Christ's humanity, human living, death, resurrection, and ascension to the priests and to the church life. This indicates strongly that the anointing of the priesthood is to make God one with us, for the anointing signifies that whatever God is, is doing, and will do are ours (see note Exo. 30:25 1 and note Exo. 30:26 1 ). In the consecration of the priests the sin offering and the burnt offering immediately followed the anointing (vv. 14-21). These offerings remind us of who and what we are, and of what we should be and yet are not. See note Lev. 8:14 1 and note Lev. 8:18 1 .

footnotes.en: 8:10 2 sanctified God's ordaining us to be priests is a matter of sanctification, a matter of being separated, of being made holy (Exo. 29:1 and note Exo. 29:1 1 ).

refs.text_en: And you shall present the bull before the Tent of Meeting, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.

refs.text_gb: 你要在耶和华面前，在会幕门口，宰这公牛。
refs.text_big5: 你要在耶和華面前，在會幕門口，宰這公牛。
refs.text_en: And you shall slaughter the bull before Jehovah at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

refs.text_gb: 要取些公牛的血，用指头抹在祭坛的四角上，把其余的血都倒在坛的基部。
refs.text_big5: 要取些公牛的血，用指頭抹在祭壇的四角上，把其餘的血都倒在壇的基部。
refs.text_en: And you shall take some of the blood of the bull and put some of it on the horns of the altar with your finger, and all the rest of the blood you shall pour out at the base of the altar.

refs.text_gb: 要把一切盖脏的脂油与肝上的网子，并两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，都烧在坛上。
refs.text_big5: 要把一切蓋臟的脂油與肝上的網子，並兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，都燒在壇上。
refs.text_en: And you shall take all the fat that covers the inward parts and the appendage on the liver and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, and burn them on the altar.

refs.text_gb: 只是公牛的肉、皮、粪，都要用火烧在营外；这是赎罪祭。
refs.text_big5: 只是公牛的肉、皮、糞，都要用火燒在營外；這是贖罪祭。
refs.text_en: But the flesh of the bull and its skin and its dung you shall burn with fire outside the camp; it is a sin offering.

refs.text_gb: 或是受膏的祭司犯罪，使百姓陷在罪里，就当为他所犯的罪，把一只没有残疾的公牛犊献给耶和华作赎罪祭。
refs.text_big5: 或是受膏的祭司犯罪，使百姓陷在罪裏，就當為他所犯的罪，把一隻沒有殘疾的公牛犢獻給耶和華作贖罪祭。
refs.text_en: If the anointed priest sins so as to bring guilt on the people, then let him present a bull of the herd without blemish to Jehovah for a sin offering for his sin that he committed.

refs.text_gb: 他要牵公牛到会幕门口、耶和华面前，按手在牛的头上，把牛宰于耶和华面前。
refs.text_big5: 他要牽公牛到會幕門口、耶和華面前，按手在牛的頭上，把牛宰於耶和華面前。
refs.text_en: And he shall bring the bull to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting before Jehovah, and he shall lay his hand on the head of the bull and slaughter the bull before Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 又把些血抹在会幕内、耶和华面前香坛的四角上，再把公牛所有其余的血倒在会幕门口、燔祭坛的基部。
refs.text_big5: 又把些血抹在會幕內、耶和華面前香壇的四角上，再把公牛所有其餘的血倒在會幕門口、燔祭壇的基部。
refs.text_en: And the priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense before Jehovah, which is in the Tent of Meeting; and all the rest of the blood of the bull he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

refs.text_gb: 要取下赎罪祭公牛所有的脂油，就是盖脏的脂油和脏上所有的脂油，
refs.text_big5: 要取下贖罪祭公牛所有的脂油，就是蓋臟的脂油和臟上所有的脂油，
refs.text_en: And all the fat of the bull of the sin offering he shall take off from it: the fat that covers the inward parts and all the fat that is upon the inward parts,

verses.text_gb: 摩西就宰了公牛，用指头蘸些血，抹在坛周围的四角上，使坛洁净，把其余的血倒在坛的基部，使坛分别为圣，为坛遮罪。
verses.text_big5: 摩西就宰了公牛，用指頭蘸些血，抹在壇周圍的四角上，使壇潔淨，把其餘的血倒在壇的基部，使壇分別為聖，為壇遮罪。
verses.text_en: And Moses slaughtered it and took the blood and put some of it on and around the horns of the altar with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar and sanctified it, to make expiation for it.
verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西就宰了公牛，用指头蘸些血，抹在坛周围的四角上，使坛洁净，把其余的血倒在坛的基部，使坛分别为圣，为坛遮罪。
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西就宰了公牛，用指頭蘸些血，抹在壇周圍的四角上，使壇潔淨，把其餘的血倒在壇的基部，使壇分別為聖，為壇遮罪。

verses.text_gb: 又取脏上所有的脂油和肝上的网子，并两个腰子与腰子上的脂油，都烧在坛上；
verses.text_big5: 又取臟上所有的脂油和肝上的網子，並兩個腰子與腰子上的脂油，都燒在壇上；
verses.text_en: And he took all the fat that was on the inward parts and the appendage of the liver and the two kidneys and their fat, and Moses burned them on the altar.
verses.text_gb_plain: 又取脏上所有的脂油和肝上的网子，并两个腰子与腰子上的脂油，都烧在坛上；
verses.text_big5_plain: 又取臟上所有的脂油和肝上的網子，並兩個腰子與腰子上的脂油，都燒在壇上；

verses.text_gb: 唯有公牛，连皮带肉和粪，用火烧在[Cra]营外，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.text_big5: 惟有公牛，連皮帶肉和糞，用火燒在[Cra]營外，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
verses.text_en: But the bull and its skin and its flesh and its dung he burned with fire outside the camp, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
verses.text_gb_plain: 唯有公牛，连皮带肉和粪，用火烧在营外，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 惟有公牛，連皮帶肉和糞，用火燒在營外，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。

refs.text_gb: 就是全公牛，要搬到营外洁净之地、倒灰之处，用火烧在柴上；总要在倒灰之处焚烧。
refs.text_big5: 就是全公牛，要搬到營外潔淨之地、倒灰之處，用火燒在柴上；總要在倒灰之處焚燒。
refs.text_en: That is, all the rest of the bull he shall bring out to a clean place outside the camp, where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire; where the ashes are poured out it shall be burned.

verses.text_gb: [Cra]他牵了[Fn1]燔祭的[Fn2]公绵羊来，亚伦和他儿子们按手在羊的头上。
verses.text_big5: [Cra]他牽了[Fn1]燔祭的[Fn2]公綿羊來，亞倫和他兒子們按手在羊的頭上。
verses.text_en: And he presented the ram of the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他牵了燔祭的公绵羊来，亚伦和他儿子们按手在羊的头上。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他牽了燔祭的公綿羊來，亞倫和他兒子們按手在羊的頭上。

footnotes.zh: 关于18～21节献燔祭的细节，见一4～9注。
footnotes.zh_big5: 關於18～21節獻燔祭的細節，見一4～9註。
footnotes.en: 8:18 1 ram The ram of the burnt offering signifies the strong Christ as our burnt offering for the assuming of our New Testament priesthood. This offering reminds us that as serving ones we must be absolute for God, yet we are not. Thus, we need to take Christ daily as our burnt offering for our priestly service (Lev. 6:12).

footnotes.zh: 燔祭的公绵羊，表征刚强的基督作我们的燔祭，使我们得以承担新约的祭司职分。这供物提醒我们这些事奉的人必须绝对为着神，而我们却不是。因此，为着祭司的事奉，我们需要天天取用基督作我们的燔祭(六12)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 燔祭的公綿羊，表徵剛強的基督作我們的燔祭，使我們得以承擔新約的祭司職分。這供物題醒我們這些事奉的人必須絕對為著神，而我們卻不是。因此，為著祭司的事奉，我們需要天天取用基督作我們的燔祭。（六12。）
footnotes.en: 8:18 2 burnt For the details concerning the offering of the burnt offering in vv. 18-21, see notes on Lev. 1:4-9.

refs.text_gb: 你也要取一只公绵羊来，亚伦和他儿子们要按手在羊的头上。
refs.text_big5: 你也要取一隻公綿羊來，亞倫和他兒子們要按手在羊的頭上。
refs.text_en: And you shall also take the one ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

refs.text_gb: 你要宰这羊，把血洒在坛的四边。
refs.text_big5: 你要宰這羊，把血灑在壇的四邊。
refs.text_en: And you shall slaughter the ram, and you shall take its blood and sprinkle it on and around the altar.

refs.text_gb: 要把羊切成块子，洗净内脏和腿，连块子带头，都放在一处。
refs.text_big5: 要把羊切成塊子，洗淨內臟和腿，連塊子帶頭，都放在一處。
refs.text_en: Then you shall cut the ram into its pieces and wash its inward parts and its legs, and put them with its pieces and its head.

refs.text_gb: 要把全羊烧在坛上；这是给耶和华的燔祭，是献给耶和华为怡爽香气的火祭。
refs.text_big5: 要把全羊燒在壇上；這是給耶和華的燔祭，是獻給耶和華為怡爽香氣的火祭。
refs.text_en: And you shall burn the whole ram on the altar; it is a burnt offering to Jehovah; it is a satisfying fragrance, an offering by fire to Jehovah.

verses.text_gb: 摩西就宰了公羊，把血洒在坛的四边，
verses.text_big5: 摩西就宰了公羊，把血灑在壇的四邊，
verses.text_en: And Moses slaughtered it and sprinkled the blood on and around the altar.
verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西就宰了公羊，把血洒在坛的四边，
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西就宰了公羊，把血灑在壇的四邊，

verses.text_gb: 把羊切成块子，把头和肉块并脂油都烧了。
verses.text_big5: 把羊切成塊子，把頭和肉塊並脂油都燒了。
verses.text_en: And he cut the ram into its pieces, and Moses burned the head and the pieces and the fat.
verses.text_gb_plain: 把羊切成块子，把头和肉块并脂油都烧了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 把羊切成塊子，把頭和肉塊並脂油都燒了。

verses.text_gb: 用水洗了内脏和腿，就把全羊烧在坛上；这是燔祭，作为怡爽的香气，是献给耶和华的火祭，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.text_big5: 用水洗了內臟和腿，就把全羊燒在壇上；這是燔祭，作為怡爽的香氣，是獻給耶和華的火祭，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
verses.text_en: And the inward parts and the legs he washed with water, and Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering for a satisfying fragrance; it was an offering by fire to Jehovah, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
verses.text_gb_plain: 用水洗了内脏和腿，就把全羊烧在坛上；这是燔祭，作为怡爽的香气，是献给耶和华的火祭，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 用水洗了內臟和腿，就把全羊燒在壇上；這是燔祭，作為怡爽的香氣，是獻給耶和華的火祭，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。

verses.text_gb: [Cra]他又把第二只公绵羊，就是[Fn1]承接圣职所献的羊牵来，亚伦和他儿子们按手在羊的头上。
verses.text_big5: [Cra]他又把第二隻公綿羊，就是[Fn1]承接聖職所獻的羊牽來，亞倫和他兒子們按手在羊的頭上。
verses.text_en: And he presented the other ram, the ram of consecration, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他又把第二只公绵羊，就是承接圣职所献的羊牵来，亚伦和他儿子们按手在羊的头上。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他又把第二隻公綿羊，就是承接聖職所獻的羊牽來，亞倫和他兒子們按手在羊的頭上。

footnotes.zh: 这公绵羊表征刚强的基督，使我们得以承接圣职，承担祭司职分。关于22～32节承接圣职献公绵羊的细节，见出二九19～34与注。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這公綿羊表徵剛強的基督，使我們得以承接聖職，承擔祭司職分。關於22～32節承接聖職獻公綿羊的細節，見出二九19～34與註。
footnotes.en: 8:22 1 ram This ram signifies the strong Christ for our consecration in the assuming of our priesthood. For details concerning the offering of the ram of consecration in vv. 22-32, see Exo. 29:19-34 and notes.

refs.text_gb: 你要取另一只公绵羊来，亚伦和他儿子们要按手在羊的头上。
refs.text_big5: 你要取另一隻公綿羊來，亞倫和他兒子們要按手在羊的頭上。
refs.text_en: And you shall take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.

refs.text_gb: 你要宰这羊，取点血抹在亚伦的右耳垂上，和他儿子们的右耳垂上；又抹在他们右手的大拇指上，和右脚的大拇指上；并要把其余的血洒在坛的四边。
refs.text_big5: 你要宰這羊，取點血抹在亞倫的右耳垂上，和他兒子們的右耳垂上；又抹在他們右手的大拇指上，和右腳的大拇指上；並要把其餘的血灑在壇的四邊。
refs.text_en: Then you shall slaughter the ram and take some of its blood and put it on the lobe of Aaron's right ear and on the lobe of the right ear of his sons and on the thumb of their right hand and on the big toe of their right foot, and sprinkle the rest of the blood on and around the altar.

refs.text_gb: 你要取点坛上的血，又取点膏油，弹在亚伦和他的衣服上，并他儿子们和他儿子们的衣服上，他们和他们的衣服就一同分别为圣。
refs.text_big5: 你要取點壇上的血，又取點膏油，彈在亞倫和他的衣服上，並他兒子們和他兒子們的衣服上，他們和他們的衣服就一同分別為聖。
refs.text_en: And you shall take some of the blood that is on the altar and some of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron and on his garments, and on his sons and on his sons' garments with him; and he and his garments shall be sanctified, as well as his sons and his sons' garments with him.

refs.text_gb: 你也要取这羊的脂油和肥尾巴，并盖脏的脂油与肝上的网子，两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，并右腿；（这是承接圣职所献的羊；）
refs.text_big5: 你也要取這羊的脂油和肥尾巴，並蓋臟的脂油與肝上的網子，兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，並右腿；（這是承接聖職所獻的羊；）
refs.text_en: You shall also take the fat from the ram, that is, the fat tail and the fat that covers the inward parts, and the appendage of the liver and the two kidneys with the fat that is on them, and the right thigh (for it is a ram of consecration),

refs.text_gb: 再从耶和华面前装无酵饼的筐子中取一个饼，一个调油的饼和一个薄饼；
refs.text_big5: 再從耶和華面前裝無酵餅的筐子中取一個餅，一個調油的餅和一個薄餅；
refs.text_en: And one loaf of bread and one cake of oiled bread and one wafer out of the basket of unleavened bread that is before Jehovah;

refs.text_gb: 都放在亚伦的手上，和他儿子们的手上，作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇。
refs.text_big5: 都放在亞倫的手上，和他兒子們的手上，作為搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖。
refs.text_en: And you shall put all these in the palms of Aaron and in the palms of his sons, and wave them as a wave offering before Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 要从他们手中接过来，烧在坛上的燔祭上，作为耶和华面前怡爽的香气；这是献给耶和华的火祭。
refs.text_big5: 要從他們手中接過來，燒在壇上的燔祭上，作為耶和華面前怡爽的香氣；這是獻給耶和華的火祭。
refs.text_en: And you shall take them from their hands and burn them on the altar upon the burnt offering for a satisfying fragrance before Jehovah; it is an offering by fire to Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 你要取亚伦承接圣职所献公绵羊的胸，作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇；这可以作你的分。
refs.text_big5: 你要取亞倫承接聖職所獻公綿羊的胸，作為搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖；這可以作你的分。
refs.text_en: And you shall take the breast of the ram of Arron's consecration and wave it as a wave offering before Jehovah; and it shall be your portion.

verses.text_gb: 摩西就宰了羊，把些血抹在亚伦的右[Fn1][Cra]耳垂上，和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上。
verses.text_big5: 摩西就宰了羊，把些血抹在亞倫的右[Fn1][Cra]耳垂上，和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上。
verses.text_en: And Moses slaughtered it and took some of its blood and put it on the lobe of Aaron's right ear and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.
verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西就宰了羊，把些血抹在亚伦的右耳垂上，和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上。
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西就宰了羊，把些血抹在亞倫的右耳垂上，和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上。

footnotes.zh: 见出二九20注1。
footnotes.en: 8:23 1 ear See note Exo. 29:20 1 .

refs.text_gb: 祭司要取些赎愆祭牲的血，抹在求洁净之人的右耳垂上，和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上。
refs.text_big5: 祭司要取些贖愆祭牲的血，抹在求潔淨之人的右耳垂上，和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上。
refs.text_en: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it on the lobe of the right ear of the one who is to be cleansed and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.

refs.text_gb: 祭司要从那一罗革油中取些倒在自己的左手掌里，
refs.text_big5: 祭司要從那一羅革油中取些倒在自己的左手掌裏，
refs.text_en: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil and pour it into the palm of the priest's left hand,

refs.text_gb: 把右手的一个指头蘸在左手掌的油里，在耶和华面前用指头弹油七次；
refs.text_big5: 把右手的一個指頭蘸在左手掌的油裏，在耶和華面前用指頭彈油七次；
refs.text_en: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in the palm of his left hand and sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 将手掌里所剩的油抹些在那求洁净之人的右耳垂上，和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上，就是抹在赎愆祭牲的血上。
refs.text_big5: 將手掌裏所剩的油抹些在那求潔淨之人的右耳垂上，和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上，就是抹在贖愆祭牲的血上。
refs.text_en: And from the rest of the oil that is in the palm of his hand the priest shall put some on the lobe of the right ear of the one who is to be cleansed and some on the thumb of his right hand and some on the big toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering.

verses.text_gb: 又叫亚伦的儿子们近前来，把些血抹在他们的右耳垂上，和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上；又把其余的血洒在坛的四边。
verses.text_big5: 又叫亞倫的兒子們近前來，把些血抹在他們的右耳垂上，和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上；又把其餘的血灑在壇的四邊。
verses.text_en: And he brought Aaron's sons near, and Moses put some of the blood on the lobe of their right ear and on the thumb of their right hand and on the big toe of their right foot; and Moses sprinkled the rest of the blood on and around the altar.
verses.text_gb_plain: 又叫亚伦的儿子们近前来，把些血抹在他们的右耳垂上，和右手的大拇指上，并右脚的大拇指上；又把其余的血洒在坛的四边。
verses.text_big5_plain: 又叫亞倫的兒子們近前來，把些血抹在他們的右耳垂上，和右手的大拇指上，並右腳的大拇指上；又把其餘的血灑在壇的四邊。

verses.text_gb: 又取脂油，就是肥尾巴，并脏上所有的脂油和肝上的网子，两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，并右腿，
verses.text_big5: 又取脂油，就是肥尾巴，並臟上所有的脂油和肝上的網子，兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，並右腿，
verses.text_en: And he took the fat, that is, the fat tail and all the fat that was on the inward parts, and the appendage of the liver, and the two kidneys and their fat, and the right thigh;
verses.text_gb_plain: 又取脂油，就是肥尾巴，并脏上所有的脂油和肝上的网子，两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，并右腿，
verses.text_big5_plain: 又取脂油，就是肥尾巴，並臟上所有的脂油和肝上的網子，兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，並右腿，

verses.text_gb: 再从耶和华面前装无酵饼的筐子中取一个无酵饼，一个调油的饼和一个薄饼，都放在脂油和右腿上，
verses.text_big5: 再從耶和華面前裝無酵餅的筐子中取一個無酵餅，一個調油的餅和一個薄餅，都放在脂油和右腿上，
verses.text_en: And from the basket of unleavened bread that was before Jehovah, he took one unleavened cake and one cake of oiled bread and one wafer, and placed them on the fat portions and on the right thigh.
verses.text_gb_plain: 再从耶和华面前装无酵饼的筐子中取一个无酵饼，一个调油的饼和一个薄饼，都放在脂油和右腿上，
verses.text_big5_plain: 再從耶和華面前裝無酵餅的筐子中取一個無酵餅，一個調油的餅和一個薄餅，都放在脂油和右腿上，

verses.text_gb: 把这一切放在亚伦的手上和他儿子们的手上，作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇。
verses.text_big5: 把這一切放在亞倫的手上和他兒子們的手上，作為搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖。
verses.text_en: And he put all these in the palms of Aaron and in the palms of his sons, and he waved them as a wave offering before Jehovah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 把这一切放在亚伦的手上和他儿子们的手上，作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇。
verses.text_big5_plain: 把這一切放在亞倫的手上和他兒子們的手上，作為搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖。

verses.text_gb: 摩西从他们的手上接过来，烧在坛上的燔祭上，都是承接圣职所献怡爽的香气，是献给耶和华的火祭。
verses.text_big5: 摩西從他們的手上接過來，燒在壇上的燔祭上，都是承接聖職所獻怡爽的香氣，是獻給耶和華的火祭。
verses.text_en: And Moses took them from their palms and burned them on the altar upon the burnt offering. They were an offering of consecration for a satisfying fragrance; it was an offering by fire to Jehovah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西从他们的手上接过来，烧在坛上的燔祭上，都是承接圣职所献怡爽的香气，是献给耶和华的火祭。
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西從他們的手上接過來，燒在壇上的燔祭上，都是承接聖職所獻怡爽的香氣，是獻給耶和華的火祭。

verses.text_gb: 摩西拿羊的胸作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇，是承接圣职所献的公绵羊中，归摩西的分，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.text_big5: 摩西拿羊的胸作為搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖，是承接聖職所獻的公綿羊中，歸摩西的分，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。
verses.text_en: And Moses took the breast and waved it as a wave offering before Jehovah; it was Moses' portion of the ram of consecration, just as Jehovah had commanded Moses.
verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西拿羊的胸作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇，是承接圣职所献的公绵羊中，归摩西的分，都是照耶和华所吩咐摩西的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西拿羊的胸作為搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖，是承接聖職所獻的公綿羊中，歸摩西的分，都是照耶和華所吩咐摩西的。

verses.text_gb: [Cra]摩西取些[Fn1]膏油和坛上的血，弹在亚伦和他的衣服上，并他儿子们和他们的衣服上，使他们和他们的衣服都分别为圣。
verses.text_big5: [Cra]摩西取些[Fn1]膏油和壇上的血，彈在亞倫和他的衣服上，並他兒子們和他們的衣服上，使他們和他們的衣服都分別為聖。
verses.text_en: And Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood that was on the altar and sprinkled it on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons and on his sons' garments with him; and he sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons and his sons' garments with him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西取些膏油和坛上的血，弹在亚伦和他的衣服上，并他儿子们和他们的衣服上，使他们和他们的衣服都分别为圣。
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西取些膏油和壇上的血，彈在亞倫和他的衣服上，並他兒子們和他們的衣服上，使他們和他們的衣服都分別為聖。

footnotes.zh: 见出二九21注1一段。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見出二九21註1一段。
footnotes.en: 8:30 1 anointing See note Exo. 29:21 1 , par. 1.

refs.text_gb: 你要取点坛上的血，又取点膏油，弹在亚伦和他的衣服上，并他儿子们和他儿子们的衣服上，他们和他们的衣服就一同分别为圣。
refs.text_big5: 你要取點壇上的血，又取點膏油，彈在亞倫和他的衣服上，並他兒子們和他兒子們的衣服上，他們和他們的衣服就一同分別為聖。
refs.text_en: And you shall take some of the blood that is on the altar and some of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it on Aaron and on his garments, and on his sons and on his sons' garments with him; and he and his garments shall be sanctified, as well as his sons and his sons' garments with him.

refs.text_gb: 要膏亚伦和他的儿子们，使他们分别为圣，可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_big5: 要膏亞倫和他的兒子們，使他們分別為聖，可以作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_en: And you shall anoint Aaron and his sons and sanctify them that they may serve Me as priests.

refs.text_gb: 这些是亚伦儿子的名字，他们都是受膏的祭司，承接圣职供祭司职分的。
refs.text_big5: 這些是亞倫兒子的名字，他們都是受膏的祭司，承接聖職供祭司職分的。
refs.text_en: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the anointed priests, whose were consecrated to serve as priests.

verses.text_gb: 摩西对亚伦和他儿子们说，要把肉[Cra]煮在会幕门口，在那里吃，又吃承接圣职筐子里的饼，正如我所吩咐的，说，这是亚伦和他儿子们要吃的。
verses.text_big5: 摩西對亞倫和他兒子們說，要把肉[Cra]煮在會幕門口，在那裏喫，又喫承接聖職筐子裏的餅，正如我所吩咐的，說，這是亞倫和他兒子們要喫的。
verses.text_en: And Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, and eat it there with the bread that is in the basket of consecration, just as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.
verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西对亚伦和他儿子们说，要把肉煮在会幕门口，在那里吃，又吃承接圣职筐子里的饼，正如我所吩咐的，说，这是亚伦和他儿子们要吃的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西對亞倫和他兒子們說，要把肉煮在會幕門口，在那裏喫，又喫承接聖職筐子裏的餅，正如我所吩咐的，說，這是亞倫和他兒子們要喫的。

refs.text_gb: 你要将承接圣职所献公绵羊的肉，煮在圣处。
refs.text_big5: 你要將承接聖職所獻公綿羊的肉，煮在聖處。
refs.text_en: And you shall take the ram of consecration and boil its flesh in a holy place.

refs.text_gb: 亚伦和他儿子们要在会幕门口，吃这羊的肉和筐内的饼。
refs.text_big5: 亞倫和他兒子們要在會幕門口，喫這羊的肉和筐內的餅。
refs.text_en: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram and the bread that is in the basket at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.

verses.text_gb: 剩下的肉和饼，你们要用火焚烧。
verses.text_big5: 剩下的肉和餅，你們要用火焚燒。
verses.text_en: And what is left of the flesh and of the bread you shall burn with fire.
verses.text_gb_plain: 剩下的肉和饼，你们要用火焚烧。
verses.text_big5_plain: 剩下的肉和餅，你們要用火焚燒。

verses.text_gb: 你们[Fn1][Cra]七天不可出会幕的门，直到你们[Crb]承接圣职的日子满了，因为你们要[Fn2]七天[Fn3]承接圣职。
verses.text_big5: 你們[Fn1][Cra]七天不可出會幕的門，直到你們[Crb]承接聖職的日子滿了，因為你們要[Fn2]七天[Fn3]承接聖職。
verses.text_en: And you shall not go out from the entrance of the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your consecration are fulfilled, for it will take seven days to consecrate you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们七天不可出会幕的门，直到你们承接圣职的日子满了，因为你们要七天承接圣职。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們七天不可出會幕的門，直到你們承接聖職的日子滿了，因為你們要七天承接聖職。

footnotes.zh: 承接圣职的祭司留在会幕门口七天，好为他们遮罪(33～36)，表征在我们进入召会生活时，我们承担新约的祭司职分，应当是彻底且完全的(由七天所表征)，好为我们成就平息(见十六1注1)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 承接聖職的祭司留在會幕門口七天，好為他們遮罪，（33～36，）表徵在我們進入召會生活時，我們承擔新約的祭司職分，應當是徹底且完全的（由七天所表徵，）好為我們成就平息。（見十六1註1。）
footnotes.en: 8:33 1 seven The consecrating priests remaining at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting for seven days for their expiation (vv. 33-36) signifies that our assuming of the New Testament priesthood should be thorough and complete (signified by the seven days) for our propitiation (see note Lev. 16:1 1 ) at our entering the church life.

footnotes.zh: 亚伦和他儿子们承接圣职，同样的程序重复七天，表征我们必须记得我们这些新约祭司承接圣职并接受任命的一切相关之事。
footnotes.zh_big5: 亞倫和他兒子們承接聖職，同樣的程序重複七天，表徵我們必須記得我們這些新約祭司承接聖職並接受任命的一切相關之事。
footnotes.en: 8:33 2 seven The process of consecrating Aaron and his sons was repeated for seven days, signifying that we need to remember all the things involved in our consecration and ordination as New Testament priests.

footnotes.zh: 直译，双手充满。十六32者同。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，雙手充滿。十六32者同。

refs.text_gb: 七日内，每日要预备一只公山羊为赎罪祭，也要预备一只公牛犊，和羊群中的一只公绵羊，都要没有残疾的。
refs.text_big5: 七日內，每日要豫備一隻公山羊為贖罪祭，也要豫備一隻公牛犢，和羊群中的一隻公綿羊，都要沒有殘疾的。
refs.text_en: Each day for seven days you shall offer a goat for a sin offering; they shall also offer a bull of the herd and a ram out of the flock without blemish.

refs.text_gb: 七日内，祭司要为坛遮罪，洁净坛；要这样把坛分别为圣。
refs.text_big5: 七日內，祭司要為壇遮罪，潔淨壇；要這樣把壇分別為聖。
refs.text_en: Seven days they shall make expiation for the altar and cleanse it, and so consecrate it.

refs.text_gb: 你要照我一切所吩咐的，向亚伦和他儿子们这样行，七天之久使他们承接圣职。
refs.text_big5: 你要照我一切所吩咐的，向亞倫和他兒子們這樣行，七天之久使他們承接聖職。
refs.text_en: And thus you shall do to Aaron and to his sons according to all that I have commanded you; you shall consecrate them seven days.

refs.text_gb: 要把这些给你的哥哥亚伦和他儿子们穿戴；又要膏他们，使他们承接圣职，将他们分别为圣，他们好作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_big5: 要把這些給你的哥哥亞倫和他兒子們穿戴；又要膏他們，使他們承接聖職，將他們分別為聖，他們好作祭司事奉我。
refs.text_en: And you shall put them upon Aaron your brother and upon his sons with him, and you shall anoint them and consecrate them and sanctify them, that they may serve Me as priests.

verses.text_gb: 今天所行的，耶和华吩咐要照样去行，为你们遮罪。
verses.text_big5: 今天所行的，耶和華吩咐要照樣去行，為你們遮罪。
verses.text_en: As has been done this day, so Jehovah has commanded to do, to make expiation for you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 今天所行的，耶和华吩咐要照样去行，为你们遮罪。
verses.text_big5_plain: 今天所行的，耶和華吩咐要照樣去行，為你們遮罪。

verses.text_gb: 七天你们要昼夜住在会幕门口，遵守耶和华的吩咐，免得你们[Fn1]死亡，因为所吩咐我的就是这样。
verses.text_big5: 七天你們要晝夜住在會幕門口，遵守耶和華的吩咐，免得你們[Fn1]死亡，因為所吩咐我的就是這樣。
verses.text_en: And at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting you shall stay day and night seven days, and keep the charge of Jehovah, that you may not die; for so I have been commanded.
verses.text_gb_plain: 七天你们要昼夜住在会幕门口，遵守耶和华的吩咐，免得你们死亡，因为所吩咐我的就是这样。
verses.text_big5_plain: 七天你們要晝夜住在會幕門口，遵守耶和華的吩咐，免得你們死亡，因為所吩咐我的就是這樣。

footnotes.zh: 这里指明祭司的承接圣职和接受任命是严肃的事。这警告我们，不该轻率地进入新约的祭司职分，也不该轻率地进入对基督的享受(参林前十一27～29)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏指明祭司的承接聖職和接受任命是嚴肅的事。這警告我們，不該輕率的進入新約的祭司職分，也不該輕率的進入對基督的享受。（參林前十一27～29。）
footnotes.en: 8:35 1 die The solemnity of the consecration and ordination of the priests is indicated here. This warns us that we should not enter into the New Testament priesthood and into the enjoyment of Christ in a careless way (cf. 1 Cor. 11:27-29).

verses.text_gb: 于是亚伦和他儿子们行了耶和华借着摩西所吩咐的一切事。
verses.text_big5: 於是亞倫和他兒子們行了耶和華藉著摩西所吩咐的一切事。
verses.text_en: And Aaron and his sons did all the things which Jehovah had commanded through Moses.
verses.text_gb_plain: 于是亚伦和他儿子们行了耶和华借着摩西所吩咐的一切事。
verses.text_big5_plain: 於是亞倫和他兒子們行了耶和華藉著摩西所吩咐的一切事。

verses.text_gb: 到了[Fn1][Cra]第八天，摩西召了亚伦和他儿子们，并以色列的众长老来；
verses.text_big5: 到了[Fn1][Cra]第八天，摩西召了亞倫和他兒子們，並以色列的眾長老來；
verses.text_en: Now on the eighth day Moses called Aaron and his sons and the elders of Israel;
verses.text_gb_plain: 到了第八天，摩西召了亚伦和他儿子们，并以色列的众长老来；
verses.text_big5_plain: 到了第八天，摩西召了亞倫和他兒子們，並以色列的眾長老來；

footnotes.zh: 第八天，就是新的七日的第一日，表征复活(可十六9上)。摩西在第八天引进祭司的事奉，指明一切祭司的事奉都必须在复活里，也就是在基督这赐生命的灵里(林前十五45下)，这灵乃是复活的实际(约十一25)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 第八天，就是新的七日的第一日，表徵復活。（可十六9上。）摩西在第八天引進祭司的事奉，指明一切祭司的事奉都必須在復活裏，也就是在基督這賜生命的靈裏，（林前十五45下，）這靈乃是復活的實際。（約十一25。）
footnotes.en: 9:1 1 eighth The eighth day, the first day of a new week, signifies resurrection (Mark 16:9a). That Moses initiated the priestly service on the eighth day indicates that all the priestly service must be in resurrection, i.e., in Christ as the life-giving Spirit (1 Cor. 15:45b), who is the reality of resurrection (John 11:25).

refs.text_gb: 七日内，祭司要为坛遮罪，洁净坛；要这样把坛分别为圣。
refs.text_big5: 七日內，祭司要為壇遮罪，潔淨壇；要這樣把壇分別為聖。
refs.text_en: Seven days they shall make expiation for the altar and cleanse it, and so consecrate it.

refs.text_gb: 满了七日，从第八日起，祭司要在坛上献你们的燔祭和平安祭；我必悦纳你们，这是主耶和华说的。
refs.text_big5: 滿了七日，從第八日起，祭司要在壇上獻你們的燔祭和平安祭；我必悅納你們，這是主耶和華說的。
refs.text_en: And when they have fulfilled the days, on the eighth day and onward, the priests shall offer your burnt offerings and your peace offerings upon the altar; and I will accept you, declares the Lord Jehovah.

footnotes.zh: 亚伦献上赎罪祭和燔祭，先为自己遮罪(7)，表征他是有罪的人，需要取用基督作他的赎罪祭和燔祭，使他与神之间的光景得以平息，而能作祭司事奉神。见八14注1与18注1。 亚伦预备赎罪祭和燔祭，也预表基督将自己献上作赎罪祭，为着救赎神的子民，并作燔祭，使神的子民作神的满足(来九14，十5～10)。不仅如此，这也表征凡我们的大祭司基督所作的，都是为我们作的，使我们蒙救赎脱离罪，并且成为神的满足。因着我们在基督的死里与祂是一，我们就在祂里面得蒙救赎(弗一7)；因着基督在祂的复活里与我们是一，基督就活在我们里面，使我们能活基督，使神得满足(加二20，腓一20～21上)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 亞倫獻上贖罪祭和燔祭，先為自己遮罪，（7，）表徵他是有罪的人，需要取用基督作他的贖罪祭和燔祭，使他與神之間的光景得以平息，而能作祭司事奉神。見八14註1與18註1。ˍ亞倫豫備贖罪祭和燔祭，也豫表基督將自己獻上作贖罪祭，為著救贖神的子民，並作燔祭，使神的子民作神的滿足。（來九14，十5～10。）不僅如此，這也表徵凡我們的大祭司基督所作的，都是為我們作的，使我們蒙救贖脫離罪，並且成為神的滿足。因著我們在基督的死裏與祂是一，我們就在祂裏面得蒙救贖；（弗一7；）因著基督在祂的復活裏與我們是一，基督就活在我們裏面，使我們能活基督，使神得滿足。（加二20，腓一20～21上。）
footnotes.en: 9:2 1 yourself Aaron's offering the sin offering and the burnt offering to make expiation for himself first (v. 7) signifies that he, as a sinful person, needed to take Christ as his sin offering and burnt offering so that his situation with God might be appeased and he might serve God as a priest. See note Lev. 8:14 1 and note Lev. 8:18 1 . Aaron's preparing the sin offering and the burnt offering also typifies Christ's offering Himself as a sin offering for the redemption of God's people and as a burnt offering for God's people to be God's satisfaction (Heb. 9:14; 10:5-10). Moreover, it signifies that whatever Christ as our High Priest did, He did for us, that we might be redeemed from sin and made God's satisfaction. By our being one with Christ in His death, we are redeemed in Him (Eph. 1:7), and by Christ's being one with us in His resurrection, He lives in us that we may live Him for God's satisfaction (Gal. 2:20; Phil. 1:20-21a).

verses.text_en: And the breasts and the right thigh Aaron waved for a wave offering before Jehovah, just as Moses had commanded.
verses.text_gb_plain: 胸和右腿，亚伦当作摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇，都是照摩西所吩咐的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 胸和右腿，亞倫當作搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖，都是照摩西所吩咐的。

refs.text_gb: 都放在亚伦的手上，和他儿子们的手上，作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇。
refs.text_big5: 都放在亞倫的手上，和他兒子們的手上，作為搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖。
refs.text_en: And you shall put all these in the palms of Aaron and in the palms of his sons, and wave them as a wave offering before Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 你要取亚伦承接圣职所献公绵羊的胸，作为摇祭，在耶和华面前摇一摇；这可以作你的分。
refs.text_big5: 你要取亞倫承接聖職所獻公綿羊的胸，作為搖祭，在耶和華面前搖一搖；這可以作你的分。
refs.text_en: And you shall take the breast of the ram of Arron's consecration and wave it as a wave offering before Jehovah; and it shall be your portion.

refs.text_gb: 他要亲手把耶和华的火祭，就是脂油和胸带来，好把胸在耶和华面前作摇祭，摇一摇。
refs.text_big5: 他要親手把耶和華的火祭，就是脂油和胸帶來，好把胸在耶和華面前作搖祭，搖一搖。
refs.text_en: His own hands shall bring Jehovah's offerings by fire; the fat with the breast he shall bring, that the breast may be waved as a wave offering before Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 祭司要把脂油烧在坛上，但胸要归亚伦和他的子孙。
refs.text_big5: 祭司要把脂油燒在壇上，但胸要歸亞倫和他的子孫。
refs.text_en: And the priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be for Aaron and for his sons.

refs.text_gb: 你们要从平安祭牲中，把右腿给祭司作举祭。
refs.text_big5: 你們要從平安祭牲中，把右腿給祭司作舉祭。
refs.text_en: And the right thigh you shall give to the priest for a heave offering out of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

refs.text_gb: 亚伦子孙中，献平安祭牲之血和脂油的，要得这右腿为分；
refs.text_big5: 亞倫子孫中，獻平安祭牲之血和脂油的，要得這右腿為分；
refs.text_en: The one among the sons of Aaron who presents the blood of the peace offerings and the fat shall have the right thigh as his portion.

refs.text_gb: 因为我从以色列人的平安祭牲中，取了这摇祭的胸和举祭的腿给祭司亚伦和他子孙；这要作以色列人所守永远的定例。
refs.text_big5: 因為我從以色列人的平安祭牲中，取了這搖祭的胸和舉祭的腿給祭司亞倫和他子孫；這要作以色列人所守永遠的定例。
refs.text_en: For the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the heave offering I have taken from the children of Israel out of the sacrifices of their peace offerings and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons for a perpetual statute to be observed by the children of Israel.

verses.text_gb: 亚伦向百姓举手，为他们[Fn1][Cra]祝福。他献了赎罪祭、燔祭、平安祭，就下来了。
verses.text_big5: 亞倫向百姓舉手，為他們[Fn1][Cra]祝福。他獻了贖罪祭、燔祭、平安祭，就下來了。
verses.text_en: And Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people and blessed them, and he came down from offering the sin offering and the burnt offering and the peace offerings.
verses.text_gb_plain: 亚伦向百姓举手，为他们祝福。他献了赎罪祭、燔祭、平安祭，就下来了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 亞倫向百姓舉手，為他們祝福。他獻了贖罪祭、燔祭、平安祭，就下來了。

footnotes.zh: 亚伦为百姓祝福，然后献了祭就下来，表征基督作我们的大祭司，在祂钉十字架以后，在祂的复活里祝福我们(路二四50)。主在复活里与我们同在，就是祂的祝福(太二八20)。这祝福借着我们应用祂作一切的供物而临到我们。
footnotes.zh_big5: 亞倫為百姓祝福，然後獻了祭就下來，表徵基督作我們的大祭司，在祂釘十字架以後，在祂的復活裏祝福我們。（路二四50。）主在復活裏與我們同在，就是祂的祝福。（太二八20。）這祝福藉著我們應用祂作一切的供物而臨到我們。
footnotes.en: 9:22 1 blessed Aaron's blessing of the people and then coming down from offering the offerings signifies that Christ as our High Priest, after His crucifixion, blessed us in His resurrection (Luke 24:50). The Lord's presence with us in His resurrection is His blessing (Matt. 28:20). This blessing comes to us through our applying Him as all the offerings.

refs.text_gb: 你要对亚伦和他儿子们说，你们要这样为以色列人祝福，说，
refs.text_big5: 你要對亞倫和他兒子們說，你們要這樣為以色列人祝福，說，
refs.text_en: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, Thus you shall bless the children of Israel; you shall say to them,

refs.text_gb: 愿耶和华赐福给你，保护你；
refs.text_big5: 願耶和華賜福給你，保護你；
refs.text_en: Jehovah bless you and keep you;

refs.text_gb: 愿耶和华使祂的面光照你，赐恩给你；
refs.text_big5: 願耶和華使祂的面光照你，賜恩給你；
refs.text_en: Jehovah make His face shine upon you and be gracious to you;

refs.text_gb: 愿耶和华向你仰脸，赐你平安。
refs.text_big5: 願耶和華向你仰臉，賜你平安。
refs.text_en: Jehovah lift up His countenance upon you and give you peace.

refs.text_gb: 他们要如此将我的名赐给以色列人，好使我赐福给他们。
refs.text_big5: 他們要如此將我的名賜給以色列人，好使我賜福給他們。
refs.text_en: So shall they put My name upon the children of Israel, that I Myself may bless them.

refs.text_gb: 利未子孙作祭司的要近前来；因为耶和华你的神拣选了他们事奉祂，在耶和华的名里祝福，所有争讼殴打的事都要凭他们的话判断。
refs.text_big5: 利未子孫作祭司的要近前來；因為耶和華你的神揀選了他們事奉祂，在耶和華的名裏祝福，所有爭訟毆打的事都要憑他們的話判斷。
refs.text_en: And the priests, the sons of Levi, shall draw near; for Jehovah your God has chosen them to minister to Him and to bless in the name of Jehovah, and by their word shall every dispute and every assault be settled.

verses.text_gb: 摩西、亚伦进入会幕，又出来为百姓[Fn1]祝福；耶和华的荣光就向众民[Fn2][Cra]显现。
verses.text_big5: 摩西、亞倫進入會幕，又出來為百姓[Fn1]祝福；耶和華的榮光就向眾民[Fn2][Cra]顯現。
verses.text_en: And Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting. And they came out and blessed the people; and the glory of Jehovah appeared to all the people.
verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西、亚伦进入会幕，又出来为百姓祝福；耶和华的荣光就向众民显现。
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西、亞倫進入會幕，又出來為百姓祝福；耶和華的榮光就向眾民顯現。

footnotes.zh: 摩西和亚伦进入会幕，又出来为百姓祝福，表征基督作我们的君王(摩西)和大祭司(亚伦)，进入诸天作我们君尊的大祭司(徒五31，来四14，七1)，并要从诸天出来为我们祝福。对于犹太人，摩西和亚伦的祝福仍然有效，并会持续直到救主再来，那时以色列全家要悔改并转向祂(亚十二10，罗十一26，启一7)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 摩西和亞倫進入會幕，又出來為百姓祝福，表徵基督作我們的君王（摩西）和大祭司（亞倫，）進入諸天作我們君尊的大祭司，（徒五31，來四14，七1，）並要從諸天出來為我們祝福。對於猶太人，摩西和亞倫的祝福仍然有效，並會持續直到救主再來，那時以色列全家要悔改並轉向祂。（亞十二10，羅十一26，啟一7。）
footnotes.en: 9:23 1 blessed Moses and Aaron's entering into the Tent of Meeting and coming out to bless the people signifies that Christ as our Prince (Moses) and High Priest (Aaron) entered into the heavens to be our kingly Priest (Acts 5:31; Heb. 4:14; 7:1) and will come out of heaven to bless us. For the Jews, the blessing of Moses and Aaron is still in effect and will continue until the entire house of Israel repents and turns to the Savior at His second coming (Zech. 12:10; Rom. 11:26; Rev. 1:7).

footnotes.zh: 神的显现(神的同在)与神荣光的显现(神的彰显)(4下，6下)，乃是我们照着神的定规，与神一同享受基督作一切供物，而有祭司事奉的结果。
footnotes.zh_big5: 神的顯現（神的同在）與神榮光的顯現（神的彰顯，）（4下，6下，）乃是我們照著神的定規，與神一同享受基督作一切供物，而有祭司事奉的結果。
footnotes.en: 9:23 2 appeared The appearing of God (God's presence) and of God's glory (God's expression) (vv. 4, 6b) is the issue of our priestly service in the enjoyment of Christ as all the offerings with God according to God's regulations.

refs.text_gb: 摩西说，这是耶和华吩咐你们行的；耶和华的荣光要向你们显现。
refs.text_big5: 摩西說，這是耶和華吩咐你們行的；耶和華的榮光要向你們顯現。
refs.text_en: And Moses said, This is what Jehovah has commanded you to do, and the glory of Jehovah shall appear to you.

refs.text_gb: 但全会众说要拿石头打死他们二人。这时，耶和华的荣光在会幕中向以色列众人显现。
refs.text_big5: 但全會眾說要拿石頭打死他們二人。這時，耶和華的榮光在會幕中向以色列眾人顯現。
refs.text_en: But the whole assembly said to stone them with stones. Then the glory of Jehovah appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all the children of Israel.

refs.text_gb: 可拉招聚全会众到会幕门前，要攻击摩西、亚伦；耶和华的荣光就向全会众显现。
refs.text_big5: 可拉招聚全會眾到會幕門前，要攻擊摩西、亞倫；耶和華的榮光就向全會眾顯現。
refs.text_en: Thus Korah gathered the whole assembly against them at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, and the glory of Jehovah appeared to the whole assembly.

refs.text_gb: 会众聚集攻击摩西、亚伦的时候，他们向会幕观看，不料，有云彩遮盖会幕，耶和华的荣光显现出来。
refs.text_big5: 會眾聚集攻擊摩西、亞倫的時候，他們向會幕觀看，不料，有雲彩遮蓋會幕，耶和華的榮光顯現出來。
refs.text_en: But when the assembly gathered against Moses and against Aaron, they looked toward the Tent of Meeting, and there the cloud was, covering it; and the glory of Jehovah appeared.

refs.text_gb: 摩西、亚伦离开会众，到会幕门口，面伏于地；耶和华的荣光向他们显现。
refs.text_big5: 摩西、亞倫離開會眾，到會幕門口，面伏於地；耶和華的榮光向他們顯現。
refs.text_en: And Moses and Aaron went from before the congregation to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting and fell upon their faces, and the glory of Jehovah appeared to them.

verses.text_gb: 有[Fn1][Cra]火从耶和华面前出来，烧尽了坛上的燔祭和脂油；众民一见，就都欢呼，面伏于地。
verses.text_big5: 有[Fn1][Cra]火從耶和華面前出來，燒盡了壇上的燔祭和脂油；眾民一見，就都歡呼，面伏於地。
verses.text_en: Then fire came forth from before Jehovah and consumed the burnt offering and the fat portions on the altar. And when all the people saw it, they gave a ringing shout and fell on their faces.
verses.text_gb_plain: 有火从耶和华面前出来，烧尽了坛上的燔祭和脂油；众民一见，就都欢呼，面伏于地。
verses.text_big5_plain: 有火從耶和華面前出來，燒盡了壇上的燔祭和脂油；眾民一見，就都歡呼，面伏於地。

footnotes.zh: 火表征神的圣别如同烈火(来十二29)，借着焚烧，悦纳我们的供物。苦难的烈火总是随着神的祝福(23)，表征神已经悦纳我们在基督里并凭着基督所献给祂的(参徒七55～59，提后四6)。参十1～2与2注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 火表徵神的聖別如同烈火，（來十二29，）藉著焚燒，悅納我們的供物。苦難的烈火總是隨著神的祝福，（23，）表徵神已經悅納我們在基督裏並憑著基督所獻給祂的。（參徒七55～59，提後四6。）參十1～2與2註1。
footnotes.en: 9:24 1 fire The fire signifies that God's holiness as a consuming fire (Heb. 12:29) accepts our offerings by burning. The consuming fire of suffering always follows God's blessing (v. 23), as a sign that God has accepted what we have offered to Him in Christ and with Christ (cf. Acts 7:55-59; 2 Tim. 4:6). Cf. Lev. 10:1-2 and note Lev. 10:2 1 .

refs.text_gb: 耶和华的使者伸出手内的杖，杖头挨了肉和无酵饼，就有火从磐石中上来，烧尽了肉和无酵饼。耶和华的使者就不见了。
refs.text_big5: 耶和華的使者伸出手內的杖，杖頭挨了肉和無酵餅，就有火從磐石中上來，燒盡了肉和無酵餅。耶和華的使者就不見了。
refs.text_en: And the Angel of Jehovah put forth the end of the staff that was in His hand and touched the flesh and the unleavened cakes. And fire came up from the rock and consumed the flesh and the unleavened cakes. And the Angel of Jehovah went from his sight.

refs.text_gb: 玛挪亚将一只山羊羔和素祭，在磐石上献与耶和华；祂行奇妙的事，玛挪亚和他的妻子观看着。
refs.text_big5: 瑪挪亞將一隻山羊羔和素祭，在磐石上獻與耶和華；祂行奇妙的事，瑪挪亞和他的妻子觀看著。
refs.text_en: And Manoah took the kid with the meal offering and offered it up upon the rock to Jehovah; and He acted wondrously, while Manoah and his wife looked on.

refs.text_gb: 当火焰从坛上往天上升时，耶和华的使者在坛上的火焰中也升上去了。玛挪亚和他的妻子看见，就面伏于地。
refs.text_big5: 當火焰從壇上往天上升時，耶和華的使者在壇上的火焰中也升上去了。瑪挪亞和他的妻子看見，就面伏於地。
refs.text_en: And when the flame went up from the altar to heaven, the Angel of Jehovah went up in the flame of the altar, while Manoah and his wife looked on; and they fell on their faces to the ground.

refs.text_gb: 于是耶和华降下火来，烧尽燔祭、木柴、石头、尘土，又烧干沟里的水。
refs.text_big5: 於是耶和華降下火來，燒盡燔祭、木柴、石頭、塵土，又燒乾溝裏的水。
refs.text_en: And the fire of Jehovah fell and consumed the burnt offering and the wood and the stones and the dust, and it licked up the water that was in the trench.

refs.text_gb: 大卫在那里为耶和华筑了一座坛，献燔祭和平安祭。他呼求耶和华，耶和华就应允他，使火从天降在燔祭坛上。
refs.text_big5: 大衛在那裏為耶和華築了一座壇，獻燔祭和平安祭。他呼求耶和華，耶和華就應允他，使火從天降在燔祭壇上。
refs.text_en: And there David built an altar to Jehovah, and he offered burnt offerings and peace offerings. And he called on Jehovah, and He answered him with fire from heaven upon the altar of burnt offering.

refs.text_gb: 所罗门祷告已毕，就有火从天上降下来，烧尽燔祭和别的祭。耶和华的荣光充满了殿；
refs.text_big5: 所羅門禱告已畢，就有火從天上降下來，燒盡燔祭和別的祭。耶和華的榮光充滿了殿；
refs.text_en: And when Solomon had finished praying, the fire came down from heaven and devoured the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of Jehovah filled the house.

verses.text_gb: 亚伦的儿子[Fn1]拿答、亚比户各拿自己的香炉，盛上火，加上香，在耶和华面前献上[Fn2]凡[Cra]火，是耶和华没有吩咐他们的。
verses.text_big5: 亞倫的兒子[Fn1]拿答、亞比戶各拿自己的香爐，盛上火，加上香，在耶和華面前獻上[Fn2]凡[Cra]火，是耶和華沒有吩咐他們的。
verses.text_en: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, each took his censer, and put fire in them and laid incense on it, and they presented strange fire before Jehovah, which He had not commanded them.
verses.text_gb_plain: 亚伦的儿子拿答、亚比户各拿自己的香炉，盛上火，加上香，在耶和华面前献上凡火，是耶和华没有吩咐他们的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 亞倫的兒子拿答、亞比戶各拿自己的香爐，盛上火，加上香，在耶和華面前獻上凡火，是耶和華沒有吩咐他們的。

footnotes.zh: 关于亚伦的儿子拿答和亚比户消极的光景，乃是发生在九22～24所描述荣耀和祝福之日以后不久，可能就在当日末了。
footnotes.zh_big5: 關於亞倫的兒子拿答和亞比戶消極的光景，乃是發生在九22～24所描述榮耀和祝福之日以後不久，可能就在當日末了。
footnotes.en: 10:1 1 Nadab The negative situation involving Nadab and Abihu, Aaron's sons, took place not long after, and probably at the end of, the day of glory and blessing described in Lev. 9:22-24.

footnotes.zh: 拿答和亚比户所献的凡火，乃是凡俗的火，不是圣别的火。这不是从祭坛(十六12)，就是从神，从天(九24)来的火，乃是从人，从地来的火，没有以遮罪为基础。凡火表征人所献给神天然的热心、天然的喜爱、天然的力量和天然的才能。拿答和亚比户为神作事，却是用天然的方法。因此，神借着烧灭这两位祭司，审判这样的献凡火(2)。这是很强的警告，给我们看见，我们接触神圣的事物时，需要将十字架应用于我们天然的生命。否则，我们若轻率地摸神的圣别事物，会带进属灵的死亡，甚至可能导致肉身的死亡(徒五1～11，林前十一27～32，约壹五16)，作为从圣别之神来的审判。见撒下六7注2与来十二29注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 拿答和亞比戶所獻的凡火，乃是凡俗的火，不是聖別的火。這不是從祭壇，（十六12，）就是從神，從天（九24）來的火，乃是從人，從地來的火，沒有以遮罪為基礎。凡火表徵人所獻給神天然的熱心、天然的喜愛、天然的力量、和天然的才能。拿答和亞比戶為神作事，卻是用天然的方法。因此，神藉著燒滅這兩位祭司，審判這樣的獻凡火。（2。）這是很強的警告，給我們看見，我們接觸神聖的事物時，需要將十字架應用於我們天然的生命。否則，我們若輕率的摸神的聖別事物，會帶進屬靈的死亡，甚至可能導致肉身的死亡，（徒五1～11，林前十一27～32，約壹五16，）作為從聖別之神來的審判。見撒下六7註2與來十二29註1。
footnotes.en: 10:1 2 strange The strange fire offered by Nadab and Abihu was common fire, not holy fire. It was not fire from the altar (Lev. 16:12), which came forth from God, from heaven (Lev. 9:24), but fire from man, from the earth, with no base of expiation. Strange fire signifies man's natural enthusiasm, natural affection, natural strength, and natural ability offered to God. Nadab and Abihu did something for God, but they did it in a natural way. Hence, God judged this offering by consuming the two priests (v. 2). This is a strong warning showing us that in touching the divine things we need to apply the cross to our natural life. Otherwise, our careless touching of the holy things of God will bring in spiritual deadness, and may even result in physical death (Acts 5:1-11; 1 Cor. 11:27-32; 1 John 5:16), as a judgment from the holy God. See note 2 Sam. 6:7 2 and note Heb. 12:29 1 .

footnotes.zh: 这嘱咐指明，拿答和亚比户轻率而不敬畏的行事，献上凡火给神，很可能是因为他们喝醉了淡酒或浓酒。9～11节的嘱咐，表征事奉神的人进到召会生活中，不该饮于任何属于世界享受、肉体兴趣或天然兴奋的东西，叫他们不至遭受属灵的死亡，却能分辨圣别和凡俗，不洁与洁净，并且能将神所定规的教导神的子民。

footnotes.en: 10:9 1 Drink This charge indicates that the reason Nadab and Abihu acted carelessly and without fear in offering strange fire to God might have been that they were drunk with wine or strong drink. The charge in vv. 9-11 signifies that God's serving ones, in coming into the church life, should not drink anything of the worldly enjoyment, of the fleshly interest, and of the natural excitement that they might not suffer spiritual deadness but be able to make a distinction between the holy and the common and between the unclean and the clean, and be able to teach God's people His regulations.

verses.text_gb: 摩西对亚伦和他剩下的儿子以利亚撒、以他玛说，你们把献给耶和华火祭中[Cra]所剩的[Fn1]素祭拿来，在坛旁不带酵而吃，因为这是至圣的。
verses.text_big5: 摩西對亞倫和他剩下的兒子以利亞撒、以他瑪說，你們把獻給耶和華火祭中[Cra]所剩的[Fn1]素祭拿來，在壇旁不帶酵而喫，因為這是至聖的。
verses.text_en: Then Moses spoke to Aaron and to Eleazar and to Ithamar, his sons who were left, Take the meal offering which remains of Jehovah's offerings by fire, and eat it unleavened beside the altar; for it is most holy.
verses.text_gb_plain: 摩西对亚伦和他剩下的儿子以利亚撒、以他玛说，你们把献给耶和华火祭中所剩的素祭拿来，在坛旁不带酵而吃，因为这是至圣的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 摩西對亞倫和他剩下的兒子以利亞撒、以他瑪說，你們把獻給耶和華火祭中所剩的素祭拿來，在壇旁不帶酵而喫，因為這是至聖的。

footnotes.zh: 在祭坛旁的圣处不带酵的吃所剩的素祭，作为给祭司的分(12～13)，表征在神享受祂的分之后(二2，9)，基督在祂的人性里作我们素祭的其余部分，是给我们这些新约祭司，在神的同在里(圣处)，在十字架(祭坛)旁边所享受，作我们无罪(无酵)的分。 神对亚伦两个儿子的审判，并没有终止神对祂子民的怜悯。紧接在1～11节神管教的审判和改正之后，神把素祭赐给亚伦和他两个儿子，这进一步显明神的怜悯和恩典。
footnotes.zh_big5: 在祭壇旁的聖處不帶酵的喫所剩的素祭，作為給祭司的分，（12～13，）表徵在神享受祂的分之後，（二2，9，）基督在祂的人性裏作我們素祭的其餘部分，是給我們這些新約祭司，在神的同在裏（聖處，）在十字架（祭壇）旁邊所享受，作我們無罪（無酵）的分。ˍ神對亞倫兩個兒子的審判，並沒有終止神對祂子民的憐憫。緊接在1～11節神管教的審判和改正之後，神把素祭賜給亞倫和他兩個兒子，這進一步顯明神的憐憫和恩典。
footnotes.en: 10:12 1 meal The eating of the remainder of the meal offering, as the priests' portion, unleavened in a holy place beside the altar (vv. 12-13) signifies that after God has enjoyed His portion (Lev. 2:2, 9), the remaining part of Christ in His humanity as our meal offering is for us, the New Testament priests, to enjoy as our portion without sin (unleavened), in a holy place (in God's presence), and beside the cross (the altar). The judgment of God on Aaron's two sons did not terminate God's mercy on His people. The giving of the meal offering to Aaron and his two sons immediately after God's disciplinary judgment and correction in vv. 1-11 was a further expression of God's mercy and grace.

refs.text_gb: 素祭所剩的要归给亚伦和他的子孙；这是献与耶和华的火祭中为至圣的。
refs.text_big5: 素祭所剩的要歸給亞倫和他的子孫；這是獻與耶和華的火祭中為至聖的。
refs.text_en: And what is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron's and his sons'; it is a thing most holy of Jehovah's offerings by fire.

refs.text_gb: 素祭所剩的要归给亚伦和他的子孙；这是献与耶和华的火祭中为至圣的。
refs.text_big5: 素祭所剩的要歸給亞倫和他的子孫；這是獻與耶和華的火祭中為至聖的。
refs.text_en: And that which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron's and his sons'; it is a thing most holy of Jehovah's offerings by fire.

verses.text_gb: 你们要在圣处吃，因为在献给耶和华的火祭中，这是[Cra]你的分和你儿子们的分；所吩咐我的本是这样。
verses.text_big5: 你們要在聖處喫，因為在獻給耶和華的火祭中，這是[Cra]你的分和你兒子們的分；所吩咐我的本是這樣。
verses.text_en: And you shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your due and your sons' due of Jehovah's offerings by fire; for so I have been commanded.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们要在圣处吃，因为在献给耶和华的火祭中，这是你的分和你儿子们的分；所吩咐我的本是这样。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們要在聖處喫，因為在獻給耶和華的火祭中，這是你的分和你兒子們的分；所吩咐我的本是這樣。

refs.text_gb: 素祭所剩的要归给亚伦和他的子孙；这是献与耶和华的火祭中为至圣的。
refs.text_big5: 素祭所剩的要歸給亞倫和他的子孫；這是獻與耶和華的火祭中為至聖的。
refs.text_en: And what is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron's and his sons'; it is a thing most holy of Jehovah's offerings by fire.

refs.text_gb: 所剩下的，亚伦和他子孙要吃，必在圣处不带酵而吃，要在会幕的院子里吃。
refs.text_big5: 所剩下的，亞倫和他子孫要喫，必在聖處不帶酵而喫，要在會幕的院子裏喫。
refs.text_en: And what is left of it Aaron and his sons may eat; it shall be eaten without leaven in a holy place; in the court of the Tent of Meeting they shall eat it.

refs.text_gb: 至圣之物中不经过火的，都是你的；以色列人给我的一切供物，就是一切的素祭、赎罪祭、赎愆祭，都是至圣的，要归给你和你的子孙。
refs.text_big5: 至聖之物中不經過火的，都是你的；以色列人給我的一切供物，就是一切的素祭、贖罪祭、贖愆祭，都是至聖的，要歸給你和你的子孫。
refs.text_en: This shall be yours of the most holy things, kept from the fire. Every offering of theirs, even every meal offering of theirs and every sin offering of theirs and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render to Me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.

refs.text_gb: 你要拿这些当至圣物吃；凡男丁都可以吃；你当以此物为圣。
refs.text_big5: 你要拿這些當至聖物喫；凡男丁都可以喫；你當以此物為聖。
refs.text_en: As the most holy things you shall eat it; every male shall eat it; it shall be holy to you.

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]摇祭的胸和举祭的腿，你们要在洁净的地方吃。你和你的儿女都要同吃，因为这些是从以色列人的平安祭中给的，作你的分和你儿子们的分。
verses.text_big5: [Fn1]搖祭的胸和舉祭的腿，你們要在潔淨的地方喫。你和你的兒女都要同喫，因為這些是從以色列人的平安祭中給的，作你的分和你兒子們的分。
verses.text_en: And the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the heave offering you shall eat in a clean place, you and your sons and your daughters with you; for they have been given as your due and your sons' due out of the sacrifices of the peace offerings of the children of Israel.
verses.text_gb_plain: 摇祭的胸和举祭的腿，你们要在洁净的地方吃。你和你的儿女都要同吃，因为这些是从以色列人的平安祭中给的，作你的分和你儿子们的分。
verses.text_big5_plain: 搖祭的胸和舉祭的腿，你們要在潔淨的地方喫。你和你的兒女都要同喫，因為這些是從以色列人的平安祭中給的，作你的分和你兒子們的分。
