verses.text_gb_plain: 赎罪祭牲的脂油要烧在坛上。
verses.text_big5_plain: 贖罪祭牲的脂油要燒在壇上。

footnotes.zh: 即当作香焚烧。赎罪祭牲的脂油当作香焚烧，表征主耶稣在十字架上的死是为着救赎我们，而祂的心向着神且为着神(由作为赎罪祭柔细部分的脂油所表征)，乃为蒙神悦纳。本章里基督作为在香坛上焚烧的香(12～13)，以及基督向着神并为着神的心，这二者对神都是可蒙悦纳的甜美香气，使神悦纳我们。
footnotes.zh_big5: 即當作香焚燒。贖罪祭牲的脂油當作香焚燒，表徵主耶穌在十字架上的死是為著救贖我們，而祂的心向著神且為著神（由作為贖罪祭柔細部分的脂油所表徵，）乃為蒙神悅納。本章裏基督作為在香壇上焚燒的香，（12～13，）以及基督向著神並為著神的心，這二者對神都是可蒙悅納的甜美香氣，使神悅納我們。
footnotes.en: 16:25 1 burn I.e., burn as incense. The burning of the fat of the sin offering as incense signifies that the Lord Jesus' death on the cross is for our redemption and that His heart toward God and for God (signified by the fat as the tender part of the sin offering) is for God's acceptance. In this chapter both Christ as the incense burned on the incense altar (vv. 12-13) and the heart of Christ, which is toward God and for God, are a sweet savor to God that is acceptable to God and that becomes God's acceptance of us.

verses.text_gb: 那放羊归与阿撒泻勒的人要[Fn1]洗衣服，用水洗身，然后进营。
verses.text_big5: 那放羊歸與阿撒瀉勒的人要[Fn1]洗衣服，用水洗身，然後進營。
verses.text_en: And he who lets the goat go for Azazel shall wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and afterward he may come into the camp.
verses.text_gb_plain: 那放羊归与阿撒泻勒的人要洗衣服，用水洗身，然后进营。
verses.text_big5_plain: 那放羊歸與阿撒瀉勒的人要洗衣服，用水洗身，然後進營。

footnotes.zh: 这表征凡因接触与罪有关的事物而受玷污的人，必须对付他外面的生活(由衣服所表征)，并对付他自己。28节者同。
footnotes.en: 16:26 1 wash This signifies that the one who is defiled by contacting anything related to sin must deal with his outward living (signified by the clothes) and with himself as well. So also for v. 28.

verses.text_gb: 作赎罪祭的公牛和公山羊的血既带入至圣所遮罪，这牛羊就要搬到[Fn1][Cra]营外，将皮、肉、粪用火焚烧。
verses.text_big5: 作贖罪祭的公牛和公山羊的血既帶入至聖所遮罪，這牛羊就要搬到[Fn1][Cra]營外，將皮、肉、糞用火焚燒。
verses.text_en: And the bull of the sin offering and the goat of the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make expiation in the Holy of Holies, shall be carried forth outside the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins and their flesh and their dung.
verses.text_gb_plain: 作赎罪祭的公牛和公山羊的血既带入至圣所遮罪，这牛羊就要搬到营外，将皮、肉、粪用火焚烧。
verses.text_big5_plain: 作贖罪祭的公牛和公山羊的血既帶入至聖所遮罪，這牛羊就要搬到營外，將皮、肉、糞用火焚燒。

footnotes.zh: 把赎罪祭牲搬到营外，将皮、肉、粪焚烧，表征：第一，主耶稣在十字架上一次永远的成就了永远、完全的救赎(来九12)，事奉祂的人在这事上是无分的(六30与注，来十三10～11与10注1)；第二，成功救赎的主，为人所弃绝；因此，凡接受祂救赎的，也当与祂一同出到营外，忍受祂所受的凌辱(来十三12～13与注)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 把贖罪祭牲搬到營外，將皮、肉、糞焚燒，表徵：第一，主耶穌在十字架上一次永遠的成就了永遠、完全的救贖，（來九12，）事奉祂的人在這事上是無分的；（六30與註，來十三10～11與10註1；）第二，成功救贖的主，為人所棄絕；因此，凡接受祂救贖的，也當與祂一同出到營外，忍受祂所受的凌辱。（來十三12～13與註。）
footnotes.en: 16:27 1 outside The carrying of the sin offering outside the camp and the burning of its skin, its flesh, and its dung signify, first, that the Lord Jesus accomplished on the cross, once for all, the eternal and perfect redemption (Heb. 9:12), and His serving ones have no participation in this matter (Lev. 6:30 and note Lev. 6:30 1 ; Heb. 13:10-11 and note Heb. 13:10 1 ). They signify, second, that the Lord who accomplished redemption was rejected by man; hence, whoever receives His redemption should go with Him outside the camp, bearing His reproach (Heb. 13:12-13 and notes).

refs.text_gb: 就是全公牛，要搬到营外洁净之地、倒灰之处，用火烧在柴上；总要在倒灰之处焚烧。
refs.text_big5: 就是全公牛，要搬到營外潔淨之地、倒灰之處，用火燒在柴上；總要在倒灰之處焚燒。
refs.text_en: That is, all the rest of the bull he shall bring out to a clean place outside the camp, where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire; where the ashes are poured out it shall be burned.

verses.text_gb: 焚烧牛羊的人要洗衣服，用水洗身，然后进营。
verses.text_big5: 焚燒牛羊的人要洗衣服，用水洗身，然後進營。
verses.text_en: And he who burns them shall wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and afterward he may come into the camp.
verses.text_gb_plain: 焚烧牛羊的人要洗衣服，用水洗身，然后进营。
verses.text_big5_plain: 焚燒牛羊的人要洗衣服，用水洗身，然後進營。

verses.text_gb: 每逢七月[Cra]初十日，你们要[Fn1]刻苦己[Fn2]心，无论是本地人，是寄居在你们中间的外人，[Fn3]什么工都不可作。这要作你们永远的定例。
verses.text_big5: 每逢七月[Cra]初十日，你們要[Fn1]刻苦己[Fn2]心，無論是本地人，是寄居在你們中間的外人，[Fn3]甚麼工都不可作。這要作你們永遠的定例。
verses.text_en: And this shall become a perpetual statute for you; in the seventh month on the tenth day of the month you shall afflict your souls and not do any work, neither the native nor the sojourner who sojourns among you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 每逢七月初十日，你们要刻苦己心，无论是本地人，是寄居在你们中间的外人，什么工都不可作。这要作你们永远的定例。
verses.text_big5_plain: 每逢七月初十日，你們要刻苦己心，無論是本地人，是寄居在你們中間的外人，甚麼工都不可作。這要作你們永遠的定例。

footnotes.zh: 这里的刻苦己心，表征为罪忧伤、痛悔、难过。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏的刻苦己心，表徵為罪憂傷、痛悔、難過。
footnotes.en: 16:29 1 afflict Here afflicting one's soul signifies mourning, repenting, and feeling sorrowful for sin.

footnotes.zh: 直译，魂。31节者同。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，魂。31節者同。
footnotes.en: 16:29 2 not The people not doing any work, for it was a Sabbath of complete rest for them (v. 31), signifies that redemption has been completely finished by Christ. There is nothing left for man to do, and man should rest in the redemption of Christ.

footnotes.zh: 百姓什么工都不可作，因为这是他们完全安息的安息日(31)，表征救赎已经完全由基督成就，没有留下什么给人作，人应当安息在基督的救赎里。
footnotes.zh_big5: 百姓甚麼工都不可作，因為這是他們完全安息的安息日，（31，）表徵救贖已經完全由基督成就，沒有留下甚麼給人作，人應當安息在基督的救贖裏。

refs.text_gb: 七月初十日是遮罪日，你们要有圣会，并要刻苦己心，也要将火祭献给耶和华。
refs.text_big5: 七月初十日是遮罪日，你們要有聖會，並要刻苦己心，也要將火祭獻給耶和華。
refs.text_en: And on the tenth day of this seventh month is the Day of Expiation; you shall have a holy convocation, and you shall afflict your souls and present an offering by fire to Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 七月初十日，你们当有圣会；要刻苦己心，什么工都不可作。
refs.text_big5: 七月初十日，你們當有聖會；要刻苦己心，甚麼工都不可作。
refs.text_en: And on the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation, and you shall afflict your souls; you shall not do any work.

verses.text_gb: 因在这日要为你们遮罪，使你们洁净；你们要在耶和华面前得以洁净，脱尽一切的罪。
verses.text_big5: 因在這日要為你們遮罪，使你們潔淨；你們要在耶和華面前得以潔淨，脫盡一切的罪。
verses.text_en: For on this day expiation shall be made for you, in order to cleanse you; from all your sins you shall be clean before Jehovah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因在这日要为你们遮罪，使你们洁净；你们要在耶和华面前得以洁净，脱尽一切的罪。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因在這日要為你們遮罪，使你們潔淨；你們要在耶和華面前得以潔淨，脫盡一切的罪。

verses.text_gb: 这日是你们完全安息的安息日，你们要刻苦己心；这要作永远的定例。
verses.text_big5: 這日是你們完全安息的安息日，你們要刻苦己心；這要作永遠的定例。
verses.text_en: It is a Sabbath of complete rest for you, and you shall afflict your souls. It shall be a perpetual statute.
verses.text_gb_plain: 这日是你们完全安息的安息日，你们要刻苦己心；这要作永远的定例。
verses.text_big5_plain: 這日是你們完全安息的安息日，你們要刻苦己心；這要作永遠的定例。

verses.text_gb: 那受膏、接续他父亲承接圣职的祭司，要穿上细麻布衣服，就是圣衣，施行遮罪。
verses.text_big5: 那受膏、接續他父親承接聖職的祭司，要穿上細麻布衣服，就是聖衣，施行遮罪。
verses.text_en: And the priest who is anointed and whose is consecrated to serve as a priest in his father's place shall make expiation; thus he shall put on the linen garments, even the holy garments.
verses.text_gb_plain: 那受膏、接续他父亲承接圣职的祭司，要穿上细麻布衣服，就是圣衣，施行遮罪。
verses.text_big5_plain: 那受膏、接續他父親承接聖職的祭司，要穿上細麻布衣服，就是聖衣，施行遮罪。

verses.text_gb: 他要为[Fn1]圣别的圣所[Cra]遮罪，为会幕和坛遮罪，并为众祭司和会众的百姓遮罪。
verses.text_big5: 他要為[Fn1]聖別的聖所[Cra]遮罪，為會幕和壇遮罪，並為眾祭司和會眾的百姓遮罪。
verses.text_en: And he shall make expiation for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make expiation for the Tent of Meeting and for the altar, and he shall make expiation for the priests and for all the people of the congregation.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他要为圣别的圣所遮罪，为会幕和坛遮罪，并为众祭司和会众的百姓遮罪。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他要為聖別的聖所遮罪，為會幕和壇遮罪，並為眾祭司和會眾的百姓遮罪。

footnotes.zh: 即至圣所
footnotes.zh_big5: 即至聖所。
footnotes.en: 16:33 1 holy I.e., the Holy of Holies.

refs.text_gb: 他要因以色列人诸般的不洁、过犯，就是他们一切的罪，为至圣所遮罪；也要为那在他们不洁之中与他们同住的会幕，照样而行。
refs.text_big5: 他要因以色列人諸般的不潔、過犯，就是他們一切的罪，為至聖所遮罪；也要為那在他們不潔之中與他們同住的會幕，照樣而行。
refs.text_en: And he shall make expiation for the Holy of Holies because of the uncleannesses of the children of Israel and because of their transgressions, for all their sins. And so he shall do for the Tent of Meeting, which dwells with them in the midst of their uncleannesses.

refs.text_gb: 他出来，要到耶和华面前的坛那里，为坛遮罪；他要取些公牛的血和公山羊的血，抹在坛周围的四角上；
refs.text_big5: 他出來，要到耶和華面前的壇那裏，為壇遮罪；他要取些公牛的血和公山羊的血，抹在壇周圍的四角上；
refs.text_en: Then he shall go out to the altar that is before Jehovah and make expiation for it, and he shall take some of the blood of the bull and some of the blood of the goat, and put it on and around the horns of the altar.

refs.text_gb: 亚伦为至圣所和会幕并坛遮罪完毕，就要把那只活着的公山羊奉上。
refs.text_big5: 亞倫為至聖所和會幕並壇遮罪完畢，就要把那隻活著的公山羊奉上。
refs.text_en: And when he has finished making expiation for the Holy of Holies and the Tent of Meeting and the altar, he shall present the live goat.

refs.text_gb: 他又照样把血洒在帐幕和一切敬拜用的器皿上。
refs.text_big5: 他又照樣把血灑在帳幕和一切敬拜用的器皿上。
refs.text_en: And both the tabernacle and all the vessels of the service he sprinkled in like manner with the blood.

verses.text_gb: 这要作你们永远的定例，就是因以色列人一切的罪，[Fn1][Cra]一年一次为他们遮罪。于是亚伦照耶和华所吩咐摩西的行了。
verses.text_big5: 這要作你們永遠的定例，就是因以色列人一切的罪，[Fn1][Cra]一年一次為他們遮罪。於是亞倫照耶和華所吩咐摩西的行了。
verses.text_en: And this shall become a perpetual statute for you, in order to make expiation for the children of Israel because of all their sins, once in the year. And just as Jehovah had commanded Moses, so he did.
verses.text_gb_plain: 这要作你们永远的定例，就是因以色列人一切的罪，一年一次为他们遮罪。于是亚伦照耶和华所吩咐摩西的行了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 這要作你們永遠的定例，就是因以色列人一切的罪，一年一次為他們遮罪。於是亞倫照耶和華所吩咐摩西的行了。

footnotes.zh: 一年一次的遮罪，表征供物不能叫人得完全，只是那‘要来美事’的影儿(来十1)，直等到神的儿子来到，才完成完满的救赎(来九1～十18)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 一年一次的遮罪，表徵供物不能叫人得完全，只是那“要來美事”的影兒，（來十1，）直等到神的兒子來到，纔完成完滿的救贖。（來九1～十18。）
footnotes.en: 16:34 1 once The making of expiation once a year signifies that the offering was unable to make man perfect and that it was only a shadow of the “good things to come” (Heb. 10:1), until the Son of God would come to complete the full redemption (Heb. 9:1-28; 10:1-18).

refs.text_gb: 亚伦一年一次，要在坛的四角上为坛遮罪；他一年一次，要用遮罪之赎罪祭的血，为坛遮罪，作为世世代代的定例。这坛在耶和华面前乃为至圣。
refs.text_big5: 亞倫一年一次，要在壇的四角上為壇遮罪；他一年一次，要用遮罪之贖罪祭的血，為壇遮罪，作為世世代代的定例。這壇在耶和華面前乃為至聖。
refs.text_en: And Aaron shall make expiation on its horns once a year; with the blood of the sin offering of expiation once a year he shall make expiation for it throughout your generations. It is most holy to Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 至于第二层帐幕，只有大祭司一年一次独自进去，没有不带着血，为自己和百姓误犯的罪献上的；
refs.text_big5: 至於第二層帳幕，只有大祭司一年一次獨自進去，沒有不帶著血，為自己和百姓誤犯的罪獻上的；
refs.text_en: But into the second, only the high priest enters, once a year and not without blood, which he offers for himself and for the sins of ignorance of the people,

refs.text_gb: 但那些祭物使人每年想起罪来；
refs.text_big5: 但那些祭物使人每年想起罪來；
refs.text_en: But in those sacrifices there is a bringing to mind of sins year by year;

verses.text_gb: 耶和华对摩西说，
verses.text_big5: 耶和華對摩西說，
verses.text_en: Then Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华对摩西说，
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華對摩西說，

verses.text_gb: 你要对亚伦和他儿子们并以色列众人说，耶和华所吩咐的乃是这样：
verses.text_big5: 你要對亞倫和他兒子們並以色列眾人說，耶和華所吩咐的乃是這樣：
verses.text_en: Speak to Aaron and to his sons and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, This is what Jehovah has commanded, saying,
verses.text_gb_plain: 你要对亚伦和他儿子们并以色列众人说，耶和华所吩咐的乃是这样：
verses.text_big5_plain: 你要對亞倫和他兒子們並以色列眾人說，耶和華所吩咐的乃是這樣：

verses.text_gb: 凡以色列家中的人，不拘是在营内或在营外宰公牛、绵羊或山羊，
verses.text_big5: 凡以色列家中的人，不拘是在營內或在營外宰公牛、綿羊或山羊，
verses.text_en: Anyone of the house of Israel who slaughters an ox or a sheep or a goat within the camp, or who slaughters it outside the camp,
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡以色列家中的人，不拘是在营内或在营外宰公牛、绵羊或山羊，
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡以色列家中的人，不拘是在營內或在營外宰公牛、綿羊或山羊，

verses.text_gb: 若未曾[Cra]牵到[Fn1]会幕门口，在耶和华的帐幕前献给耶和华为供物，流血的罪必算在那人身上。他流了血，就要[Fn2]从民中剪除。
verses.text_big5: 若未曾[Cra]牽到[Fn1]會幕門口，在耶和華的帳幕前獻給耶和華為供物，流血的罪必算在那人身上。他流了血，就要[Fn2]從民中剪除。
verses.text_en: And has not brought it to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting to present it as an offering to Jehovah before the tabernacle of Jehovah, that man shall be accounted as guilty of bloodshed. He has shed blood, and that man shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.text_gb_plain: 若未曾牵到会幕门口，在耶和华的帐幕前献给耶和华为供物，流血的罪必算在那人身上。他流了血，就要从民中剪除。
verses.text_big5_plain: 若未曾牽到會幕門口，在耶和華的帳幕前獻給耶和華為供物，流血的罪必算在那人身上。他流了血，就要從民中剪除。

footnotes.zh: 按照3～9节，献给神的祭牲只能在会幕门口，在耶和华面前献，祭牲的血要流在坛上。这表征我们应用主耶稣作我们献给神的祭物，并有分于祂救赎的血，必须是在神地上居所(召会)的入口，也必须经过十字架。我们敬拜神的时候，该照着神的愿望和经纶，在神所立的规则、约束和限制之下，应用基督作惟一的祭物。在召会之外，就是在我们所喜好和拣选的地方(参申十二5～6)应用基督，乃是滥用基督。
footnotes.zh_big5: 按照3～9節，獻給神的祭牲只能在會幕門口，在耶和華面前獻，祭牲的血要流在壇上。這表徵我們應用主耶穌作我們獻給神的祭物，並有分於祂救贖的血，必須是在神地上居所（召會）的入口，也必須經過十字架。我們敬拜神的時候，該照著神的願望和經綸，在神所立的規則、約束和限制之下，應用基督作惟一的祭物。在召會之外，就是在我們所喜好和揀選的地方（參申十二5～6）應用基督，乃是濫用基督。
footnotes.en: 17:4 1 entrance According to vv. 3-9, the sacrifices were to be offered to God only at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting before Jehovah, and their blood was to be shed on the altar. This signifies that our applying the Lord Jesus as our sacrifices offered to God and our participating in His redeeming blood must be at the entrance of God's dwelling place (the church) on earth and must be through the cross. In our worship of God, Christ as the unique sacrifice should be applied according to God's desire and economy, within the regulations, restrictions, and limitations set by Him. To apply Christ outside the church, i.e., in a place according to our preference and choice (cf. Deut. 12:5-6), is to abuse Christ.

footnotes.zh: 从民中剪除(4，9～10，14)，表征从神子民的交通中挪开(参林前五13)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 從民中剪除，（4，9～10，14，）表徵從神子民的交通中挪開。（參林前五13。）
footnotes.en: 17:4 2 cut To be cut off from one's people (vv. 4, 9-10, 14) signifies to be removed from the fellowship of God's people (cf. 1 Cor. 5:13).

refs.text_gb: 若不带到会幕门口献给耶和华，那人必从民中剪除。
refs.text_big5: 若不帶到會幕門口獻給耶和華，那人必從民中剪除。
refs.text_en: And does not bring it to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to Jehovah, that man shall be cut off from his people.

refs.text_gb: 但耶和华你们的神从你们各支派中，所选择出来立祂名的地方，就是祂的居所，那是你们当寻求的，你们要往那里去，
refs.text_big5: 但耶和華你們的神從你們各支派中，所選擇出來立祂名的地方，就是祂的居所，那是你們當尋求的，你們要往那裏去，
refs.text_en: But to the place which Jehovah your God will choose out of all your tribes to put His name, to His habitation, shall you seek, and there shall you go.

refs.text_gb: 将你们的燔祭和别的祭，十分取一之物，和手中的举祭，并还愿祭、甘心祭，以及牛群羊群中头生的，都奉到那里；
refs.text_big5: 將你們的燔祭和別的祭，十分取一之物，和手中的舉祭，並還願祭、甘心祭，以及牛群羊群中頭生的，都奉到那裏；
refs.text_en: And there you shall bring your burnt offerings and your sacrifices and your tithes and the heave offering of your hand and your vows and your freewill offerings and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock;

refs.text_gb: 他的供物若以牛为燔祭，就要献一只没有残疾的公牛；他要在会幕门口把公牛献上，使他可以在耶和华面前蒙悦纳。
refs.text_big5: 他的供物若以牛為燔祭，就要獻一隻沒有殘疾的公牛；他要在會幕門口把公牛獻上，使他可以在耶和華面前蒙悅納。
refs.text_en: If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall present it, a male without blemish; he shall present it at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, that he may be accepted before Jehovah.

verses.text_gb: 这是要使以色列人把他们在田野里所献的祭牲带到会幕门口、耶和华面前，交给祭司，献与耶和华为[Fn1][Cra]平安祭。
verses.text_big5: 這是要使以色列人把他們在田野裏所獻的祭牲帶到會幕門口、耶和華面前，交給祭司，獻與耶和華為[Fn1][Cra]平安祭。
verses.text_en: This is so that the children of Israel will bring their sacrifices which they sacrifice in the open field, that they will bring them to Jehovah at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting to the priest and sacrifice them as sacrifices of peace offerings to Jehovah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 这是要使以色列人把他们在田野里所献的祭牲带到会幕门口、耶和华面前，交给祭司，献与耶和华为平安祭。
verses.text_big5_plain: 這是要使以色列人把他們在田野裏所獻的祭牲帶到會幕門口、耶和華面前，交給祭司，獻與耶和華為平安祭。

footnotes.zh: 十六章的遮罪与五种基本祭中的四种有关：赎罪祭、赎愆祭(含示于赎罪祭—五6)、燔祭和素祭。这些祭产生平安祭，结果叫神的子民享受与神并彼此之间的平安。见七37注2。
footnotes.zh_big5: 十六章的遮罪與五種基本祭中的四種有關：贖罪祭、贖愆祭（含示於贖罪祭—五6、）燔祭和素祭。這些祭產生平安祭，結果叫神的子民享受與神並彼此之間的平安。見七37註2。
footnotes.en: 17:5 1 peace The expiation in ch. 16 involved four of the five basic offerings: the sin offering, the trespass offering (implied in the sin offering — Lev. 5:6), the burnt offering, and the meal offering. The issue of these offerings is the peace offering, with the result that God's people enjoy peace with God and with one another. See note Lev. 7:37 2 .

refs.text_gb: 人献供物为平安祭，若是从牛群中献的，无论是公是母，必用没有残疾的献在耶和华面前。
refs.text_big5: 人獻供物為平安祭，若是從牛群中獻的，無論是公是母，必用沒有殘疾的獻在耶和華面前。
refs.text_en: And if his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings, if he presents it from the herd, whether male or female, he shall present it without blemish before Jehovah.

verses.text_gb: 祭司要[Fn1][Cra]把血洒在会幕门口、耶和华的坛上，把脂油焚烧，献给耶和华为怡爽的香气。
verses.text_big5: 祭司要[Fn1][Cra]把血灑在會幕門口、耶和華的壇上，把脂油焚燒，獻給耶和華為怡爽的香氣。
verses.text_en: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood on the altar of Jehovah at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting and burn the fat for a satisfying fragrance to Jehovah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 祭司要把血洒在会幕门口、耶和华的坛上，把脂油焚烧，献给耶和华为怡爽的香气。
verses.text_big5_plain: 祭司要把血灑在會幕門口、耶和華的壇上，把脂油焚燒，獻給耶和華為怡爽的香氣。

footnotes.zh: 把血洒在坛上，表征基督在十字架上流血。把脂油焚烧，献给耶和华为怡爽的香气，表征基督的优越，借着神圣别的火献给神，作为香气满足神。
footnotes.en: 17:6 1 sprinkle The sprinkling of the blood on the altar signifies that Christ's blood was shed on the cross. Burning the fat for a satisfying fragrance to Jehovah signifies that Christ's excellencies are offered up to God through God's holy fire for a fragrance to satisfy God.

refs.text_gb: 他要按手在供物的头上，宰于会幕门口；亚伦子孙作祭司的，要把血洒在坛的四边。
refs.text_big5: 他要按手在供物的頭上，宰於會幕門口；亞倫子孫作祭司的，要把血灑在壇的四邊。
refs.text_en: And he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering and slaughter it at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, and Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood on and around the altar.

refs.text_gb: 那人要从平安祭的祭牲中，将火祭献给耶和华。盖脏的脂油和脏上所有的脂油，
refs.text_big5: 那人要從平安祭的祭牲中，將火祭獻給耶和華。蓋臟的脂油和臟上所有的脂油，
refs.text_en: And from the sacrifice of peace offerings he shall present an offering by fire to Jehovah, the fat that covers the inward parts and all the fat that is on the inward parts,

refs.text_gb: 并两个腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰两旁的脂油，与肝上连着腰子的网子，都要取下。
refs.text_big5: 並兩個腰子和腰子上的脂油，就是靠腰兩旁的脂油，與肝上連著腰子的網子，都要取下。
refs.text_en: And the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, which is on the loins; and the appendage on the liver, which he shall remove with the kidneys.

refs.text_gb: 亚伦的子孙要把这些烧在坛的燔祭上，在火的柴上，是献与耶和华为怡爽香气的火祭。
refs.text_big5: 亞倫的子孫要把這些燒在壇的燔祭上，在火的柴上，是獻與耶和華為怡爽香氣的火祭。
refs.text_en: And Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire; it is an offering by fire, a satisfying fragrance to Jehovah.

verses.text_gb: 他们[Fn1]不可再献[Cra]祭牲给他们[Fn2]行邪淫所随从的山羊鬼；这要作他们世世代代永远的定例。
verses.text_big5: 他們[Fn1]不可再獻[Cra]祭牲給他們[Fn2]行邪淫所隨從的山羊鬼；這要作他們世世代代永遠的定例。
verses.text_en: And they shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices to the goat demons, to whom they prostitute themselves. This shall become a perpetual statute for them throughout their generations.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们不可再献祭牲给他们行邪淫所随从的山羊鬼；这要作他们世世代代永远的定例。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們不可再獻祭牲給他們行邪淫所隨從的山羊鬼；這要作他們世世代代永遠的定例。

footnotes.zh: 不再献祭牲给山羊鬼，表征不再与鬼有交通，而犯属灵的淫乱(林前十20～21)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 不再獻祭牲給山羊鬼，表徵不再與鬼有交通，而犯屬靈的淫亂。（林前十20～21。）
footnotes.en: 17:7 1 no No longer sacrificing to goat demons signifies no longer having fellowship with demons so as to commit spiritual fornication (1 Cor. 10:20-21).

footnotes.zh: 这里的‘行邪淫’指明，以色列人(信徒)在自己所拣选的地方(召会之外)，将祭牲(基督)献上，滥用了祭牲，就使自己成了行邪淫的。这是属灵的邪淫、属灵的淫乱。见4注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這裏的“行邪淫”指明，以色列人（信徒）在自己所揀選的地方（召會之外，）將祭牲（基督）獻上，濫用了祭牲，就使自己成了行邪淫的。這是屬靈的邪淫、屬靈的淫亂。見4註1。
footnotes.en: 17:7 2 prostitute The word prostitute here indicates that for an Israelite (a believer) to abuse the sacrifices (Christ) by offering them in the place of his choice (outside the church) was to make himself a prostitute. This is a matter of spiritual prostitution, of spiritual fornication. See note Lev. 17:4 1 .

refs.text_gb: 他们献祭给鬼魔，给那不是神的，给素不认识的神，给那近来新兴的，是你们列祖所不畏惧的。
refs.text_big5: 他們獻祭給鬼魔，給那不是神的，給素不認識的神，給那近來新興的，是你們列祖所不畏懼的。
refs.text_en: They sacrificed to demons, to those who were no god, / To gods they did not know, / To new ones who had recently come up, / Before whom your fathers had not shuddered.

refs.text_gb: 耶罗波安为邱坛、山羊、并他所铸造的牛犊，自行设立祭司。
refs.text_big5: 耶羅波安為邱壇、山羊、並他所鑄造的牛犢，自行設立祭司。
refs.text_en: And he appointed priests for himself for the high places and for the goats and the calves that he had made.

refs.text_gb: 他们又把自己的儿女献给鬼魔为祭物，
refs.text_big5: 他們又把自己的兒女獻給鬼魔為祭物，
refs.text_en: They also sacrificed their sons / And their daughters to demons,

refs.text_gb: 我乃是说，外邦人所献的祭，是祭鬼，不是祭神；我不愿意你们成为与鬼交通的人。
refs.text_big5: 我乃是說，外邦人所獻的祭，是祭鬼，不是祭神；我不願意你們成為與鬼交通的人。
refs.text_en: No, but that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God; and I do not want you to become those who have fellowship with demons.

refs.text_gb: 其余未被这些灾害所杀的人，仍旧不悔改自己手所作的，还是去拜鬼，和那些不能看、不能听、不能走，金、银、铜、石、木的偶像；
refs.text_big5: 其餘未被這些災害所殺的人，仍舊不悔改自己手所作的，還是去拜鬼，和那些不能看、不能聽、不能走，金、銀、銅、石、木的偶像；
refs.text_en: And the rest of the men, who were not killed by these plagues, still did not repent of the works of their hands, so as not to worship the demons and the idols of gold and silver and brass and stone and wood, which can neither see nor hear nor walk;

verses.text_gb: 你要对他们说，凡以色列家中的人，或是寄居在他们中间的外人，献燔祭或平安祭，
verses.text_big5: 你要對他們說，凡以色列家中的人，或是寄居在他們中間的外人，獻燔祭或平安祭，
verses.text_en: And you shall say to them, Anyone of the house of Israel or of the sojourners who sojourn among them, who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice
verses.text_gb_plain: 你要对他们说，凡以色列家中的人，或是寄居在他们中间的外人，献燔祭或平安祭，
verses.text_big5_plain: 你要對他們說，凡以色列家中的人，或是寄居在他們中間的外人，獻燔祭或平安祭，

verses.text_gb: 若不[Cra]带到会幕门口献给耶和华，那人必从民中剪除。
verses.text_big5: 若不[Cra]帶到會幕門口獻給耶和華，那人必從民中剪除。
verses.text_en: And does not bring it to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to Jehovah, that man shall be cut off from his people.
verses.text_gb_plain: 若不带到会幕门口献给耶和华，那人必从民中剪除。
verses.text_big5_plain: 若不帶到會幕門口獻給耶和華，那人必從民中剪除。

refs.text_gb: 若未曾牵到会幕门口，在耶和华的帐幕前献给耶和华为供物，流血的罪必算在那人身上。他流了血，就要从民中剪除。
refs.text_big5: 若未曾牽到會幕門口，在耶和華的帳幕前獻給耶和華為供物，流血的罪必算在那人身上。他流了血，就要從民中剪除。
refs.text_en: And has not brought it to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting to present it as an offering to Jehovah before the tabernacle of Jehovah, that man shall be accounted as guilty of bloodshed. He has shed blood, and that man shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.text_gb: 凡以色列家中的人，或是寄居在他们中间的外人，若吃了什么[Fn1][Cra]血，我必向那吃血的人变脸，把他从民中剪除。
verses.text_big5: 凡以色列家中的人，或是寄居在他們中間的外人，若喫了甚麼[Fn1][Cra]血，我必向那喫血的人變臉，把他從民中剪除。
verses.text_en: And anyone of the house of Israel or of the sojourners who sojourn among them, who eats any blood, I will set My face against that person who eats blood and cut him off from among his people.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡以色列家中的人，或是寄居在他们中间的外人，若吃了什么血，我必向那吃血的人变脸，把他从民中剪除。
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡以色列家中的人，或是寄居在他們中間的外人，若喫了甚麼血，我必向那喫血的人變臉，把他從民中剪除。

footnotes.zh: 关于不吃血(10，12)，见三17注1。
footnotes.en: 17:10 1 blood On not eating blood (vv. 10, 12), see note Lev. 3:17 1 .

refs.text_gb: 在你们一切的住处，脂油和血都不可吃；这要作你们世世代代永远的定例。
refs.text_big5: 在你們一切的住處，脂油和血都不可喫；這要作你們世世代代永遠的定例。
refs.text_en: It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwelling places that you shall not eat any fat or any blood.

verses.text_gb: 因为[Fn1]活物的[Fn2][Cra]生命是在血中；我已经把血赐给你们，可以在坛上为你们的生命遮罪；因[Crb]血里有生命，所以能遮罪。
verses.text_big5: 因為[Fn1]活物的[Fn2][Cra]生命是在血中；我已經把血賜給你們，可以在壇上為你們的生命遮罪；因[Crb]血裏有生命，所以能遮罪。
verses.text_en: For the life of the flesh is in the blood; and I have given it to you to make expiation for your souls on the altar, for it is the blood, by reason of the life, that makes expiation.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为活物的生命是在血中；我已经把血赐给你们，可以在坛上为你们的生命遮罪；因血里有生命，所以能遮罪。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為活物的生命是在血中；我已經把血賜給你們，可以在壇上為你們的生命遮罪；因血裏有生命，所以能遮罪。

footnotes.zh: 直译，肉体。14节者同。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，肉體。14節者同。

footnotes.zh: 或，魂。14节者同。

refs.text_gb: 论到一切活物的生命，它的血就是它的生命；所以我对以色列人说，无论什么活物的血，你们都不可吃，因为一切活物的生命是在血中；凡吃了血的，必被剪除。
refs.text_big5: 論到一切活物的生命，牠的血就是牠的生命；所以我對以色列人說，無論甚麼活物的血，你們都不可喫，因為一切活物的生命是在血中；凡喫了血的，必被剪除。
refs.text_en: For as to the life of all flesh, its blood is its very life; therefore I have said to the children of Israel, You shall not eat the blood of any flesh, for the life of all flesh is its blood; whoever eats it shall be cut off.

refs.text_gb: 只是你要心意坚定不吃血，因为血是生命；不可将生命与肉同吃。
refs.text_big5: 只是你要心意堅定不喫血，因為血是生命；不可將生命與肉同喫。
refs.text_en: But make sure that you do not eat the blood; for the blood is the life, and you shall not eat the life with the flesh.

refs.text_gb: 按着律法，凡物差不多都是用血洁净的，没有流血，就没有赦罪。
refs.text_big5: 按著律法，凡物差不多都是用血潔淨的，沒有流血，就沒有赦罪。
refs.text_en: And almost all things are purified by blood according to the law, and without shedding of blood there is no forgiveness.

verses.text_gb: 因此，我对以色列人说，你们中间什么人都不可吃[Cra]血；寄居在你们中间的外人也不可吃血。
verses.text_big5: 因此，我對以色列人說，你們中間甚麼人都不可喫[Cra]血；寄居在你們中間的外人也不可喫血。
verses.text_en: Therefore I said to the children of Israel, No person among you shall eat blood, nor shall any sojourner who sojourns among you eat blood.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因此，我对以色列人说，你们中间什么人都不可吃血；寄居在你们中间的外人也不可吃血。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因此，我對以色列人說，你們中間甚麼人都不可喫血；寄居在你們中間的外人也不可喫血。

refs.text_gb: 唯独肉带着生命，就是带着血，你们不可吃。
refs.text_big5: 惟獨肉帶著生命，就是帶著血，你們不可喫。
refs.text_en: But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat.

refs.text_gb: 在你们一切的住处，脂油和血都不可吃；这要作你们世世代代永远的定例。
refs.text_big5: 在你們一切的住處，脂油和血都不可喫；這要作你們世世代代永遠的定例。
refs.text_en: It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwelling places that you shall not eat any fat or any blood.

refs.text_gb: 论到一切活物的生命，它的血就是它的生命；所以我对以色列人说，无论什么活物的血，你们都不可吃，因为一切活物的生命是在血中；凡吃了血的，必被剪除。
refs.text_big5: 論到一切活物的生命，牠的血就是牠的生命；所以我對以色列人說，無論甚麼活物的血，你們都不可喫，因為一切活物的生命是在血中；凡喫了血的，必被剪除。
refs.text_en: For as to the life of all flesh, its blood is its very life; therefore I have said to the children of Israel, You shall not eat the blood of any flesh, for the life of all flesh is its blood; whoever eats it shall be cut off.

refs.text_gb: 只是不可吃血，要倒在地上，如同倒水一样。
refs.text_big5: 只是不可喫血，要倒在地上，如同倒水一樣。
refs.text_en: However, you shall not eat the blood; you shall pour it out upon the earth like water.

refs.text_gb: 只是你要心意坚定不吃血，因为血是生命；不可将生命与肉同吃。
refs.text_big5: 只是你要心意堅定不喫血，因為血是生命；不可將生命與肉同喫。
refs.text_en: But make sure that you do not eat the blood; for the blood is the life, and you shall not eat the life with the flesh.

refs.text_gb: 不可吃血，要倒在地上，如同倒水一样。
refs.text_big5: 不可喫血，要倒在地上，如同倒水一樣。
refs.text_en: You shall not eat it; you shall pour it out upon the earth like water.

refs.text_gb: 你不可吃血，使你和你的子孙可以得福，因为你行了耶和华眼中看为正的事。
refs.text_big5: 你不可喫血，使你和你的子孫可以得福，因為你行了耶和華眼中看為正的事。
refs.text_en: You shall not eat it, so that it may go well with you and with your children after you, when you do what is right in the sight of Jehovah.

refs.text_gb: 只是不可吃它的血，要倒在地上，如同倒水一样。
refs.text_big5: 只是不可喫牠的血，要倒在地上，如同倒水一樣。
refs.text_en: However, you shall not eat its blood; you shall pour it out upon the earth like water.

verses.text_gb: 凡以色列人，或是寄居在他们中间的外人，若打猎得了可吃的禽兽，必放出它的血来，用土[Fn1]掩盖。
verses.text_big5: 凡以色列人，或是寄居在他們中間的外人，若打獵得了可喫的禽獸，必放出牠的血來，用土[Fn1]掩蓋。
verses.text_en: And anyone of the children of Israel or of the sojourners who sojourn among them, who in hunting takes an animal or bird that may be eaten, shall pour out its blood and cover it with dust.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡以色列人，或是寄居在他们中间的外人，若打猎得了可吃的禽兽，必放出它的血来，用土掩盖。
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡以色列人，或是寄居在他們中間的外人，若打獵得了可喫的禽獸，必放出牠的血來，用土掩蓋。

footnotes.zh: 这表征人在主耶稣的血之外所得到一切的血，都不能救赎我们脱离罪，应当被掩埋，意即放弃、丢弃、拒绝。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這表徵人在主耶穌的血之外所得到一切的血，都不能救贖我們脫離罪，應當被掩埋，意即放棄、丟棄、拒絕。
footnotes.en: 17:13 1 cover This signifies that all the blood that man can obtain other than the blood of the Lord Jesus cannot redeem us from our sins and should be buried, i.e., given up, abandoned, rejected.

verses.text_gb: 论到一切活物的生命，它的血[Fn1]就是它的生命；所以我对以色列人说，无论什么活物的血，你们都不可[Cra]吃，因为一切活物的生命[Fn2]是在血中；凡吃了血的，必被剪除。
verses.text_big5: 論到一切活物的生命，牠的血[Fn1]就是牠的生命；所以我對以色列人說，無論甚麼活物的血，你們都不可[Cra]喫，因為一切活物的生命[Fn2]是在血中；凡喫了血的，必被剪除。
verses.text_en: For as to the life of all flesh, its blood is its very life; therefore I have said to the children of Israel, You shall not eat the blood of any flesh, for the life of all flesh is its blood; whoever eats it shall be cut off.
verses.text_gb_plain: 论到一切活物的生命，它的血就是它的生命；所以我对以色列人说，无论什么活物的血，你们都不可吃，因为一切活物的生命是在血中；凡吃了血的，必被剪除。
verses.text_big5_plain: 論到一切活物的生命，牠的血就是牠的生命；所以我對以色列人說，無論甚麼活物的血，你們都不可喫，因為一切活物的生命是在血中；凡喫了血的，必被剪除。

footnotes.zh: 直译，带有。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，帶有。
footnotes.en: 17:14 1 its Lit., with its life.

footnotes.zh: 直译，就是它的血。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，就是牠的血。

refs.text_gb: 因为活物的生命是在血中；我已经把血赐给你们，可以在坛上为你们的生命遮罪；因血里有生命，所以能遮罪。
refs.text_big5: 因為活物的生命是在血中；我已經把血賜給你們，可以在壇上為你們的生命遮罪；因血裏有生命，所以能遮罪。
refs.text_en: For the life of the flesh is in the blood; and I have given it to you to make expiation for your souls on the altar, for it is the blood, by reason of the life, that makes expiation.

verses.text_gb: 凡吃[Fn1]自死的或[Fn2]被野兽撕裂的，无论是本地人，是寄居的，都要[Fn3][Cra]洗衣服，用水洗澡，并要[Fn4]不洁净到晚上，然后才洁净了。
verses.text_big5: 凡喫[Fn1]自死的或[Fn2]被野獸撕裂的，無論是本地人，是寄居的，都要[Fn3][Cra]洗衣服，用水洗澡，並要[Fn4]不潔淨到晚上，然後纔潔淨了。
verses.text_en: And every person who eats that which dies of itself or is torn by beasts, whether he is a native or a sojourner, shall wash his clothes and bathe in water and be unclean until the evening; then he shall be clean.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡吃自死的或被野兽撕裂的，无论是本地人，是寄居的，都要洗衣服，用水洗澡，并要不洁净到晚上，然后才洁净了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡喫自死的或被野獸撕裂的，無論是本地人，是寄居的，都要洗衣服，用水洗澡，並要不潔淨到晚上，然後纔潔淨了。

footnotes.zh: 自死之物的血，表征杀身成仁者的血，不能救赎我们脱离罪。惟有神在十字架上所压伤(赛五三10)之耶稣基督的血，才能洗净我们一切的罪(约壹一7)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 自死之物的血，表徵殺身成仁者的血，不能救贖我們脫離罪。惟有神在十字架上所壓傷（賽五三10）之耶穌基督的血，纔能洗淨我們一切的罪。（約壹一7。）
footnotes.en: 17:15 1 dies The blood of that which dies of itself signifies the blood of one who sacrifices himself for the good of others, which blood cannot redeem us from our sins. Only the blood of Jesus Christ, whom God bruised on the cross (Isa. 53:10), can cleanse us from all sin (1 John 1:7).

footnotes.zh: 被野兽撕裂之物的血，表征被如同野兽之野蛮人杀害牺牲者的血；这血也不能救赎我们脱离罪。惟有神在十字架上所审判(赛五三8)之耶稣基督的血，才能洗去我们的罪(启一5)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 被野獸撕裂之物的血，表徵被如同野獸之野蠻人殺害犧牲者的血；這血也不能救贖我們脫離罪。惟有神在十字架上所審判（賽五三8）之耶穌基督的血，纔能洗去我們的罪。（啟一5。）
footnotes.en: 17:15 2 torn The blood of that which is torn by beasts signifies the blood of one who is martyred by wild people, who are like beasts, which blood also is unable to redeem us from our sins. Only the blood of Jesus Christ, whom God judged on the cross (Isa. 53:8), is able to wash us from our sins (Rev. 1:5).

footnotes.zh: 这表征凡以别的血代替主耶稣之血的，要对付他从前的行为，和他已往与宗教有关的所是，并要洁净自己；否则他就要被定罪。 吃不同的血，相当于根据对不同人物的信仰，所形成不同的宗教。神命定惟一的血，乃是耶稣基督在十字架上所流的血(约六53～55，林前十16上，21上)；惟一的信仰乃是相信为我们死在十字架上的基督(见罗一5注4)。
footnotes.en: 17:15 3 wash This signifies that the one who takes any blood other than the blood of the Lord Jesus should deal with his former behavior and with what he was in the past concerning religion and should purge himself. Otherwise, he will be condemned. To eat different bloods is equivalent to forming different religions based on beliefs in different persons. The one blood ordained by God is the blood of Jesus Christ shed on the cross (John 6:53-55; 1 Cor. 10:16, 21a), and the one belief is the belief in the Christ who died on the cross for us (see note Rom. 1:5 3 ).

footnotes.zh: 不洁净到晚上，表征凡以别的血，就是以别的信仰，代替主耶稣之血的，必不洁净，直到把这事对付干净，完全了结。
footnotes.zh_big5: 不潔淨到晚上，表徵凡以別的血，就是以別的信仰，代替主耶穌之血的，必不潔淨，直到把這事對付乾淨，完全了結。
footnotes.en: 17:15 4 evening Being unclean until the evening signifies that the one who takes any blood, i.e., any belief, other than the blood of the Lord Jesus is unclean until the matter is cleared up and brought to a complete ending.

refs.text_gb: 凡拿了尸体任何一部分的，就要洗衣服，并且不洁净到晚上。
refs.text_big5: 凡拿了屍體任何一部分的，就要洗衣服，並且不潔淨到晚上。
refs.text_en: And whoever carries any part of their carcass shall wash his clothes and be unclean until the evening.

verses.text_gb: 他若不洗衣服，也不洗[Fn1]身，就必担当他的罪孽。
verses.text_big5: 他若不洗衣服，也不洗[Fn1]身，就必擔當他的罪孽。
verses.text_en: But if he does not wash them or bathe his body, then he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他若不洗衣服，也不洗身，就必担当他的罪孽。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他若不洗衣服，也不洗身，就必擔當他的罪孽。

footnotes.zh: 直译，肉体。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，肉體。
footnotes.en: 17:16 1 body Lit., flesh.

verses.text_big5: 耶和華[Fn1]對摩西說，
verses.text_en: Then Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华对摩西说，
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華對摩西說，

footnotes.zh: 本书十八至二十章，论到神圣别子民的圣别生活，相当于弗四17～五14吩咐神圣别的子民脱去旧人，穿上新人，过圣别的生活，像神是圣别的一样。
footnotes.zh_big5: 本書十八至二十章，論到神聖別子民的聖別生活，相當於弗四17～五14吩咐神聖別的子民脫去舊人，穿上新人，過聖別的生活，像神是聖別的一樣。
footnotes.en: 18:1 1 spoke Chapters 18—20 of this book, on the holy living of God's holy people, correspond to Eph. 4:17-32; 5:1-14, which charges the holy people of God to put off the old man and put on the new man, living a life that is holy, as God is holy.

verses.text_gb: 你要对以色列人说，我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.text_big5: 你要對以色列人說，我是耶和華你們的神。
verses.text_en: Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, I am Jehovah your God.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你要对以色列人说，我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你要對以色列人說，我是耶和華你們的神。

verses.text_gb: 你们从前住的[Fn1][Cra]埃及地，那里的人所作的，你们不可照样作；我要领你们去的[Crb]迦南地，那里的人所作的，你们也不可照样作，也不可照他们的[Fn2]风俗行。
verses.text_big5: 你們從前住的[Fn1][Cra]埃及地，那裏的人所作的，你們不可照樣作；我要領你們去的[Crb]迦南地，那裏的人所作的，你們也不可照樣作，也不可照他們的[Fn2]風俗行。
verses.text_en: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, in which you dwelt; and you shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you, nor shall you walk in their statutes.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们从前住的埃及地，那里的人所作的，你们不可照样作；我要领你们去的迦南地，那里的人所作的，你们也不可照样作，也不可照他们的风俗行。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們從前住的埃及地，那裏的人所作的，你們不可照樣作；我要領你們去的迦南地，那裏的人所作的，你們也不可照樣作，也不可照他們的風俗行。

footnotes.zh: 以色列人不可照着他们从前生活在埃及人中的那种样式生活，表征信徒应当在从前旧的生活样式上，脱去旧人(弗四22)。以色列人也不可在他们要被领进的地上，照着迦南人的样式生活，表征信徒得救后，不该模成世人生活与行为的样子(罗十二2)。以色列人照着神的圣别过一种圣别的生活(4～二十27)，表征信徒应当穿上新人，这新人是照着神，在那实际的义和圣中所创造的(弗四24)。
footnotes.en: 18:3 1 Egypt The Israelites' not living in the manner of the Egyptians, among whom they once lived, signifies that the believers should put off, as regards their former old way of living, the old man (Eph. 4:22). The Israelites' not living in the manner of the Canaanites, to whose land they were to be brought, signifies that, after being saved, the believers should not be conformed to the living and conduct of the worldly people (Rom. 12:2). The Israelites' living a holy life according to God's holiness (v. 4—20:27) signifies that the believers should put on the new man, which was created according to God in righteousness and holiness of the truth (Eph. 4:24).

footnotes.zh: 或，律例。30节者同。

refs.text_gb: 反与他们混杂相合，学习他们的行为，
refs.text_big5: 反與他們混雜相合，學習他們的行為，
refs.text_en: But they mingled themselves with the nations / And learned their practices.

refs.text_gb: 我对他们说，你们各人要抛弃眼中所喜爱那些可憎之物，不可因埃及的偶像玷污自己；我是耶和华你们的神。
refs.text_big5: 我對他們說，你們各人要拋棄眼中所喜愛那些可憎之物，不可因埃及的偶像玷污自己；我是耶和華你們的神。
refs.text_en: And I said to them, Cast away, each of you, the detestable things of your eyes, and do not defile yourselves with the idols of Egypt; I am Jehovah your God.

refs.text_gb: 他们却悖逆我，不肯听从我；各人不抛弃眼中所喜爱那些可憎之物，也不离弃埃及的偶像。我就说，我要将我的忿怒倾倒在他们身上，在埃及地向他们发尽我的怒气。
refs.text_big5: 他們卻悖逆我，不肯聽從我；各人不拋棄眼中所喜愛那些可憎之物，也不離棄埃及的偶像。我就說，我要將我的忿怒傾倒在他們身上，在埃及地向他們發盡我的怒氣。
refs.text_en: But they rebelled against Me and were not willing to listen to Me; they did not, each one, cast away the detestable things of their eyes, nor did they forsake the idols of Egypt. Thus I thought to pour out My wrath upon them and to spend My anger on them in the midst of the land of Egypt.

refs.text_gb: 他们的神像，你不可跪拜，不可事奉，也不可效法他们所作的；却要把神像尽行拆毁，把他们的柱像打碎。
refs.text_big5: 他們的神像，你不可跪拜，不可事奉，也不可效法他們所作的；卻要把神像盡行拆毀，把他們的柱像打碎。
refs.text_en: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do according to their works; but you shall utterly overthrow them and break their pillars into pieces.

refs.text_gb: 我在你们面前所逐出的国民，你们不可随从他们的风俗；因为他们行了这一切的事，所以我厌恶他们。
refs.text_big5: 我在你們面前所逐出的國民，你們不可隨從他們的風俗；因為他們行了這一切的事，所以我厭惡他們。
refs.text_en: And you shall not walk in the customs of the nation, which I am about to send away before you. Because they did all these things, so I abhorred them.

verses.text_gb: 你们要遵行我的[Fn1]典章，谨守我的律例，按此而行；我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.text_big5: 你們要遵行我的[Fn1]典章，謹守我的律例，按此而行；我是耶和華你們的神。
verses.text_en: You shall observe My ordinances, and you shall keep My statutes to walk in them; I am Jehovah your God.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们要遵行我的典章，谨守我的律例，按此而行；我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們要遵行我的典章，謹守我的律例，按此而行；我是耶和華你們的神。

refs.text_en: And I gave them My statutes and made known to them My ordinances, by which, if a man does them, he will live.

refs.text_gb: 以色列家却在旷野悖逆我，不遵行我的律例，弃绝我的典章；（人若遵行这些，就必因这些活着；）他们大大渎犯我的安息日。我就说，我要在旷野将我的忿怒倾倒在他们身上，灭绝他们。
refs.text_big5: 以色列家卻在曠野悖逆我，不遵行我的律例，棄絕我的典章；（人若遵行這些，就必因這些活著；）他們大大瀆犯我的安息日。我就說，我要在曠野將我的忿怒傾倒在他們身上，滅絕他們。
refs.text_en: But the house of Israel rebelled against Me in the wilderness; they did not walk in My statutes, and they rejected My ordinances, by which, if a man does them, he will live; and they greatly profaned My Sabbaths. Then I thought to pour out My wrath upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.

refs.text_gb: 只是他们的儿女悖逆我，不遵行我的律例，也不谨守遵行我的典章；（人若遵行这些，就必因这些活着；）他们渎犯我的安息日。我就说，我要将我的忿怒倾倒在他们身上，在旷野向他们发尽我的怒气。
refs.text_big5: 只是他們的兒女悖逆我，不遵行我的律例，也不謹守遵行我的典章；（人若遵行這些，就必因這些活著；）他們瀆犯我的安息日。我就說，我要將我的忿怒傾倒在他們身上，在曠野向他們發盡我的怒氣。
refs.text_en: But the children rebelled against Me; they did not walk in My statutes and they were not careful to do My ordinances, by which, if a man does them, he will live; they profaned My Sabbaths. Then I thought to pour out My wrath upon them to spend My anger on them in the wilderness.

refs.text_gb: 你警戒他们，要使他们归服你的律法；他们却行事狂傲，不听从你的诫命，干犯你的典章，（人若行这些，必因这些活着，）扭转肩头，硬着颈项，不肯听从。
refs.text_big5: 你警戒他們，要使他們歸服你的律法；他們卻行事狂傲，不聽從你的誡命，干犯你的典章，（人若行這些，必因這些活著，）扭轉肩頭，硬著頸項，不肯聽從。
refs.text_en: And You testified against them in order to turn them back to Your law, / But they acted arrogantly and would not listen to Your commandments; / And they sinned against Your ordinances / (By which, if a man does them, he will live), / And they turned a stubborn shoulder / And stiffened their neck and would not listen.

refs.text_gb: 论到那本于律法的义，摩西写着：“行这些事的，必因这些事活着。”
refs.text_big5: 論到那本於律法的義，摩西寫著：“行這些事的，必因這些事活著。”
refs.text_en: For Moses writes concerning the righteousness which is out of the law: "The man who does them shall live by them."

refs.text_gb: 但律法不是本于信，只说，“行这些事的，必因这些事活着。”
refs.text_big5: 但律法不是本於信，只說，“行這些事的，必因這些事活著。”
refs.text_en: But the law is not of faith, yet, "He who does them shall live because of them."

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他说，你为什么以善问我？只有一位是善的。你若要进入生命，就要遵守诫命。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他說，你為甚麼以善問我？只有一位是善的。你若要進入生命，就要遵守誡命。
refs.text_en: And He said to him, Why do you ask Me concerning what is good? There is only One who is good. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣说，你答得对，你这样行，就必得着生命。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌說，你答得對，你這樣行，就必得著生命。
refs.text_en: And He said to him, You have answered correctly; do this, and you shall have life.

verses.text_gb: 你们什么人都不可亲近[Fn1][Cra]骨肉之亲，露他们的下体；我是耶和华。
verses.text_big5: 你們甚麼人都不可親近[Fn1][Cra]骨肉之親，露他們的下體；我是耶和華。
verses.text_en: None of you shall approach to any of his close relatives to uncover their nakedness; I am Jehovah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们什么人都不可亲近骨肉之亲，露他们的下体；我是耶和华。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們甚麼人都不可親近骨肉之親，露他們的下體；我是耶和華。

footnotes.zh: 直译，肉中的肉。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，肉中的肉。
footnotes.en: 18:6 1 his Lit., flesh of his flesh.

refs.text_gb: 与父亲妻子行淫的，就是揭露了他父亲的下体，他们二人必要被处死，流他们血的罪要归到他们身上。
refs.text_big5: 與父親妻子行淫的，就是揭露了他父親的下體，他們二人必要被處死，流他們血的罪要歸到他們身上。
refs.text_en: If there is a man who lies with his father's wife, he has uncovered his father's nakedness. Both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

refs.text_gb: 与儿媳同寝的，他们二人必要被处死；他们行了乱伦的事，流他们血的罪要归到他们身上。
refs.text_big5: 與兒媳同寢的，他們二人必要被處死；他們行了亂倫的事，流他們血的罪要歸到他們身上。
refs.text_en: If there is a man who lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death. They have brought about confusion; their blood shall be upon them.

refs.text_gb: 人若与男人苟合，像与女人一样，他们二人行了可憎的事，必要被处死，流他们血的罪要归到他们身上。
refs.text_big5: 人若與男人苟合，像與女人一樣，他們二人行了可憎的事，必要被處死，流他們血的罪要歸到他們身上。
refs.text_en: If there is a man who lies with a male as with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination. They shall surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.

refs.text_gb: 人若娶妻，又娶其母，便是大恶，这三人要用火焚烧，使你们中间免去大恶。
refs.text_big5: 人若娶妻，又娶其母，便是大惡，這三人要用火焚燒，使你們中間免去大惡。
refs.text_en: If there is a man who takes a wife and her mother, it is wickedness. They shall be burnt with fire, both he and they, that there be no wickedness among you.

refs.text_gb: 人若与兽淫合，必要被处死；你们也要把那兽杀死。
refs.text_big5: 人若與獸淫合，必要被處死；你們也要把那獸殺死。
refs.text_en: If there is a man who lies with a beast, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall slaughter the beast.

refs.text_gb: 女人若与兽亲近，与它淫合，你要把那女人和那兽杀死；他们必要被处死，流他们血的罪要归到他们身上。
refs.text_big5: 女人若與獸親近，與牠淫合，你要把那女人和那獸殺死；他們必要被處死，流他們血的罪要歸到他們身上。
refs.text_en: If there is a woman who approaches any beast to lie down with it, you shall kill the woman and the beast. They shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

refs.text_gb: 人若娶他的姊妹，无论是异母同父的，或是异父同母的，彼此见了对方的下体，这是可耻的事；他们必在本民的眼前被剪除。他揭露了他姊妹的下体，必担当自己的罪孽。
refs.text_big5: 人若娶他的姊妹，無論是異母同父的，或是異父同母的，彼此見了對方的下體，這是可恥的事；他們必在本民的眼前被剪除。他揭露了他姊妹的下體，必擔當自己的罪孽。
refs.text_en: If there is a man who takes his sister, his father's daughter or his mother's daughter, and he sees her nakedness and she sees his nakedness, it is a reproach, and they shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people. He has uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.

refs.text_gb: 妇人有月经，人若与她同寝，揭露了她的下体，就是显露了妇人的血源，妇人也揭露了自己的血源；二人必从民中剪除。
refs.text_big5: 婦人有月經，人若與她同寢，揭露了她的下體，就是顯露了婦人的血源，婦人也揭露了自己的血源；二人必從民中剪除。
refs.text_en: If there is a man who lies with a woman having her sickness, and he uncovers her nakedness, he has laid bare her flow, and she has uncovered the flow of her blood; and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

refs.text_gb: 不可揭露姨母或姑母的下体，这是显露了骨肉之亲的下体；二人必担当自己的罪孽。
refs.text_big5: 不可揭露姨母或姑母的下體，這是顯露了骨肉之親的下體；二人必擔當自己的罪孽。
refs.text_en: And you shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother's sister nor of your father's sister, for he has made naked his flesh; they shall bear their iniquity.

refs.text_gb: 人若与伯叔的妻子同寝，就是揭露了他伯叔的下体；二人要担当自己的罪，必无子女而死。
refs.text_big5: 人若與伯叔的妻子同寢，就是揭露了他伯叔的下體；二人要擔當自己的罪，必無子女而死。
refs.text_en: If there is a man who lies with his aunt, he has uncovered his uncle's nakedness. They shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.

refs.text_gb: 人若娶他兄弟的妻子，这本是污秽的事；他是揭露了他兄弟的下体；二人必无子女。
refs.text_big5: 人若娶他兄弟的妻子，這本是污穢的事；他是揭露了他兄弟的下體；二人必無子女。
refs.text_en: If there is a man who takes his brother's wife, it is impurity. He has uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.

verses.text_gb: 不可露你母亲的下体，这本是你父亲的下体；她是你的母亲，不可露她的下体。
verses.text_big5: 不可露你母親的下體，這本是你父親的下體；她是你的母親，不可露她的下體。
verses.text_en: The nakedness of your father, that is, the nakedness of your mother, you shall not uncover. She is your mother; you shall not uncover her nakedness.
verses.text_gb_plain: 不可露你母亲的下体，这本是你父亲的下体；她是你的母亲，不可露她的下体。
verses.text_big5_plain: 不可露你母親的下體，這本是你父親的下體；她是你的母親，不可露她的下體。

verses.text_gb: 不可露你[Cra]父亲妻子的下体，这本是你父亲的下体。
verses.text_big5: 不可露你[Cra]父親妻子的下體，這本是你父親的下體。
verses.text_en: The nakedness of your father's wife you shall not uncover; it is your father's nakedness.
verses.text_gb_plain: 不可露你父亲妻子的下体，这本是你父亲的下体。
verses.text_big5_plain: 不可露你父親妻子的下體，這本是你父親的下體。

refs.text_gb: 人不可娶父亲的妻子，以致掀开他父亲的衣边。
refs.text_big5: 人不可娶父親的妻子，以致掀開他父親的衣邊。
refs.text_en: A man shall not take his father's wife, so that he does not uncover the skirt of his father's garment.

refs.text_gb: 与父亲的妻子行淫的，必受咒诅，因为掀开他父亲的衣边。百姓都要说，阿们。
refs.text_big5: 與父親的妻子行淫的，必受咒詛，因為掀開他父親的衣邊。百姓都要說，阿們。
refs.text_en: Cursed is he who lies with his father's wife, for he uncovers the skirt of his father's garment. And all the people shall say, Amen.

refs.text_gb: 确实听说在你们中间有淫乱的事，这样的淫乱，连外邦人中也没有，就是有人收了他的继母。
refs.text_big5: 確實聽說在你們中間有淫亂的事，這樣的淫亂，連外邦人中也沒有，就是有人收了他的繼母。
refs.text_en: It is actually reported that there is fornication among you, and such fornication that does not even occur among the Gentiles, that someone has his stepmother.

verses.text_gb: 你的姊妹，不拘是异母同父的，或异父同母的，无论是生在家的或生在外的，都不可露她们的下体。
verses.text_big5: 你的姊妹，不拘是異母同父的，或異父同母的，無論是生在家的或生在外的，都不可露她們的下體。
verses.text_en: The nakedness of your sister, your father's daughter, or your mother's daughter, whether born at home or born abroad, their nakedness you shall not uncover.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你的姊妹，不拘是异母同父的，或异父同母的，无论是生在家的或生在外的，都不可露她们的下体。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你的姊妹，不拘是異母同父的，或異父同母的，無論是生在家的或生在外的，都不可露她們的下體。

verses.text_gb: 不可露你孙女或外孙女的下体，因为她们的下体就是你自己的下体。
verses.text_big5: 不可露你孫女或外孫女的下體，因為她們的下體就是你自己的下體。
verses.text_en: The nakedness of your son's daughter or of your daughter's daughter, their nakedness you shall not uncover; for their nakedness is your own nakedness.
verses.text_gb_plain: 不可露你孙女或外孙女的下体，因为她们的下体就是你自己的下体。
verses.text_big5_plain: 不可露你孫女或外孫女的下體，因為她們的下體就是你自己的下體。

verses.text_gb: 你父亲妻子从你父亲生的女儿本是你的姊妹，不可露她的下体。
verses.text_big5: 你父親妻子從你父親生的女兒本是你的姊妹，不可露她的下體。
verses.text_en: The nakedness of your father's wife's daughter, begotten of your father-she is your sister-you shall not uncover her nakedness.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你父亲妻子从你父亲生的女儿本是你的姊妹，不可露她的下体。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你父親妻子從你父親生的女兒本是你的姊妹，不可露她的下體。

verses.text_gb: 不可露你姑母的下体；她是你父亲的骨肉之亲。
verses.text_big5: 不可露你姑母的下體；她是你父親的骨肉之親。
verses.text_en: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's sister; she is your father's flesh.
verses.text_gb_plain: 不可露你姑母的下体；她是你父亲的骨肉之亲。
verses.text_big5_plain: 不可露你姑母的下體；她是你父親的骨肉之親。

verses.text_gb: 不可露你姨母的下体；她是你母亲的骨肉之亲。
verses.text_big5: 不可露你姨母的下體；她是你母親的骨肉之親。
verses.text_en: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother's sister, for she is your mother's flesh.
verses.text_gb_plain: 不可露你姨母的下体；她是你母亲的骨肉之亲。
verses.text_big5_plain: 不可露你姨母的下體；她是你母親的骨肉之親。

verses.text_gb: 不可亲近你伯叔的妻子，这乃是露你伯叔的下体；她是你的伯叔母。
verses.text_big5: 不可親近你伯叔的妻子，這乃是露你伯叔的下體；她是你的伯叔母。
verses.text_en: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's brother, that is, you shall not approach his wife; she is your aunt.
verses.text_gb_plain: 不可亲近你伯叔的妻子，这乃是露你伯叔的下体；她是你的伯叔母。
verses.text_big5_plain: 不可親近你伯叔的妻子，這乃是露你伯叔的下體；她是你的伯叔母。

verses.text_gb: 不可露你儿媳的下体；她是你儿子的妻子，不可露她的下体。
verses.text_big5: 不可露你兒媳的下體；她是你兒子的妻子，不可露她的下體。
verses.text_en: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law; she is your son's wife; you shall not uncover her nakedness.
verses.text_gb_plain: 不可露你儿媳的下体；她是你儿子的妻子，不可露她的下体。
verses.text_big5_plain: 不可露你兒媳的下體；她是你兒子的妻子，不可露她的下體。

verses.text_gb: 不可露你[Cra]兄弟妻子的下体，这本是你兄弟的下体。
verses.text_big5: 不可露你[Cra]兄弟妻子的下體，這本是你兄弟的下體。
verses.text_en: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother's wife; it is your brother's nakedness.
verses.text_gb_plain: 不可露你兄弟妻子的下体，这本是你兄弟的下体。
verses.text_big5_plain: 不可露你兄弟妻子的下體，這本是你兄弟的下體。

refs.text_gb: 人若娶他兄弟的妻子，这本是污秽的事；他是揭露了他兄弟的下体；二人必无子女。
refs.text_big5: 人若娶他兄弟的妻子，這本是污穢的事；他是揭露了他兄弟的下體；二人必無子女。
refs.text_en: If there is a man who takes his brother's wife, it is impurity. He has uncovered his brother's nakedness; they shall be childless.

refs.text_gb: 因为约翰曾对他说，你不可娶这妇人。
refs.text_big5: 因為約翰曾對他說，你不可娶這婦人。
refs.text_en: For John had been saying to him, It is not lawful for you to have her.

refs.text_gb: 约翰曾对希律说，你不可娶你兄弟的妻子。
refs.text_big5: 約翰曾對希律說，你不可娶你兄弟的妻子。
refs.text_en: For John had been saying to Herod, It is not lawful for you to have the wife of your brother.

verses.text_gb: 不可露了妇人的下体，又露她女儿的下体，也不可娶她孙女或外孙女，露她的下体；她们是骨肉之亲，这是大恶。
verses.text_big5: 不可露了婦人的下體，又露她女兒的下體，也不可娶她孫女或外孫女，露她的下體；她們是骨肉之親，這是大惡。
verses.text_en: You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter; you shall not take her son's daughter or her daughter's daughter to uncover her nakedness; they are her flesh; it is wickedness.
verses.text_gb_plain: 不可露了妇人的下体，又露她女儿的下体，也不可娶她孙女或外孙女，露她的下体；她们是骨肉之亲，这是大恶。
verses.text_big5_plain: 不可露了婦人的下體，又露她女兒的下體，也不可娶她孫女或外孫女，露她的下體；她們是骨肉之親，這是大惡。

verses.text_gb: 你妻子还活着的时候，不可另娶她的姊妹作对头，露她的下体。
verses.text_big5: 你妻子還活著的時候，不可另娶她的姊妹作對頭，露她的下體。
verses.text_en: And you shall not take a woman as wife in addition to her sister, as a rival to uncover her nakedness while she is alive.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你妻子还活着的时候，不可另娶她的姊妹作对头，露她的下体。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你妻子還活著的時候，不可另娶她的姊妹作對頭，露她的下體。

verses.text_gb: 女人在月经不洁净的时候，不可亲近她，露她的下体。
verses.text_big5: 女人在月經不潔淨的時候，不可親近她，露她的下體。
verses.text_en: And you shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness while she is in her menstrual uncleanness.
verses.text_gb_plain: 女人在月经不洁净的时候，不可亲近她，露她的下体。
verses.text_big5_plain: 女人在月經不潔淨的時候，不可親近她，露她的下體。

verses.text_gb: 不可与同伴的妻子交合，因而玷污自己。
verses.text_big5: 不可與同伴的妻子交合，因而玷污自己。
verses.text_en: And you shall not have sexual relations with the wife of your fellow countryman to become defiled with her.
verses.text_gb_plain: 不可与同伴的妻子交合，因而玷污自己。
verses.text_big5_plain: 不可與同伴的妻子交合，因而玷污自己。

verses.text_gb: 不可使你的儿女经火归与[Cra]摩洛，因而亵渎你神的名；我是耶和华。
verses.text_big5: 不可使你的兒女經火歸與[Cra]摩洛，因而褻瀆你神的名；我是耶和華。
verses.text_en: And you shall not give any of your offspring to pass through the fire to Molech, and so profane the name of your God; I am Jehovah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 不可使你的儿女经火归与摩洛，因而亵渎你神的名；我是耶和华。
verses.text_big5_plain: 不可使你的兒女經火歸與摩洛，因而褻瀆你神的名；我是耶和華。

refs.text_gb: 你还要对以色列人说，凡以色列人，或是在以色列中寄居的外人，把自己的儿女献给摩洛的，必要被处死；本地的人要用石头把他打死。
refs.text_big5: 你還要對以色列人說，凡以色列人，或是在以色列中寄居的外人，把自己的兒女獻給摩洛的，必要被處死；本地的人要用石頭把他打死。
refs.text_en: Moreover you shall say to the children of Israel, Anyone of the children of Israel or of the sojourners who sojourn in Israel who gives any of his offspring to Molech shall surely be put to death; the people of the land shall stone him with stones.

refs.text_gb: 我也要向那人变脸，把他从民中剪除，因为他把儿女献给摩洛，以致玷污我的圣所，亵渎我的圣名。
refs.text_big5: 我也要向那人變臉，把他從民中剪除，因為他把兒女獻給摩洛，以致玷污我的聖所，褻瀆我的聖名。
refs.text_en: I will also set My face against that man and will cut him off from among his people because he has given one of his offspring to Molech, so as to defile My sanctuary and profane My holy name.

refs.text_gb: 那人把儿女献给摩洛，本地的人若佯为不见，不把他处死，
refs.text_big5: 那人把兒女獻給摩洛，本地的人若佯為不見，不把他處死，
refs.text_en: And if the people of the land ever hide their eyes from that man when he gives some of his offspring to Molech, and do not put him to death,

refs.text_gb: 我就要向那人和他的家变脸，把他并一切随从他与摩洛行邪淫的人，都从民中剪除。
refs.text_big5: 我就要向那人和他的家變臉，把他並一切隨從他與摩洛行邪淫的人，都從民中剪除。
refs.text_en: Then I will set My face against that man and against his family, and I will cut off from among their people him and all who prostitute themselves after him, to prostitute themselves after Molech.

refs.text_gb: 王又污秽欣嫩子谷的陀斐特，不许人在那里使儿女经火献给摩洛；
refs.text_big5: 王又污穢欣嫩子谷的陀斐特，不許人在那裏使兒女經火獻給摩洛；
refs.text_en: And he defiled Topheth, which is in the valley of the sons of Hinnom, so that no one could make his son or his daughter pass through fire to Molech.

refs.text_gb: 他们在欣嫩子谷，建筑巴力的邱坛，好使自己的儿女经火归摩洛，他们行这可憎的事，使犹大犯罪，这并不是我所吩咐的，也不是我心所起的意。
refs.text_big5: 他們在欣嫩子谷，建築巴力的邱壇，好使自己的兒女經火歸摩洛，他們行這可憎的事，使猶大犯罪，這並不是我所吩咐的，也不是我心所起的意。
refs.text_en: And they built the high places of Baal in the valley of the son of Hinnom in order to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through fire to Molech, something I did not command them to do, nor did it come up in My heart that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.

verses.text_gb: 不可与[Cra]男人苟合，像与女人一样；这是可憎的。
verses.text_big5: 不可與[Cra]男人苟合，像與女人一樣；這是可憎的。
verses.text_en: You shall not lie with a male as one lies with a woman; it is an abomination.
verses.text_gb_plain: 不可与男人苟合，像与女人一样；这是可憎的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 不可與男人苟合，像與女人一樣；這是可憎的。

refs.text_gb: 人若与男人苟合，像与女人一样，他们二人行了可憎的事，必要被处死，流他们血的罪要归到他们身上。
refs.text_big5: 人若與男人苟合，像與女人一樣，他們二人行了可憎的事，必要被處死，流他們血的罪要歸到他們身上。
refs.text_en: If there is a man who lies with a male as with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination. They shall surely be put to death; their blood is upon them.

refs.text_gb: 男人也是如此，弃了女人顺性的用处，欲火中烧，彼此贪恋，男和男行可耻的事，就在自己身上受这妄为当得的报应。
refs.text_big5: 男人也是如此，棄了女人順性的用處，慾火中燒，彼此貪戀，男和男行可恥的事，就在自己身上受這妄為當得的報應。
refs.text_en: And likewise also the males, leaving the natural use of the female, burned in their craving toward one another, males with males committing unseemliness and fully receiving in themselves the retribution of their error which was due.

refs.text_gb: 你们岂不知，不义的不能承受神的国么？不要受迷惑，无论是淫乱的、拜偶像的、奸淫的、作娈童的、同性恋的、

refs.text_en: Or do you not know that the unrighteous will not inherit the kingdom of God? Do not be led astray; neither fornicators nor idolaters nor adulterers nor effeminate nor homosexuals

verses.text_gb: 不可与兽淫合，因而玷污自己；女人也不可站在兽前，与它淫合；这是逆性的事。
verses.text_big5: 不可與獸淫合，因而玷污自己；女人也不可站在獸前，與牠淫合；這是逆性的事。
verses.text_en: And you shall not lie with any beast to defile yourself with it; neither shall any woman stand before a beast, to lie down with it; it is confusion.
verses.text_gb_plain: 不可与兽淫合，因而玷污自己；女人也不可站在兽前，与它淫合；这是逆性的事。
verses.text_big5_plain: 不可與獸淫合，因而玷污自己；女人也不可站在獸前，與牠淫合；這是逆性的事。

verses.text_gb: 在这一切的事上，你们都不可玷污自己；因为我在你们面前所赶出的国民，在这一切的事上玷污了自己。
verses.text_big5: 在這一切的事上，你們都不可玷污自己；因為我在你們面前所趕出的國民，在這一切的事上玷污了自己。
verses.text_en: Do not defile yourselves in any of these things, for by all these the nations which I am casting out before you have defiled themselves.
verses.text_gb_plain: 在这一切的事上，你们都不可玷污自己；因为我在你们面前所赶出的国民，在这一切的事上玷污了自己。
verses.text_big5_plain: 在這一切的事上，你們都不可玷污自己；因為我在你們面前所趕出的國民，在這一切的事上玷污了自己。

verses.text_gb: 因为那地受了玷污，所以我[Fn1]向那地追讨罪孽，那[Cra]地也[Fn2]吐出其中的居民。
verses.text_big5: 因為那地受了玷污，所以我[Fn1]向那地追討罪孽，那[Cra]地也[Fn2]吐出其中的居民。
verses.text_en: Because the land has become defiled, I visited its iniquity upon it, and the land vomited out its inhabitants.
verses.text_gb_plain: 因为那地受了玷污，所以我向那地追讨罪孽，那地也吐出其中的居民。
verses.text_big5_plain: 因為那地受了玷污，所以我向那地追討罪孽，那地也吐出其中的居民。

footnotes.zh: 表征基督的那地(见申八7注1)，是为着神子民生存和生活的供应，也是为着他们的享受。美地吐出受玷污且不圣别的居民(25，28，二十22)，表征包罗万有的基督，原是我们的居所和我们所需的一切，作我们的享受，但如果我们与祂的关系不正确，祂就要把我们从祂自己里面吐出去，不再让我们享受祂(参启三16)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 表徵基督的那地，（見申八7註1，）是為著神子民生存和生活的供應，也是為著他們的享受。美地吐出受玷污且不聖別的居民，（25，28，二十22，）表徵包羅萬有的基督，原是我們的居所和我們所需的一切，作我們的享受，但如果我們與祂的關係不正確，祂就要把我們從祂自己裏面吐出去，不再讓我們享受祂。（參啟三16。）
footnotes.en: 18:25 2 vomited The land, signifying Christ (see note Deut. 8:7 1 ), is the supply for the existence and living of God's people and is also for their enjoyment. The good land vomiting out the defiled and unholy people (vv. 25, 28; 20:22) signifies that the all-inclusive Christ as our dwelling place and everything we need for our enjoyment will vomit us out of Himself and not allow us to enjoy Him any longer (cf. Rev. 3:16) if we are not proper in relation to Him.

refs.text_gb: 所以你们要谨守遵行我一切的律例和典章，免得我领你们去住的那地把你们吐出。
refs.text_big5: 所以你們要謹守遵行我一切的律例和典章，免得我領你們去住的那地把你們吐出。
refs.text_en: You shall therefore keep all My statutes and all My ordinances, and do them, so that the land into which I am bringing you to dwell in does not vomit you out.

verses.text_gb: 故此，你们要谨守我的律例和典章；这一切可憎的事，无论是本地人，或是寄居在你们中间的外人，都不可行，

verses.text_big5: 免得你們玷污那地的時候，地就把你們吐出，像吐出在你們以先的國民一樣。
verses.text_en: That the land does not vomit you out when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation which was before you.

verses.text_big5_plain: 免得你們玷污那地的時候，地就把你們吐出，像吐出在你們以先的國民一樣。

verses.text_big5: 無論甚麼人行了其中一件可憎的事，必從民中剪除。
verses.text_en: For all who do any of these abominations, those persons who do them shall be cut off from among their people.

verses.text_en: Therefore you shall keep My charge, so that you do not commit any of these abominable customs which were committed before you, and you do not defile yourselves by them; I am Jehovah your God.
verses.text_gb_plain: 所以，你们要谨守我所吩咐的，免得你们随从那些可憎的风俗，就是在你们以先的人所行的，以致玷污了自己；我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.text_big5_plain: 所以，你們要謹守我所吩咐的，免得你們隨從那些可憎的風俗，就是在你們以先的人所行的，以致玷污了自己；我是耶和華你們的神。

verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华对摩西说，
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華對摩西說，

verses.text_en: Speak to all the assembly of the children of Israel, and say to them, You shall be holy, for I, Jehovah your God, am holy.

verses.text_big5_plain: 你要對以色列人全會眾說，你們要聖別，因為我耶和華你們的神是聖別的。

refs.text_gb: 我是耶和华你们的神；所以你们要使自己分别为圣，成为圣别，因为我是圣别的。你们总不可因地上爬行的物污秽自己。
refs.text_big5: 我是耶和華你們的神；所以你們要使自己分別為聖，成為聖別，因為我是聖別的。你們總不可因地上爬行的物污穢自己。
refs.text_en: For I am Jehovah your God. Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy, for I am holy. And you shall not defile yourselves with any of the swarming things that move upon the earth.

refs.text_gb: 我是领你们从埃及地上来的耶和华，要作你们的神；所以你们要圣别，因为我是圣别的。
refs.text_big5: 我是領你們從埃及地上來的耶和華，要作你們的神；所以你們要聖別，因為我是聖別的。
refs.text_en: For I am Jehovah, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt to be your God; you shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

refs.text_gb: 所以你们要使自己分别为圣，成为圣别；因为我是耶和华你们的神。
refs.text_big5: 所以你們要使自己分別為聖，成為聖別；因為我是耶和華你們的神。
refs.text_en: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am Jehovah your God.

refs.text_gb: 你们要归我为圣别，因为我耶和华是圣别的，并且把你们从众民中分别出来归我。
refs.text_big5: 你們要歸我為聖別，因為我耶和華是聖別的，並且把你們從眾民中分別出來歸我。
refs.text_en: And you shall be holy to Me, because I Jehovah am holy, and I have set you apart from the peoples to be Mine.

refs.text_en: Because it is written, "You shall be holy because I am holy."

refs.text_en: Cursed is the man who makes an idol or a molten image, an abomination to Jehovah, the work of the craftsman's hands, and puts it in a secret place. And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.

refs.text_gb: 众民的神都属虚无，唯独耶和华造作诸天。
refs.text_big5: 眾民的神都屬虛無，惟獨耶和華造作諸天。
refs.text_en: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, / But Jehovah made the heavens.

verses.text_gb: [Cra]你们献[Fn1]平安祭给耶和华的时候，要献得可蒙悦纳。
verses.text_big5: [Cra]你們獻[Fn1]平安祭給耶和華的時候，要獻得可蒙悅納。

verses.text_gb_plain: 你们献平安祭给耶和华的时候，要献得可蒙悦纳。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們獻平安祭給耶和華的時候，要獻得可蒙悅納。

footnotes.zh: 见三1注1。平安祭要献得可蒙悦纳，表征擘饼记念主要作得蒙主悦纳(参林前十一17～21)。 这里提到平安祭，指明在十八至二十章所描述神圣别子民的圣别生活中，神圣别的子民在平安里有交通、来往、彼此的享受，乃是非常重要的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見三1註1。平安祭要獻得可蒙悅納，表徵擘餅記念主要作得蒙主悅納。（參林前十一17～21。）ˍ這裏題到平安祭，指明在十八至二十章所描述神聖別子民的聖別生活中，神聖別的子民在平安裏有交通、來往、彼此的享受，乃是非常重要的。
footnotes.en: 19:5 1 peace See note Lev. 3:1 1 . The offering of the peace offering in an acceptable way signifies that the breaking of bread for the remembrance of the Lord should be done in a way that is acceptable to the Lord (cf. 1 Cor. 11:17-21). The mentioning of the peace offering here indicates that in the holy living of God's holy people, as portrayed in chs. 18—20, it is important that God's holy people have fellowship, communion, mutual enjoyment, in peace.

refs.text_gb: 若所献的供物是为还愿，或是甘心献的，要在献祭的日子吃，所剩下的第二天也可以吃。
refs.text_big5: 若所獻的供物是為還願，或是甘心獻的，要在獻祭的日子喫，所剩下的第二天也可以喫。
refs.text_en: But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow or a freewill offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he presents his sacrifice, and on the next day what remains of it shall be eaten;

refs.text_gb: 但所剩下的祭肉，到第三天要用火焚烧；
refs.text_big5: 但所剩下的祭肉，到第三天要用火焚燒；
refs.text_en: But what remains of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.

refs.text_gb: 第三天若吃了平安祭牲的肉，这祭必不蒙悦纳，人所献的也不算为祭，反成了可憎之物；吃这祭肉的人，必担当他的罪孽。
refs.text_big5: 第三天若喫了平安祭牲的肉，這祭必不蒙悅納，人所獻的也不算為祭，反成了可憎之物；喫這祭肉的人，必擔當他的罪孽。
refs.text_en: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten at all on the third day, it will not be accepted, neither will it be reckoned to the one who presents it; it will be an abomination, and the person who eats of it shall bear his own iniquity.

refs.text_gb: 你们献感谢祭给耶和华，要献得可蒙悦纳。
refs.text_big5: 你們獻感謝祭給耶和華，要獻得可蒙悅納。
refs.text_en: And when you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to Jehovah, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.

refs.text_gb: 要当天吃，一点不可留到早晨；我是耶和华。
refs.text_big5: 要當天喫，一點不可留到早晨；我是耶和華。
refs.text_en: On the same day it shall be eaten; you shall leave none of it until the morning; I am Jehovah.

verses.text_gb: 这祭物要在献的[Fn1]当天或第二天吃，若有剩到第三天的，就要用火焚烧。
verses.text_big5: 這祭物要在獻的[Fn1]當天或第二天喫，若有剩到第三天的，就要用火焚燒。
verses.text_en: It shall be eaten on the day you sacrifice it, or on the next day, but what remains until the third day shall be burned with fire.
verses.text_gb_plain: 这祭物要在献的当天或第二天吃，若有剩到第三天的，就要用火焚烧。
verses.text_big5_plain: 這祭物要在獻的當天或第二天喫，若有剩到第三天的，就要用火焚燒。

footnotes.zh: 6～8节的话，表征信徒为着与神并彼此之间的交通，而享受基督作平安祭，应当保持新鲜。信徒彼此之间并与神的交通若是陈旧，就不蒙神悦纳且为神所憎恶(7)。有分于陈旧交通的人，犯了轻看神的圣物之罪，会失去神子民中间的交通(8)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 6～8節的話，表徵信徒為著與神並彼此之間的交通，而享受基督作平安祭，應當保持新鮮。信徒彼此之間並與神的交通若是陳舊，就不蒙神悅納且為神所憎惡。（7。）有分於陳舊交通的人，犯了輕看神的聖物之罪，會失去神子民中間的交通。（8。）
footnotes.en: 19:6 1 day The word in vv. 6-8 signifies that the believers' enjoyment of Christ as the peace offering for their fellowship with God and with one another should be kept fresh. Stale fellowship with one another and with God is not acceptable but is abhorrent to God (v. 7). The one who participates in stale fellowship is guilty of having despised the holy things of God and will lose the fellowship among God's people (v. 8).

refs.text_gb: 你们收割地的庄稼时，不可割尽田角，也不可拾取收割时所遗落的，要留给穷人和寄居的；我是耶和华你们的神。
refs.text_big5: 你們收割地的莊稼時，不可割盡田角，也不可拾取收割時所遺落的，要留給窮人和寄居的；我是耶和華你們的神。
refs.text_en: And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not completely reap the corners of your field, nor shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest; you shall leave them for the poor and for the sojourner; I am Jehovah your God.

refs.text_gb: 你在田间收割庄稼，若忘下一捆在田里，不可回去拾取，要留给寄居的与孤儿寡妇；这样，耶和华你神必在你手所办的一切事上，赐福与你。
refs.text_big5: 你在田間收割莊稼，若忘下一捆在田裏，不可回去拾取，要留給寄居的與孤兒寡婦；這樣，耶和華你神必在你手所辦的一切事上，賜福與你。
refs.text_en: When you reap your harvest in your field and you forget a sheaf in the field, you shall not turn back to gather it; it shall be for the sojourner, the orphan, and the widow, in order that Jehovah your God may bless you in all your undertakings.

refs.text_en: I will cause it to go forth, declares Jehovah of hosts; and it will enter the house of him who steals and the house of him who swears falsely by My name; and it will lodge overnight within his house and consume it, both with its timbers and its stones.

refs.text_en: Again, you have heard that it was said to the ancients, "You shall not break an oath, but you shall render to the Lord your oaths."

refs.text_gb: 再者，若是你的弟兄犯罪得罪你，你要去，只在你和他之间指出他的过错。他若听你，你就得着了你的弟兄。
refs.text_big5: 再者，若是你的弟兄犯罪得罪你，你要去，只在你和他之間指出他的過錯。他若聽你，你就得著了你的弟兄。
refs.text_en: Moreover if your brother sins against you, go, reprove him between you and him alone. If he hears you, you have gained your brother.

refs.text_gb: 公开的责备强如暗中的爱。
refs.text_big5: 公開的責備強如暗中的愛。
refs.text_en: Open rebuke is better / Than love that is hidden.

refs.text_gb: 朋友加的伤痕是出于忠诚，仇敌却与你连连亲嘴。
refs.text_big5: 朋友加的傷痕是出於忠誠，仇敵卻與你連連親嘴。
refs.text_en: Faithful are the wounds of a friend, / But the kisses of an enemy are profuse.

refs.text_gb: 我何时指着恶人说，恶人哪，你必要死；你若不发言警戒恶人，使他离开他的行径，那恶人必因自己的罪孽而死，我却要从你手中追讨流他血的罪。
refs.text_big5: 我何時指著惡人說，惡人哪，你必要死；你若不發言警戒惡人，使他離開他的行徑，那惡人必因自己的罪孽而死，我卻要從你手中追討流他血的罪。
refs.text_en: When I say to the wicked, O wicked man, you will surely die, and you do not speak to warn the wicked from his way, that wicked man will die in his iniquity, but his blood I will require at your hand.

refs.text_gb: 倘若你警戒恶人转离他的行径，他仍不转离，他必因自己的罪孽而死，你却救了自己的性命。
refs.text_big5: 倘若你警戒惡人轉離他的行徑，他仍不轉離，他必因自己的罪孽而死，你卻救了自己的性命。
refs.text_en: Yet if you warn the wicked man of his way to turn from it and he does not turn from his way, he will die in his iniquity, and you have delivered your soul.

refs.text_gb: 你们要小心，若是你的弟兄犯了罪，就责备他；他若悔改，就赦免他。
refs.text_big5: 你們要小心，若是你的弟兄犯了罪，就責備他；他若悔改，就赦免他。
refs.text_en: Take heed to yourselves. If your brother sins, rebuke him; and if he repents, forgive him.

refs.text_gb: 弟兄们，即使有人偶然为某种过犯所胜，你们属灵的人，也当用温柔的灵挽回这样的人，可是要当心自己，免得也被试诱。
refs.text_big5: 弟兄們，即使有人偶然為某種過犯所勝，你們屬靈的人，也當用溫柔的靈挽回這樣的人，可是要當心自己，免得也被試誘。
refs.text_en: Brothers, even if a man is overtaken in some offense, you who are spiritual restore such a one in a spirit of meekness, looking to yourself lest you also be tempted.

refs.text_gb: 只是不要以他为仇敌，乃要劝戒他如弟兄。
refs.text_big5: 只是不要以他為仇敵，乃要勸戒他如弟兄。
refs.text_en: Yet do not regard him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

refs.text_en: For, "You shall not commit adultery, you shall not murder, you shall not steal, you shall not covet," and if there is any other commandment, it is summed up in this word, namely, "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."

refs.text_en: If indeed you are fulfilling the royal law according to the Scripture, "You shall love your neighbor as yourself," you do well;

verses.text_gb: 你们要守我的律例。不可叫你的[Fn1]牲畜与异类交配；不可用两样搀杂的种子种田，也不可用两样搀杂的料子作衣服穿在身上。
verses.text_big5: 你們要守我的律例。不可叫你的[Fn1]牲畜與異類交配；不可用兩樣攙雜的種子種田，也不可用兩樣攙雜的料子作衣服穿在身上。
verses.text_en: You shall keep My statutes. You shall not let your cattle breed with a different kind; you shall not sow your field with two kinds of seed, nor shall a garment made of two kinds of material come upon you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们要守我的律例。不可叫你的牲畜与异类交配；不可用两样搀杂的种子种田，也不可用两样搀杂的料子作衣服穿在身上。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們要守我的律例。不可叫你的牲畜與異類交配；不可用兩樣攙雜的種子種田，也不可用兩樣攙雜的料子作衣服穿在身上。

footnotes.zh: 不容许有掺杂，这指明神要万物各从其类(参创一11，21，24～25)，没有任何种的掺杂。牲畜交配不可掺杂，表征生命不可掺杂：凡凭神生命而活的，就不可凭肉体而活(参加五16)。播种不可掺杂，表征话语的职事不可掺杂：所供应神的话，不可与世界的话掺杂(参林前二13，提前一3～4)。不用掺杂的衣料作衣服，表征我们的行为不可掺杂：活在新约生命里的人，不该凭旧约的规条而活(加二19～20，五1～6)；属于主的人，不该照着外邦人的风俗生活(二十23，参弗四17，罗十二2上)。见十八3注1。
footnotes.en: 19:19 1 cattle The fact that no mixture was allowed indicates that God wants everything to be after its kind (cf. Gen. 1:11, 21, 24-25), without any kind of mixture. Breeding cattle without mixture signifies that life is not allowed to be mixed: those living by the life of God must not live by the flesh (cf. Gal. 5:16). Sowing seed without mixture signifies that the ministry of the word is not allowed to be mixed: the word of God that is ministered should not be mixed with the word of the world (cf. 1 Cor. 2:13; 1 Tim. 1:3-4). Making a garment without mixing materials signifies that our conduct is not allowed to be mixed: those living in the life of the New Testament should not live by the ordinances of the Old Testament (Gal. 2:19-20; 5:1-6), and those who belong to the Lord should not live according to the customs of the Gentiles (Lev. 20:23; cf. Eph. 4:17; Rom. 12:2a). See note Lev. 18:3 1 .

refs.text_en: Then Saul disguised himself and put on other clothes. And he and two men with him went, and they came to the woman by night. And he said, Consult a departed spirit for me, and bring up to me the one whom I tell you.

refs.text_gb: 后来，我们往那祷告的地方去，有一个使女迎面而来，她有巫觋的灵附着，行占卜，叫她的主人们大得财利。
refs.text_big5: 後來，我們往那禱告的地方去，有一個使女迎面而來，她有巫覡的靈附著，行占卜，叫她的主人們大得財利。
refs.text_en: And as we were going to the place of prayer, a certain slave girl having a spirit of Python met us, who brought her masters much profit by divining.

refs.text_gb: 我乃是说，外邦人所献的祭，是祭鬼，不是祭神；我不愿意你们成为与鬼交通的人。
refs.text_big5: 我乃是說，外邦人所獻的祭，是祭鬼，不是祭神；我不願意你們成為與鬼交通的人。
refs.text_en: No, but that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God; and I do not want you to become those who have fellowship with demons.

verses.text_gb: 在白发的人面前，你要[Cra]站起来，也要尊敬老年人；又要敬畏你的神；我是耶和华。
verses.text_big5: 在白髮的人面前，你要[Cra]站起來，也要尊敬老年人；又要敬畏你的神；我是耶和華。
verses.text_en: You shall rise up before the grayheaded and honor the face of the old man. And you shall fear your God; I am Jehovah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 在白发的人面前，你要站起来，也要尊敬老年人；又要敬畏你的神；我是耶和华。
verses.text_big5_plain: 在白髮的人面前，你要站起來，也要尊敬老年人；又要敬畏你的神；我是耶和華。

refs.text_gb: 力量乃少年人的荣耀，白发为老年人的尊荣。
refs.text_big5: 力量乃少年人的榮耀，白髮為老年人的尊榮。
refs.text_en: The glory of young men is their strength, / And the honor of old men is gray hair.

refs.text_gb: 不可严责老年人，只要劝他如同父亲，劝青年人如同弟兄，
refs.text_big5: 不可嚴責老年人，只要勸他如同父親，勸青年人如同弟兄，
refs.text_en: Do not upbraid an elderly man, but exhort him as a father, younger men as brothers,

verses.text_gb: 若有外人在你们的地寄居，你们不可欺负他。
verses.text_big5: 若有外人在你們的地寄居，你們不可欺負他。
verses.text_en: And if a sojourner sojourns with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong.
verses.text_gb_plain: 若有外人在你们的地寄居，你们不可欺负他。
verses.text_big5_plain: 若有外人在你們的地寄居，你們不可欺負他。

verses.text_gb: 在你们那里[Cra]寄居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如同自己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的；我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.text_big5: 在你們那裏[Cra]寄居的外人，你們要看他如本地人一樣，並要愛他如同自己，因為你們在埃及地也作過寄居的；我是耶和華你們的神。
verses.text_en: The sojourner who sojourns with you shall be to you as the native among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you were sojourners in the land of Egypt; I am Jehovah your God.
verses.text_gb_plain: 在你们那里寄居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如同自己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的；我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.text_big5_plain: 在你們那裏寄居的外人，你們要看他如本地人一樣，並要愛他如同自己，因為你們在埃及地也作過寄居的；我是耶和華你們的神。

refs.text_gb: 不可亏负寄居的，也不可欺压他，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。
refs.text_big5: 不可虧負寄居的，也不可欺壓他，因為你們在埃及地也作過寄居的。
refs.text_en: And you shall not wrong a sojourner, nor shall you oppress him; for you were sojourners in the land of Egypt.

refs.text_gb: 不可欺压寄居的，因为你们在埃及地作过寄居的，知道寄居者的心情。
refs.text_big5: 不可欺壓寄居的，因為你們在埃及地作過寄居的，知道寄居者的心情。
refs.text_en: And you shall not oppress a sojourner; for you know the feelings of a sojourner, for you were sojourners in the land of Egypt.

refs.text_gb: 所以你们要爱寄居的，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。
refs.text_big5: 所以你們要愛寄居的，因為你們在埃及地也作過寄居的。
refs.text_en: Therefore love the sojourner, for you were sojourners in the land of Egypt.

verses.text_gb: 你们施行审判时，在尺寸、重量或容量上，不可行不义。
verses.text_big5: 你們施行審判時，在尺寸、重量或容量上，不可行不義。
verses.text_en: You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们施行审判时，在尺寸、重量或容量上，不可行不义。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們施行審判時，在尺寸、重量或容量上，不可行不義。

verses.text_gb: [Cra]要用公道的[Crb]天平、公道的法码、公道的伊法、公道的欣；我是耶和华你们的神，曾把你们从埃及地领出来。
verses.text_big5: [Cra]要用公道的[Crb]天平、公道的法碼、公道的伊法、公道的欣；我是耶和華你們的神，曾把你們從埃及地領出來。
verses.text_en: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin; I am Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text_gb_plain: 要用公道的天平、公道的法码、公道的伊法、公道的欣；我是耶和华你们的神，曾把你们从埃及地领出来。
verses.text_big5_plain: 要用公道的天平、公道的法碼、公道的伊法、公道的欣；我是耶和華你們的神，曾把你們從埃及地領出來。

refs.text_gb: 当用足重公道的法码，足量公道的量器。这样，在耶和华你神所赐你的地上，你的日子就得以长久。
refs.text_big5: 當用足重公道的法碼，足量公道的量器。這樣，在耶和華你神所賜你的地上，你的日子就得以長久。
refs.text_en: A full and righteous weight you shall have, and a full and righteous measure you shall have, in order that your days may be extended upon the land which Jehovah your God is giving you.

refs.text_gb: 你们要用公道的天平、公道的伊法、公道的罢特。
refs.text_big5: 你們要用公道的天平、公道的伊法、公道的罷特。
refs.text_en: You shall have just balances, a just ephah, and a just bath.

crossrefs.label: b
crossrefs.raw: 箴十六11，十一1，参摩八5，弥六11

refs.text_gb: 公道的天平和秤都属耶和华；囊中的一切法码都是祂所制定的。
refs.text_big5: 公道的天平和秤都屬耶和華；囊中的一切法碼都是祂所制定的。
refs.text_en: A just balance and just scales are Jehovah's; / All the weights of the bag are His work.

refs.text_gb: 诡诈的天平为耶和华所憎恶；足重的法码为祂所喜悦。
refs.text_big5: 詭詐的天平為耶和華所憎惡；足重的法碼為祂所喜悅。
refs.text_en: A false balance is an abomination to Jehovah, / But a full weight is His delight.

refs.text_gb: 你们说，月朔几时过去，我们好卖粮？安息日几时过去，我们好摆开麦子？好把卖出用的量器弄小，把收银用的法码弄大，用诡诈的天平欺哄人；
refs.text_big5: 你們說，月朔幾時過去，我們好賣糧？安息日幾時過去，我們好擺開麥子？好把賣出用的量器弄小，把收銀用的法碼弄大，用詭詐的天平欺哄人；
refs.text_en: Saying, When will the new moon be over, that we may sell grain? / And the Sabbath, that we may lay open the wheat? / In order to make the ephah small and the shekel large / And to falsify the balances for deceit;

refs.text_gb: 我若用不公道的天平和囊中诡诈的法码，岂可算为清洁呢？
refs.text_big5: 我若用不公道的天平和囊中詭詐的法碼，豈可算為清潔呢？
refs.text_en: Shall I be pure with wicked balances / And with a bag of deceitful weights?

verses.text_gb: 你们要谨守遵行我一切的律例和典章；我是耶和华。
verses.text_big5: 你們要謹守遵行我一切的律例和典章；我是耶和華。
verses.text_en: And you shall observe all My statutes and all My ordinances, and do them; I am Jehovah.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们要谨守遵行我一切的律例和典章；我是耶和华。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們要謹守遵行我一切的律例和典章；我是耶和華。

verses.text_gb: 耶和华对摩西说，
verses.text_big5: 耶和華對摩西說，
verses.text_en: Then Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.text_gb_plain: 耶和华对摩西说，
verses.text_big5_plain: 耶和華對摩西說，

verses.text_gb: 你还要对以色列人说，凡以色列人，或是在以色列中寄居的外人，把自己的儿女献给[Cra]摩洛的，必要被处死；本地的人要用石头把他打死。
verses.text_big5: 你還要對以色列人說，凡以色列人，或是在以色列中寄居的外人，把自己的兒女獻給[Cra]摩洛的，必要被處死；本地的人要用石頭把他打死。
verses.text_en: Moreover you shall say to the children of Israel, Anyone of the children of Israel or of the sojourners who sojourn in Israel who gives any of his offspring to Molech shall surely be put to death; the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你还要对以色列人说，凡以色列人，或是在以色列中寄居的外人，把自己的儿女献给摩洛的，必要被处死；本地的人要用石头把他打死。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你還要對以色列人說，凡以色列人，或是在以色列中寄居的外人，把自己的兒女獻給摩洛的，必要被處死；本地的人要用石頭把他打死。

refs.text_gb: 不可使你的儿女经火归与摩洛，因而亵渎你神的名；我是耶和华。
refs.text_big5: 不可使你的兒女經火歸與摩洛，因而褻瀆你神的名；我是耶和華。
refs.text_en: And you shall not give any of your offspring to pass through the fire to Molech, and so profane the name of your God; I am Jehovah.

verses.text_gb: 我也要向那人变脸，把他从民中剪除，因为他把儿女献给摩洛，以致玷污我的圣所，亵渎我的圣名。
verses.text_big5: 我也要向那人變臉，把他從民中剪除，因為他把兒女獻給摩洛，以致玷污我的聖所，褻瀆我的聖名。
verses.text_en: I will also set My face against that man and will cut him off from among his people because he has given one of his offspring to Molech, so as to defile My sanctuary and profane My holy name.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我也要向那人变脸，把他从民中剪除，因为他把儿女献给摩洛，以致玷污我的圣所，亵渎我的圣名。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我也要向那人變臉，把他從民中剪除，因為他把兒女獻給摩洛，以致玷污我的聖所，褻瀆我的聖名。

verses.text_gb: 那人把儿女献给摩洛，本地的人若佯为不见，不把他处死，
verses.text_big5: 那人把兒女獻給摩洛，本地的人若佯為不見，不把他處死，
verses.text_en: And if the people of the land ever hide their eyes from that man when he gives some of his offspring to Molech, and do not put him to death,
verses.text_gb_plain: 那人把儿女献给摩洛，本地的人若佯为不见，不把他处死，
verses.text_big5_plain: 那人把兒女獻給摩洛，本地的人若佯為不見，不把他處死，

verses.text_gb: 我就要向那人和他的家变脸，把他并一切随从他与摩洛行邪淫的人，都从民中剪除。
verses.text_big5: 我就要向那人和他的家變臉，把他並一切隨從他與摩洛行邪淫的人，都從民中剪除。
verses.text_en: Then I will set My face against that man and against his family, and I will cut off from among their people him and all who prostitute themselves after him, to prostitute themselves after Molech.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我就要向那人和他的家变脸，把他并一切随从他与摩洛行邪淫的人，都从民中剪除。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我就要向那人和他的家變臉，把他並一切隨從他與摩洛行邪淫的人，都從民中剪除。

verses.text_gb: 人偏向交鬼的和行巫术的，随从他们行邪淫，我要向那人变脸，把他从民中剪除。
verses.text_big5: 人偏向交鬼的和行巫術的，隨從他們行邪淫，我要向那人變臉，把他從民中剪除。
verses.text_en: And the person who turns to mediums and to spiritists to prostitute himself after them, I will even set My face against that person and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.text_gb_plain: 人偏向交鬼的和行巫术的，随从他们行邪淫，我要向那人变脸，把他从民中剪除。
verses.text_big5_plain: 人偏向交鬼的和行巫術的，隨從他們行邪淫，我要向那人變臉，把他從民中剪除。

verses.text_gb: [Cra]所以你们要使自己分别为圣，成为[Fn1]圣别；因为我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.text_big5: [Cra]所以你們要使自己分別為聖，成為[Fn1]聖別；因為我是耶和華你們的神。
verses.text_en: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am Jehovah your God.
verses.text_gb_plain: 所以你们要使自己分别为圣，成为圣别；因为我是耶和华你们的神。
verses.text_big5_plain: 所以你們要使自己分別為聖，成為聖別；因為我是耶和華你們的神。

refs.text_gb: 我是耶和华你们的神；所以你们要使自己分别为圣，成为圣别，因为我是圣别的。你们总不可因地上爬行的物污秽自己。
refs.text_big5: 我是耶和華你們的神；所以你們要使自己分別為聖，成為聖別，因為我是聖別的。你們總不可因地上爬行的物污穢自己。
refs.text_en: For I am Jehovah your God. Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy, for I am holy. And you shall not defile yourselves with any of the swarming things that move upon the earth.

refs.text_gb: 你要对以色列人全会众说，你们要圣别，因为我耶和华你们的神是圣别的。
refs.text_big5: 你要對以色列人全會眾說，你們要聖別，因為我耶和華你們的神是聖別的。
refs.text_en: Speak to all the assembly of the children of Israel, and say to them, You shall be holy, for I, Jehovah your God, am holy.

refs.text_gb: 因为经上记着：“你们要圣别，因为我是圣别的。”
refs.text_big5: 因為經上記著：“你們要聖別，因為我是聖別的。”
refs.text_en: Because it is written, "You shall be holy because I am holy."

verses.text_gb: 你们要谨守遵行我的律例；我是使你们分别为圣的耶和华。
verses.text_big5: 你們要謹守遵行我的律例；我是使你們分別為聖的耶和華。
verses.text_en: And you shall keep My statutes and do them; I am Jehovah who sanctifies you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 你们要谨守遵行我的律例；我是使你们分别为圣的耶和华。
verses.text_big5_plain: 你們要謹守遵行我的律例；我是使你們分別為聖的耶和華。

verses.text_gb: 凡[Cra]咒骂父母的，必要被处死；他咒骂了父母，流他[Crb]血的罪要归到他身上。
verses.text_big5: 凡[Cra]咒罵父母的，必要被處死；他咒罵了父母，流他[Crb]血的罪要歸到他身上。
verses.text_en: If there is anyone who curses his father or his mother, he shall surely be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother; his blood is upon him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 凡咒骂父母的，必要被处死；他咒骂了父母，流他血的罪要归到他身上。
verses.text_big5_plain: 凡咒罵父母的，必要被處死；他咒罵了父母，流他血的罪要歸到他身上。

refs.text_en: And he who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.

refs.text_big5: 原來神說，“當孝敬父母，”又說，“咒罵父母的，要被處死。”
refs.text_en: For God said, "Honor your father and your mother," and, "He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death."

refs.text_gb: 大卫对他说，流你血的罪归到你自己的头上，因为你亲口指证说，我杀了耶和华的受膏者。

refs.text_en: And David said to him, Your blood be upon your head, for your mouth has testified against you, saying, I have killed Jehovah's anointed.

refs.text_gb: 他们既抗拒、毁谤，保罗就抖着衣服对他们说，你们的血归到你们自己头上，我是洁净的。从今以后，我要往外邦人那里去。

refs.text_en: But when they resisted and blasphemed, he shook out his garments and said to them, Your blood be upon your head; I am clean. From now on I will go to the Gentiles.

verses.text_gb: 与别人的妻子[Cra]行淫，就是与邻舍的妻子行淫的，奸夫淫妇必被处死。
